jobs.title: Salesforce Administrator
jobs.excerpt: R1 is the leading provider of technology-driven solutions that transform the patient experience and financial performance of hospitals, health systems and medical groups.
jobs.description:
R1 is the leading provider of technology-driven solutions that transform the patient experience and financial performance of hospitals, health systems and medical groups. We are the one company that combines the deep expertise of a global workforce of revenue cycle professionals with the industry’s most advanced technology platform, encompassing sophisticated analytics, AI, intelligent automation, and workflow orchestration.

As our Salesforce Administrator, you will be responsible for the execution of day-to-day configuration, support, and maintenance of our Salesforce, as well as continuously improving the platform to enable growth. Every day you will work to support various internal users, communicate with those users, and perform day to day admin work within Salesforce. To thrive in this role you must have Salesforce experience and enjoy working directly with the end users (internal customers).

Here’s what you will experience working as a Salesforce Administrator:

  • Handles all basic administrative functions, including user maintenance, reports and dashboards, Flows, lead/opportunity pipeline management, case/service requests, bug and feature requests, testing and QA in sandbox, and other routine tasks.
  • Assist in training new users and growing the Salesforce.com skill set across the organization.
  • Support other team members on special projects as needed.
  • Manage Salesforce.com data feeds and other conversions, consolidations, and integrations with platforms such as Pardot and ServiceNow.
  • Work independently and collaborate with others to deliver effective solutions that meet business requirements.
  • Develop efficient processes with a forward-thinking mindset, utilizing best practices, native functionality, and UX in mind.
  • Routinely test the stability and functionality of applications, recommending performance improvements where possible.
  • Manage cases to troubleshoot and fix bugs, documenting solutions in the ticketing system.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, Computer Sciences, or related field preferred.
  • Equivalent experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience as a Salesforce administrator.
  • Salesforce Administrator Certification required; additional certifications are preferred.
  • Strong knowledge and experience with Salesforce administration, including app building, user provisioning, data management, including the ability to configure custom apps, objects, formula fields, flows, and user security (profiles, roles and sharing rules).
  • Strong project management skills, positive attitude, and lifelong learner.
  • Proven ability to meet deadlines, prioritize requests, and manage across organizational levels.
  • Creative and analytical thinker with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Exceptional communication skills, effective at all organizational levels.
  • Ability to evaluate information, reconcile conflicts, and identify true needs.
  • Assess impact of new requirements on Salesforce.com and related systems.
  • Design and implement new processes, facilitate user adoption, and maintain Salesforce instance with a forward-thinking approach.
  • Project management experience, preferably Agile methodology.
  • Experience with Validity’s DemandTools, Conga or other CLM, integrated MAP platform (Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, Hubspot), and Gearset (or other DevOps tool).
  • Integration experience.
  • Experience as a business analyst.
  • Ability and desire to work as a team, and as an individual contributor.
  • Ability to take complex ideas and document them as functional requirements.
For this US-based position, the base pay range is $50,461.00 - $114,114.48 per year . Individual pay is determined by role, level, location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.This job is eligible to participate in our annual bonus plan at a target of 10.00%

The healthcare system is always evolving — and it’s up to us to use our shared expertise to find new solutions that can keep up. On our growing team you’ll find the opportunity to constantly learn, collaborate across groups and explore new paths for your career.

Our associates are given the chance to contribute, think boldly and create meaningful work that makes a difference in the communities we serve around the world. We go beyond expectations in everything we do. Not only does that drive customer success and improve patient care, but that same enthusiasm is applied to giving back to the community and taking care of our team — including offering a competitive benefits package.

jobs.title: Instructional Systems Designer
jobs.excerpt: At Team Carney, we believe that true performance acceleration happens at the intersection of innovative learning and deep strategic expertise.
jobs.description:
At Team Carney, we believe that true performance acceleration happens at the intersection of innovative learning and deep strategic expertise. Since 1994, our mission has been to provide top-tier training, learning, and human capital solutions that empower Federal Government agencies to meet their critical mandates. We are seeking a high-performing Instructional Systems Designer (ISD) to support the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) Corporate University (CU) Course Maintenance Program.

This position is contingent on contract award.

Work Schedule and Location

  • Employment Status: Full-Time

  • Location: Remote within the U.S., with anticipated travel to the FDIC Dallas Regional Office (Dallas, TX) approximately once per quarter

Who You Are & What You’ll Do

As an Instructional Systems Designer (ISD) supporting the FDIC Corporate University Course Maintenance Program, you will serve in a Key Personnel capacity responsible for maintaining, revising, and modernizing a comprehensive catalog of professional courses and training collateral. You will work in close collaboration with FDIC Corporate University personnel, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and technical monitors to update existing courseware across all instructional delivery formats.

In this role, you will analyze source documentation, review Course Change Sheets, and update learning products across Instructor-Led Training (ILT), Virtual Instructor-Led Training (VILT), Web-Based Training (WBT), Instructional Video, and electronic Job Aids. You will ensure all updated and converted training assets align with Corporate University design standards, templates, style guides, and Section 508 accessibility requirements.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Collaborating closely with FDIC CU personnel, project managers, and SMEs to design, update, and maintain courseware.

  • Updating and revising instructional materials across multiple modalities, including design plans, instructor guides, participant guides, slide decks, case studies, and virtual classroom setups.

  • Reviewing Course Change Sheets and updating content to reflect regulatory, technical, or procedural changes.

  • Developing asynchronous Web-Based Training (WBT) using approved templates and authoring tools (such as Lectora).

  • Creating, scripting, and captioning instructional multimedia, including video files developed in Camtasia (with separate SRT or VTT caption files).

  • Developing and updating electronic performance support tools and job aids in MS Word and PDF formats.

  • Ensuring all deliverables comply with CU technical guidelines, template specifications, and Section 508 accessibility standards.

  • Routing completed deliverables through quality assurance reviews and uploading finalized products to FDIC systems of record and LMS repositories.

What You Bring to the Table - Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in Education, Instructional Design, or a related subject.

  • Experience: Minimum of five (5) years of professional field instructional design experience (excluding time in school).

  • Accessibility Training / Certification: DHS Trusted Tester trained or certified (preferred or able to meet program testing requirements).

  • Demonstrated Functional Experience: Proven, hands-on experience across all of the following core competencies:

    • Technical writing and editing for professional and regulatory audiences.

    • Converting existing and legacy course materials into modern instructional formats.

    • Web-based course development and instructional authoring tools.

    • Multimedia technology integration and visual design.

  • Required Software & Technology Skills:

    • Microsoft Word: Advanced proficiency, including table formatting, custom styles, headers/footers, table of contents creation and updates, page and section breaks, field codes, and working with macros.

    • Microsoft PowerPoint: Advanced proficiency, including slide masters, custom layouts, placeholders, layering, graphic manipulation, and macros.

    • Microsoft Excel: High proficiency in data entry, formatting, sorting, and filtering.

  • Desirable Software & Technology Skills:

    • Lectora Inspire / Lectora Desktop (version 21 or equivalent)

    • Camtasia (video production and closed captioning)

    • Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator)

    • Adobe Connect and Microsoft Teams (virtual training and classroom management)

    • DHS Trusted Tester Section 508 conformance testing processes

Why Join Team Carney?

When you join Team Carney, you join a legacy of excellence. We focus on our people because when we make a positive impact on the lives of our employees, they are able to make a positive impact on our clients. We offer a full suite of competitive benefits, including:

  • Health & Wellness: Multiple medical, dental, and vision insurance options (BCBS CareFirst), health spending accounts (HSA), and flexible spending accounts (FSA).

  • Financial Security: 401(k) retirement plan with company match, plus Carney-paid life and disability insurance.

  • Work-Life Harmony: Generous Paid Time Off (PTO), 11 paid holidays, and 6 weeks of paid parental leave.

  • Professional & Personal Growth: Annual tuition assistance (up to $5,000) and student loan repayment.

  • Get Out and Learn: Up to $200 annually to learn almost anything (from pottery to coding!).

  • Get Out and Run: Up to $200 annually to participate in fitness and active lifestyle events.

  • Continuous Development: Ad hoc training and ongoing professional development access.

jobs.description:
Ensora Health is the leading provider of software and services for mental and behavioral health therapists, trusted by over 200,000 individual providers and more than 28,000 practices. Our unmatched expertise, partnership, and breadth of products allow us to fine-tune solutions that meet the specific needs of everyone from solo practitioners to larger practices. With AI-enabled solutions that span practice management to electronic medical records and e-prescribing to billing, we help eliminate administrative complexity and create harmony between therapists, their clients, and the whole healthcare community.

Job Description

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our team. This role will be to develop information systems by studying operations; designing, developing and installing software solutions; support and develop the software team. In this role, you will work with leadership to define software requirements and take the lead on operational and technical projects.

We’re seeking a Software Engineer with strong object-oriented programming experience (PHP preferred, but open to other OOP languages) and a thoughtful interest in how AI can enhance modern software development. In this role, you’ll take ownership of meaningful features and components, contribute across the full development lifecycle, and collaborate closely with senior engineers to build scalable, secure, and maintainable systems.

This is an opportunity for an engineer who enjoys solving moderately complex problems, writing high-quality code, and using AI-assisted tools to work more efficiently—while maintaining strong engineering judgment, reliability, and security standards


What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain small-to-medium features and services using object-oriented design principles (PHP preferred; experience in Java, C#, Python, Ruby, or similar is welcome).
  • Own technical implementation for assigned work, from design through deployment, with limited oversight.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or similar) to improve productivity, accelerate debugging, and support test creation—while validating outputs and ensuring quality.
  • Design reusable, testable components that align with existing architecture, interfaces, and coding standards.
  • Diagnose and resolve non-trivial bugs and performance issues; leverage logs, metrics, and traces to identify root causes.
  • Contribute meaningfully to automated testing efforts, including unit and integration tests, and help improve overall test coverage.
  • Participate actively in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and mentoring junior engineers when appropriate.
  • Apply secure coding practices and proactively address common web and application security risks.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers during sprint planning, estimation, and backlog refinement.
  • Maintain and improve technical documentation, using AI tools to assist with clarity, accuracy, and ongoing updates.
  • Stay current on emerging engineering and AI-assisted development practices and share effective techniques with the team.

What You Bring

Required

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience in an object-oriented language (PHP preferred).
  • Strong understanding of OOP principles, design patterns, and clean code practices.
  • Experience working in a Linux-based development environment.
  • Proficiency with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS3.
  • Solid experience with relational databases and SQL/MySQL.
  • Working understanding of system architecture concepts, debugging strategies, and observability fundamentals (logs, metrics, tracing).
  • Demonstrated commitment to code quality, testing, and maintainable design.
  • Practical experience using (or strong interest in) AI tools for coding, debugging, testing, or documentation in a responsible way.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Docker or containerized environments.
  • Exposure to AWS or other cloud platforms.
  • Experience using AI to improve engineering workflows (e.g., repeatable prompts, test generation, or faster root-cause analysis).

Additional Information

While we've outlined some key qualities we typically seek, it's essential to remember that there might be additional unique strengths and talents you possess that would make you an exceptional match for us, even if they're not explicitly mentioned. The message we want to convey is that taking a leap of faith and applying can be incredibly rewarding. So, don't hesitate—apply today and let's explore the exciting possibilities together!

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

AtEnsora Health, Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging aren’t just words. We celebrate what makes us unique, foster an ecosystem of inclusion for all and harness our talents to promote diversity of thought and action in everything we do.

jobs.excerpt: Tiger Analytics is an advanced analytics consulting firm.
jobs.description:
Tiger Analytics is an advanced analytics consulting firm. We are the trusted analytics partner for several Fortune 100 companies, enabling them to generate business value from data. Our consultants bring deep expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI. Our business value and leadership have been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner.

We are looking for an AI Engagement Lead / AI Engineering Pod Lead who can combine strong client and project leadership with hands-on expertise in AI/ML and Generative AI engineering. The role will involve approximately 50% engagement/project management and coordination and 50% hands-on technical leadership and AI engineering.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead AI/GenAI engagements from discovery and solution definition through development, deployment, and production.
  • Serve as the primary technical and delivery interface for clients and senior stakeholders.
  • Understand business objectives and translate them into AI/ML solution requirements and actionable engineering plans.
  • Own project planning, prioritization, timelines, milestones, risks, dependencies, and overall delivery.
  • Coordinate across AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Product Managers, and client teams.
  • Conduct regular client discussions, status reviews, technical walkthroughs, and solutioning sessions.
  • Proactively identify delivery risks, technical challenges, resource constraints, and dependencies and drive them toward resolution.
  • Architect, develop, and deploy AI/ML and Generative AI solutions for enterprise use cases.
  • Lead hands-on development of LLM-powered applications, RAG systems, AI agents, and agentic workflows.
  • Design and implement end-to-end AI application architectures, including: LLM integration, Prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, Embeddings and vector databases, Tool/function calling, Agent orchestration, Evaluation and monitoring
  • Work with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent technologies.
  • Integrate foundation models and LLM platforms such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Amazon Bedrock, Gemini, or open-source models.
  • Develop production-grade AI services and APIs using technologies such as Python, FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms.
  • Design retrieval pipelines including document processing, chunking, embedding generation, vector search, hybrid retrieval, and re-ranking.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, data science, or a related technical field.
  • Strong hands-on experience building and deploying AI/ML or Generative AI solutions.
  • Proven experience leading technical teams or AI engineering pods while remaining hands-on.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and experience developing production-grade applications.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, Generative AI, NLP, RAG, and AI agents.
  • Experience with one or more AI/GenAI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.
  • Experience working with LLM APIs/foundation models such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Gemini, or open-source LLMs.
  • Experience with vector databases and semantic search.
  • Experience designing and deploying cloud-based AI solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, microservices, Docker, CI/CD, and production deployment.
  • Experience with AI evaluation, monitoring, guardrails, and responsible AI is highly desirable.
  • Strong client-facing communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into practical technical solutions.
  • Master's in Business Analytics or equivalent work experience.

Benefits

Significant career development opportunities exist as the company grows. The position offers a unique opportunity to be part of a small, fast-growing, challenging and entrepreneurial environment, with a high degree of individual responsibility.

Job Description

Our Eligibility & Enrollment team is the front door to the member experience — we process every enrollment, disenrollment, plan change, and retroactive adjustment across our HMO, PPO, and Special Needs Plan products, and we own the CMS transactions that make membership accurate and auditable. As Manager, you'll turn departmental strategy into daily workflows, production targets, and staff assignments, keeping the work compliant with CMS requirements and on time.

You'll report to the Senior Manager, Eligibility & Enrollment and lead a team of Enrollment/Eligibility Associates. This is a hands-on operational leadership role: you'll be in the queues, in the data, and in the escalations, while building the reporting and controls the team runs on. Your results show up directly in CMS transaction accuracy and timeliness, inventory aging, quality audit scores, and the member experience measures tied to enrollment accuracy.

Your responsibilities and impact will include:

  • Managing daily workflow, work queues, and transaction inventory so enrollments, disenrollments, plan changes, cancellations, and retroactive adjustments across HMO, PPO, and SNP products clear within CMS and internal SLAs, holding aging and backlog inside established thresholds.

  • Monitoring CMS MARx submissions, response and reply files, and error reports so rejections and discrepancies are researched and resolved inside required timeframes, and membership reconciliation lands accurate and on time each month.

  • Serving as the first point of escalation on complex and exception-based cases, making case-level decisions consistent with CMS guidance and internal policy.

  • Supervising, coaching, and developing associates — hiring, onboarding, scheduling, one-on-ones, performance management, and individual production and quality goals tied to department KPIs — and owning the team's productivity, quality, engagement, and retention. You'll set the tone for accountability and service excellence, and address performance or conduct issues promptly and consistently.

  • Planning capacity and coverage for peak cycles, including AEP, OEP, and Special Election Periods, so volume surges don't become backlog.

  • Performing and documenting quality reviews of transactions and member records against the CMS Medicare Managed Care Enrollment and Disenrollment Guidance and internal controls, and driving individual and team audit scores.

  • Supporting CMS, internal, and external audits by preparing universes, pulling case files, validating samples, and answering auditor questions; executing assigned corrective action plans and closing them on time, with no repeat findings in your area.

  • Translating new CMS guidance and memos into operational changes — recommending workflow updates to the Senior Manager, keeping job aids and desk-level procedures current, and training staff on regulatory changes and system enhancements.

  • Identifying recurring errors, rework drivers, and manual workarounds, then implementing process improvements and automation opportunities.

  • Building and maintaining notebooks and monitoring views for volume, aging, throughput, accuracy, timeliness, and reconciliation completion, and escalating trends and risks with a recommended action rather than just a number.

  • Partnering with peer managers and staff on the design and use of AI agents in transaction processing under a human-in-the-loop model: defining where human review is required, setting quality checkpoints on agent-assisted output, documenting controls to audit standards, and coaching the team against over-reliance on automated output.

  • Partnering with Member Services, Billing, Data Reconciliation, Compliance, Sales, Agent Support, and Tech on member-impacting issues, defect resolution, file transmission and interface monitoring, and UAT for configuration changes, upgrades, new products, and plan expansions.

  • Supporting the Senior Manager with materials and analysis for leadership, CMS inquiries, and internal governance forums.

Required skills and experience:

  • 4+ years in Medicare Advantage eligibility and enrollment operations, including at least 2 years in a supervisory or team lead role.

  • Working knowledge of CMS enrollment and disenrollment regulations for HMO, PPO, and SNP products, including election periods, effective dating, and retroactive processing rules.

  • Hands-on experience with CMS MARx transaction processing, response and reply file handling, and membership reconciliation.

  • Experience supporting CMS or internal audits, including universe preparation and case documentation.

  • Strong analytical and root-cause problem-solving skills on complex transaction and eligibility discrepancies, with proficiency in Excel and reporting tools for inventory tracking, trend analysis, and audit sampling.

  • Demonstrated aptitude for hands-on operational tooling — including the ability to learn and build notebooks for metric monitoring and reporting — and willingness to work directly in AI-assisted processes under a human-in-the-loop model.

  • Effective written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain regulatory requirements to staff and non-technical partners.

  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities and high-volume workloads in a deadline-driven, regulated environment, with a demonstrated commitment to data accuracy and member confidentiality (HIPAA).

Desired skills and experience:

Location: France
Project type: One-time paid project
Time commitment: Approximately 1–2 hours
Compensation: $75 for completing the project activity

About the opportunity

CloudFactory is looking for participants to support a short-term transaction validation project that we are administering on behalf of a global payments processing company.

The project is designed to help evaluate the accuracy of how payment transactions are matched to individuals.

As a participant, you'll review a set of recent payment transactions and indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself.

How it works

If selected for the project:

  1. You'll provide the email address(es) you use with selected merchants, subscriptions, apps, or online accounts.
  2. Our payments processing client will use those email address(es) to identify payment transactions it believes are associated with you and securely provide a list of those transactions for the project.
  3. You'll be presented with approximately 50 recent transactions from the last 3 months through the designated project platform. The information shown may include details such as the merchant name, date, amount, payment method, card identifier, and card issuer to help you recognize each transaction.
  4. You'll indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself and, where helpful, add a short note.

The activity is expected to take approximately 1–2 hours.

You will not be asked to provide or upload your own transaction history, bank statements, full card number, online banking login credentials, banking password, PIN, or CVV.

Please note that this is a data validation activity only.

Requirements

To participate, you must:

  • Be 18 years of age or older.
  • Currently reside in France.
  • Be an active debit and/or credit card user.
  • Have made purchases or payments within the last three months across a variety of merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be able to recognize your own recent purchases and transactions.
  • Have access to the email address(es) you use with the merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be comfortable providing those email address(es) if selected for the project.
  • Be willing to review approximately 50 transactions and confirm whether or not you recognize them as your own.

jobs.description:
We are on the front line of recruitment, enabling organizations to hire smarter and onboard faster. At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members.

Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.

About First Advantage

First Advantage (NASDAQ: FA) is a leading provider of global software and data in the HR technology industry. Enabled by proprietary technology and AI, First Advantage’s platforms, data, and APIs power comprehensive employment background screening, identity solutions, and verification services.

Headquartered in Atlanta, GA, we have an internationally distributed workforce of about 10,000 employees spanning 17 countries. With a strong emphasis on innovation, automation, and customer success, First Advantage empowers 80,000 organizations to modernize their hiring and onboarding processes on a global scale.

Are you detail-oriented, naturally curious, and capable of delivering exceptional service? Join our team as a remote Bilingual Operations Agent (French/English) and play a critical role in helping organizations make confident hiring decisions from the comfort of your home.

In this fully remote role, you'll be at the heart of the pre-employment screening process, conducting reference interviews and employment and education verifications that are a critical component of ensuring our clients have the best candidates for their open positions. If you're looking to gain valuable exposure to Human Resources, background screening, and client services while enjoying the flexibility of working remotely, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

As a key member of our Operations team, you will:

  • Conduct professional reference interviews on behalf of our clients
  • Contact employers, educational institutions, and references to verify candidate information
  • Review and validate employment and education claims, identifying discrepancies when necessary
  • Handle inbound and outbound calls related to verifications and reference checks
  • Provide exceptional client support and respond to inquiries in both French and English
  • Prepare, proofread, and edit reports to ensure accuracy and quality
  • Deliver completed verification results through our online platform
  • Collaborate with team members to support client needs and service delivery
  • Contribute to special projects and other operational initiatives as required

What You Bring

We're looking for a motivated professional who is dedicated to accuracy, excellent communication, and delivering outstanding service.

Required Qualifications

  • Fluency in both French and English, with strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and time management abilities
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with professionalism and discretion
  • Strong customer service mindset and interpersonal skills
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team
  • Comfortable navigating multiple software platforms, online systems, and databases
  • Minimum typing speed of 35 words per minute
  • Previous work experience in customer service, administration, operations, or a related field

Language Requirement:

As our operations serve a global and diverse client base, including both English and French speaking clients, this role requires proficiency in English in addition to French to support accurate communication, consistent service quality, and effective cross‑regional operations.

Nice to Have

  • Certificate, diploma, or degree in a related field
  • Background in Human Resources, Business Administration, Criminology, or a related discipline
  • Experience in verification, screening, recruitment, or client services environments

Why Join Us?

When you join our team, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Gain hands-on experience in the growing field of pre-employment screening and HR services
  • Develop professional communication, investigative, and analytical skills
  • Work in a collaborative and supportive team environment
  • Make a meaningful impact by helping organizations hire with confidence
  • Grow your career with an industry-leading organization

Compensation & Benefits

  • Starting wage: $21.50 per hour
  • Eligibility for the Company's Annual Incentive Bonus Plan
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including:
    • Medical and dental coverage
    • Retirement savings plan (RRSP)
    • 20 days of annual PTO for eligible full-time employees
    • Fully Remote
    • Additional wellness and employee benefits

Compensation is based on job-related skills, knowledge, experience, and market location, in accordance with applicable pay transparency and equal pay legislation.

What Are You Waiting For? Apply Today!

You have learned a little about us today – we want to learn about you! If you think this position and our company are a great fit for your areas of interest and expertise, tell us about you by applying now!

This position is an actual vacancy.

Applications are processed through an Applicant Tracking System (ATS), and while automation helps with organization, all decisions include meaningful human involvement which is maintained throughout the hiring process.

If you require accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please let us know. We will work with you to meet your needs.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today and help build trust in every hire.

*****************************************************************

Nous sommes aux premières lignes du recrutement, en permettant aux organisations d’embaucher plus intelligemment et d’intégrer leurs nouveaux employés plus rapidement. Chez First Advantage (Nasdaq : FA), les personnes sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons — de nos clients et partenaires à notre plus grand avantage : les membres de notre équipe.

Dites bonjour à une carrière enrichissante et joignez-vous à un fournisseur de premier plan de solutions essentielles de vérification des antécédents pour certaines des marques les plus reconnues du Fortune 100 et du Global 500.

À propos de First Advantage

First Advantage (NASDAQ : FA) est un fournisseur de premier plan de logiciels et de données à l’échelle mondiale dans le secteur des technologies RH. Grâce à sa technologie exclusive et à l’intelligence artificielle, les plateformes, les données et les API de First Advantage alimentent des solutions complètes de vérification des antécédents d’emploi, d’identité et de vérification des renseignements.

Établie à Atlanta, en Géorgie, notre entreprise compte un effectif réparti à l’international d’environ 10 000 employés dans 17 pays. En mettant fortement l’accent sur l’innovation, l’automatisation et la réussite client, First Advantage aide 80 000 organisations à moderniser leurs processus d’embauche et d’intégration à l’échelle mondiale.

Vous avez le souci du détail, une curiosité naturelle et la capacité d’offrir un service exceptionnel? Joignez-vous à notre équipe à titre d’agent(e) des opérations bilingue à distance (français/anglais) et jouez un rôle essentiel en aidant les organisations à prendre des décisions d’embauche éclairées, dans le confort de votre domicile.

Dans ce poste entièrement à distance, vous serez au cœur du processus de présélection préemploi, en menant des entrevues de références ainsi que des vérifications d’emploi et de scolarité, qui constituent un élément essentiel pour aider nos clients à identifier les meilleurs candidats pour leurs postes à pourvoir. Si vous souhaitez acquérir une expérience précieuse en ressources humaines, en vérification des antécédents et en services à la clientèle tout en profitant de la flexibilité du télétravail, nous aimerions vous connaître.

Ce que vous ferez

À titre de membre clé de notre équipe des opérations, vous devrez :

  • Collaborer avec les membres de l’équipe afin de soutenir les besoins des clients et la prestation de services
  • Contribuer à des projets spéciaux et à d’autres initiatives opérationnelles, au besoin

Ce que vous apportez

Nous recherchons une personne professionnelle et motivée, qui accorde une grande importance à l’exactitude, à une excellente communication et à la prestation d’un service exceptionnel.

Qualifications requises

  • Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, avec d’excellentes aptitudes en communication orale et écrite
  • Excellentes compétences en organisation et en gestion du temps
  • Souci exceptionnel du détail et engagement envers l’exactitude
  • Capacité de traiter des renseignements confidentiels et sensibles avec professionnalisme et discrétion
  • Solide orientation service à la clientèle et excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles
  • Autonomie et capacité de travailler de façon indépendante ainsi qu’en collaboration au sein d’une équipe
  • Aisance à naviguer dans plusieurs plateformes logicielles, systèmes en ligne et bases de données
  • Vitesse de frappe minimale de 35 mots par minute
  • Expérience professionnelle antérieure en service à la clientèle, administration, opérations ou dans un domaine connexe

Exigence linguistique

Comme nos opérations desservent une clientèle mondiale et diversifiée, comprenant des clients anglophones et francophones, ce poste exige la maîtrise de l’anglais en plus du français afin d’assurer une communication exacte, une qualité de service constante et des opérations interrégionales efficaces.

Atouts

  • Certificat, diplôme ou grade dans un domaine connexe
  • Formation ou expérience en ressources humaines, en administration des affaires, en criminologie ou dans une discipline connexe
  • Expérience dans des environnements de vérification, de présélection, de recrutement ou de services à la clientèle

Pourquoi vous joindre à nous?

En vous joignant à notre équipe, vous aurez l’occasion de :

  • Acquérir une expérience pratique dans le domaine en croissance de la présélection préemploi et des services RH
  • Développer vos compétences en communication professionnelle, en enquête et en analyse
  • Travailler dans un environnement d’équipe collaboratif et axé sur le soutien
  • Avoir un impact concret en aidant les organisations à embaucher en toute confiance
  • Faire évoluer votre carrière au sein d’une organisation chef de file dans son secteur

Rémunération et avantages sociaux

  • Salaire de départ : 21,50 $ l’heure
  • Admissibilité au régime annuel de primes incitatives de l’entreprise
  • Gamme complète d’avantages sociaux, comprenant :
    • Assurance médicale et dentaire

La rémunération est fondée sur les compétences, les connaissances et l’expérience liées au poste, ainsi que sur le marché géographique, conformément aux lois applicables en matière de transparence salariale et d’équité salariale.

Qu’attendez-vous? Postulez dès aujourd’hui!

Vous en avez appris un peu plus sur nous aujourd’hui — nous voulons maintenant en apprendre davantage sur vous! Si vous pensez que ce poste et notre entreprise correspondent bien à vos champs d’intérêt et à votre expertise, parlez-nous de vous en postulant dès maintenant!

Ce poste correspond à un poste vacant réel.

Les candidatures sont traitées au moyen d’un système de suivi des candidatures (ATS). Bien que l’automatisation facilite l’organisation du processus, toutes les décisions comprennent une participation humaine significative, maintenue tout au long du processus d’embauche.

Si vous avez besoin de mesures d’adaptation à toute étape du processus d’embauche, veuillez nous en informer. Nous collaborerons avec vous afin de répondre à vos besoins.

  • Support data conversion initiatives related to insurance brokerage system implementations, acquisitions, agency integrations, divestitures, platform migrations, and enterprise transformation programs.

  • Compare source and target system data to identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, incomplete, or incorrectly mapped records, and document remediation requirements.
  • Support data quality reviews, exception management, defect tracking, business rule validation, and issue resolution throughout the conversion lifecycle.
  • Partner with business users, agency stakeholders, operations teams, technology teams, implementation partners, and vendors to gather requirements, resolve data issues, and support conversion readiness activities.
  • Assist with mock conversions, test migrations, user acceptance testing (UAT), production cutovers, post-load validation, reconciliation, and post-conversion stabilization efforts.
  • Analyze source data from agency management systems, CRM platforms, accounting and billing systems, document repositories, carrier interfaces, and other brokerage applications.

  • Prepare clear summaries of conversion findings, risks, open issues, validation results, and recommendations for project leadership and business stakeholders.
  • Identify potential risks, data gaps, downstream impacts, and operational concerns that could affect reporting accuracy, financial integrity, compliance requirements, or client service continuity.
  • Follow established conversion methodologies, governance standards, documentation practices, and escalation procedures to ensure successful project execution and audit readiness.
  • Contribute to business continuity and user adoption by helping ensure converted data supports operational workflows, reporting needs, client servicing activities, and compliance requirements.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance conversion processes, data quality controls, testing approaches, and documentation standards.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of insurance brokerage operations experience supporting data conversion, data migration, systems implementation, platform consolidation, agency acquisition integration, business systems support, data analysis, or related functions.
  • Experience supporting complex, cross-functional system implementation, migration, or integration initiatives.
  • Knowledge of Employee Benefits and Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance brokerage operations, data structures, and workflows, including client, policy, carrier, employer group, employee/subscriber, dependent, benefit plan, producer, commission, billing, certificates, claims, enrollment, eligibility, census, activities, attachments, and document data.

  • Exposure to reporting, analytics, and data management tools such as Power BI, SQL, Alteryx, Access, or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills with the ability to clearly document business rules, data issues, validation results, remediation actions, and open items.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with business leaders, operations teams, IT teams, vendors, implementation partners, and end users to resolve data and system-related issues.
  • Experience working in multi-location, regional, acquisitive, or enterprise brokerage environments is preferred.
  • Ability to travel up to 15%.

jobs.excerpt: Sunrise,FL - USAPosition Requirements Location: Remote - nationally deployable; travel to assigned markets as required.
jobs.description:
Sunrise,FL - USA

Position Requirements

Location: Remote - nationally deployable; travel to assigned markets as required. This Market Region will cover Tennessee and Mississippi.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the cadence and accountability infrastructure that keeps NAPA client relationships healthy. Ensure that the right meetings are occurring on schedule, the right stakeholders are in the room, and that no relationship touchpoint falls through the cracks. Track and document all client engagement activity — chief meetings, administrator check-ins, joint reviews — and flag to the RVP when cadence slips or attendance patterns signal disengagement. Maintain timely, accurate records of all client interactions in the CRM. Proactively flag any issue, pattern, or signal that could lead to client dissatisfaction. Prepare materials and briefings that enable executive conversations to be high-quality and well-informed. The CSD will work in partnership with their Operations VP and Clinical VP to determine which relationships will be owned by whom and on what meeting cadence.

  • Serve as the first point of resolution for day-to-day operational issues in assigned markets, including staffing coverage gaps, payroll and scheduling inaccuracies, credentialing coordination, and compliance escalations. Drive accountability across shared services (RCM, HR, Talent Acquisition, Quality) to ensure timely, coordinated responses. Escalate to the RVP on issues determined to be outside of the decision scope.

  • Serve as a visible, accessible advocate for clinicians in assigned markets. Partner with Chiefs and Talent Acquisition on recruitment, onboarding, and credentialing. Monitor engagement signals and address concerns early. Participate in candidate interviewing and provide white-glove onboarding support. Track and address premium pay drivers, vacancy trends, and locum reliance as indicators of cultural or operational breakdown. Maintain knowledge of staffing models and flag model-level risks to the RVP.

  • Provide intentional capacity relief to Regional Vice Presidents by owning the operational and relational layer of account management. Prepare briefing materials, financial summaries, and client meeting prep; attend and support RVP-led strategic engagements as needed. Participate in FORC prep, monthly financial reviews, and other regional initiatives. Identify situations without resolution and bring structured recommendations — not just problem statements — to RVP attention.

  • Actively partner with the RVP to identify and develop expansion opportunities within assigned client accounts. This shall include developing strategic plans for where cross-credentialing should occur to enable more market-based clinical teams. The CSD’s on-the-ground presence and operational relationships make them a primary source of intelligence on client appetite for new service lines, ASC development, volume growth, or contract expansion. Surface these opportunities with specificity — context, timing, and the right internal contact. Maintain awareness of each market’s competitive dynamics and flag threats as well as opportunities. Serve as the connective tissue between field-level insight and NAPA’s RVPs and business development.

SCOPE & DEPLOYMENT MODEL

CSDs are nationally deployable and assigned to markets by need and strategic priority, not by physical proximity alone. A CSD may support multiple markets within a region or cross-region boundaries when RVP capacity and client risk warrant. Assignments are determined collaboratively with Regional SVP leadership and adjusted as portfolio conditions evolve.

Deployment principles:

  • Every client has an assigned, accountable partner with a preset meeting cadence with the executive decision makers for the relationship.

  • Travel cadence is defined by market need; CSDs are expected to achieve meaningful face time with clients and clinicians without being anchored to a single geography.

  • Remote-first work is the operating assumption; on-site presence is purposeful and planned, not incidental.

KEY INTERNAL RELATIONSHIPS

Vice President of Operations - Primary reporting relationship; CSD provides operational and relational capacity relief; escalates only issues requiring RVP authority.

Clinical Vice President - Dotted-line accountability; input on portfolio assignments, performance standards, and strategic priorities.

Chief Physicians / Chief CRNAs - Day-to-day operational partners; CSD supports chief effectiveness and surfaces leadership development needs.

APP Senior Director - Aligned on APP staffing models, performance trends, and practice integration.

Talent Acquisition / HR - Coordinated recruitment, credentialing, onboarding, and provider relations support.

RCM / Accounting - Monitor site-level billing performance; escalate compliance gaps and payer issues.

Client Success / Implementation Teams - Collaboration on new site stand-ups, HyperCare transitions, and escalated client satisfaction situations.

Centralized Scheduling Leadership - High-partnership relationship; CSD owns the effectiveness of every clinical schedule in their market, with shared accountability for delivering consistent operational standards across clients.

Centralized HR Leadership - High-partnership relationship; CSD routes all HR issues — provider relations, payroll concerns, onboarding, credentialing delays, personnel matters — through centralized HR leadership. Acts as the field-level connector and advocate, not the resolver. Timely and accurate escalation to HR is a core performance expectation.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, or a related field; MBA or equivalent preferred.

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in healthcare operations, account management, or clinical services administration, preferably within an anesthesia or physician practice management organization.

  • Demonstrated track record of managing complex client relationships and driving measurable retention or satisfaction outcomes.

  • Strong financial literacy: ability to read site-level P&Ls, identify performance variances, and communicate financial risk clearly.

  • Experience coordinating clinician recruitment, credentialing, and onboarding workflows in a multi-site healthcare environment.

  • Exceptional interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to build trust with clinicians, hospital administrators, and executive stakeholders.

  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently — expected 30–50% travel depending on market portfolio.

Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with clinical operations systems including scheduling platforms (Qgenda preferred), practice management tools (iPro preferred), and CRM platforms (Microsoft Dynamics preferred).

  • Experience supporting or leading new site implementations in a healthcare services environment.

  • Familiarity with various types of client contractual agreements.

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED

Client retention in assigned portfolio - No at-risk contracts escalate without early CSD involvement and documented action plan.

RVP capacity relief - RVPs report meaningful reduction in day-to-day operational interruptions from CSD-covered markets.

Issue resolution cycle time - Operational issues are closed at the CSD level; escalation rate to RVP is tracked and declining.

Locum and premium pay reduction - Month-over-month reduction in locum reliance and unplanned premium pay in assigned markets.

Clinician satisfaction / retention - Chiefs and clinicians in CSD-supported markets report accessible, responsive support.

Client relationship health - Regular cadenced client touchpoints are documented; no significant satisfaction deterioration goes unreported.

TOTAL REWARDS:

North American Partners in Anesthesia (NAPA) offers excellent salary, benefits and paid time off.

  • Generous benefits package, including:

    • Paid Time Off

    • Health, life, vision, dental, disability, and AD&D insurance

    • Flexible Spending Accounts/Health Savings Accounts

    • 401(k)

    • Leadership and professional development opportunities

The Clinical Services Director (CSD) is a senior field-facing role responsible for the operational and financial health, clinician experience, and client relationships across an assigned portfolio of NAPA markets. Operating without a geographic residency requirement, the CSD is deployed where need and opportunity are greatest — providing consistent, high-quality support to their markets and amplifying the capacity and effectiveness of their VP of Operations who carries ultimate portfolio accountability.

The CSD role has full P&L ownership for their market and serves as the trusted, accountable partner to both NAPA clients and the clinicians who serve them. This is an intentionally matrixed role. The CSD works within the dyad clinical and operational leadership of their region, and is also expected to work through centralized service delivery leadership to achieve great outcomes. They consistently model the kind of cross-functional partnering that produces repeatable, high-quality output across every market they support.

EEO Statement

North American Partners in Anesthesia is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.description:
Location:Remote

Reports to:Indiana Bureau Chief, Chalkbeat

Type:Full-time

Salary Range:$65,000 to $80,000, depending on location and experience

Civic News Companyis leading a civic revival.

We were founded to address one of the most consequential market failures of our time: the collapse of local news. Since 2008, nearly two-thirds of U.S. newsroom jobs have disappeared, leaving communities without trusted reporting on education, elections, and public health. Our mission is simple and urgent: to help people understand how America works so they can make it work better.

ThroughChalkbeat(education),Votebeat(elections), andHealthbeat(public health), we operate a national network of local news bureaus that combine deep local expertise with centralized national infrastructure.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Civic News is seeking aReporterto cover schools and education policy as part of the Chalkbeat Indiana team.

This is a critical moment to report about education in Indianapolis. How the city’s schools are run and governed is going through a radical transformation, with shifting power dynamics and uncertainty over how it will play out in the city’s district-run and charter schools. Changes to how school performance is measured, decisions about students’transportation to and from school, and charged debates about school closures all loom on the horizon.

You will tell these stories, hold leaders accountable, and put the news into context for students and families.Your work will help families and leaders make decisions for stronger public understanding of the institutions and decisions that shape students' lives. You’ll also be a member of a team covering education across Indiana, including how high schools prepare students for college and career, and what access families have to vouchers and online schools.

Capturing this story requires strong beat reporting, source development, relationship-building, and writing skills. You should enjoy a fast-paced and newsy environment and be comfortable as one of Chalkbeat’s public faces in the community and representing the organization at public events and on social media. This role includes night meeting coverage as well as the occasional evening event.

The key responsibilities for this role include:

  • Report and write compelling local education stories, balancing quick-turn news coverage with enterprise and accountability journalism.

  • Develop and execute longer-term reporting projects that deepen readers’ understanding of local education issues.

  • Serve as a trusted guide for readers by clearly explaining how education systems, policies, and decisions affect local communities.

  • Hold public officials and institutions accountable through rigorous, fair, and well-sourced reporting.

  • Engage with readers and community members to identify relevant stories, questions, and areas of interest.

  • Collaborate with colleagues across Chalkbeat and with external news partners on reporting and special projects, including TV, radio and panel appearances.

  • Build and maintain relationships with a broad range of sources, including educators, education leaders, parents, students, and community members.

  • Report stories that make an impact in the community and drive change.

What background and skills do you have? (We know not all strong candidates will have all the skills we list. That’s OK. What else do you bring to the table? Please tell us!): The person we seek:

  • 3+ years of experience in journalism.

  • Excellent news judgment.

  • Breaking news metabolism and decisiveness.

  • Ability to produce ambitious, agenda-setting enterprise journalism.

  • Strong interpersonal skills, demonstrating empathy and understanding while being unafraid to have tough conversations when needed.

  • Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion.

  • Passion for education and Chalkbeat’s mission is a must; knowledge of education is a strong plus, but not required.

Bonus points if you’ve got:

  • Connections to Indianapolis.

  • Data journalism experience.

  • Photo and social video skills.

  • Fluency in a language other than English, especially Spanish.

Civic NewsValues, here’s how that shows up in our work together:

  • We work as one team.

    Rebuilding local news requires collaboration. We actively nurture a harmonious environment of dignity, respect, and professionalism. We assume good intent, support one another’s growth, and have a team-oriented approach to solving problems together.

  • We pursue truth with intellectual honesty.
    Our work demands rigor. We seek facts, challenge assumptions, and engage thoughtfully with perspectives different from our own. We follow the evidence wherever it leads.

  • We practice inclusive journalism.

    Strong civic life depends on representation and trust. We commit to antiracism, equity, and inclusive practices. We build meaningful relationships with the communities we serve and reflect their realities in our reporting.

  • We earn trust every day.

    We develop subject-matter expertise. We operate transparently. We take responsibility for our work and keep learning so our journalism remains credible, relevant, and strong.

This full-time, remote-eligible position is based in the Indianapolis area. Civic News Company already has a presence: Chicago, Colorado, Indianapolis, Newark, Pennsylvania, Arizona, Texas, Michigan, Tennessee, New York City, and Washington, D.C.

The salary range is $65,000 to $80,000; final salary will be determined based on level of experience and geographic location, with a generous benefits package, including:

  • Medical, vision, and dental insurance

  • Time off that truly supports rest, including 20 days of PTO, a paid one-week recess, 5 sick days, 3 floating holidays, and 12 paid holidays in 2026

  • Retirement support through a 401(k) with a 4% employer match that is immediately vested

  • 100% paid parental leave: 18 weeks fully paid, plus a 2-week part-time return-to-work ramp-up

  • Flexible Spending Plan for eligible medical or childcare expenses

  • Annual professional development stipend

  • Employer-provided life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage

  • Monthly reimbursement for cell phone and internet expenses

Civic News Company recognizes a staff bargaining unit, Civic News Company, affiliated with the Writers Guild of America, East,a labor union representing thousands of members who write content for news and online media, motion pictures, and television.This position is included in the Civic News Company bargaining unit.

Physical Requirements of the Job

This role is primarily sedentary and involves extended periods of sitting and regular use of standard office equipment, including computers and phones, for up to 8 hours per day. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Civic News Company Commitment

Civic News Company is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive organization. We believe restoring civic trust requires a plurality of voices, backgrounds, and experiences. Civic News Company is committed to equal employment opportunities and welcomes applicants and employees from diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to races, colors, national origins, ancestries, creeds, religions, genders, ages, disabilities, veteran status, sexual orientations, and marital statuses. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply and contribute to our shared vision.

Civic News Company participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, Civic News Company is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before Civic News Company can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. jobs.excerpt: Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.
jobs.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset.

We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.

Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

At Sleek, we are on a mission to streamline operations and elevate customer experience through intelligent automation and modern engineering.

About the Role:

We are looking for a sharp, commercially-minded, and execution-oriented Product Manager to own the growth trajectory of our two core emerging products: the Sleek Business Account (SBA)—a licensed, fledgling digital business account in Singapore and our new proprietary In-House Payroll Solution

This is a senior-level, highly autonomous, hands-on builder role. You will not have a dedicated marketing department; you will own the product strategy, project management, and go-to-market execution from top to bottom. If you have deep neo- banking roots, love driving organic growth loops, and thrive in lean, rapid-deployment environments, this role is built for you.

Mission of the Role

To aggressively scale revenue for the SBA and Payroll products by driving rapid customer adoption, expanding AUM for SBA, and increasing the volume of active employees utilizing the Payroll system.

Key Outcomes (First 6–12 Months)

  • Accelerate customer adoption rates for both SBA and Payroll.
  • Significantly expand the AUM of the SBA and grow the total number of employees onboarded to the Payroll software.
  • Directly increase Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) through strategic product monetization,such as value-added foreign exchange (FX) transactions.
  • Successfully navigate ambiguities to deliver product commitments on time, partnering intimately with key stakeholders and a dedicated engineering squad.

Requirements

Must-Have Experience

  • 5 to 10 Years in Product Manager Roles: Proven track record of robust, hands-on product management within a Neobank, Digital Bank, or high-growth Fintech environment.
  • 0-to-1 Product Delivery: Demonstrated success taking tech products from ideation to launch and scaling them as an individual contributor.
  • Commercial & Growth Competency: Experience driving user adoption, managing legacy data migrations, and optimizing commercial metrics like Assets Under Management (AUM) and FX/transaction revenues
  • AI & Tech Literacy: Fluent with AI applications and structurally familiar with AI evaluations (evals) to drive automated feature development alongside engineering.
  • Analytical Problem Solving: Exceptional skill in working backwards from aggressive growth targets using structured, data-driven frameworks.

Must-Have Attributes

  • Extreme Ownership & High Agency: A self-starter who operates autonomously, moves fast under heavy ambiguity, and takes absolute accountability for outcomes.
  • Commercial Mindset & Customer Empathy: Deeply understands user pain points while simultaneously thinking strategically about monetization and business growth.
  • The "Builder" Mentality: Combines high-level product vision with a grounded, humble approach to doing the tactical, ground-level execution yourself.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Ability to handle both product strategy and hands-on Go-To-Market (GTM) execution without dedicated marketing support.
  • Collaborative Diplomat: A low-ego communicator who builds trust, bridges engineering and commercial teams, and aligns leadership to drive consensus.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you’re more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

Attention to detail: You’ll be managing multiple, complex workstreams from numerous stakeholders. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing or inconsistent.

Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn’t their first language. For you to excel, you’ll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

About the interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages (note that the order might be different to what you read below).

We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish. Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.

A ~30 minute chat with our Talent Acquisition team to learn more about you, your background, and what you’re looking for.
A ~60 minute technical interview with the Product Team
A ~60 minute AI skills interview with the AI Lead.

A final interview with our CRO, giving you the opportunity to ask any final questions and hear more about our vision and priorities.

Reference verification
Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.

This may include using external vendors to verify the below:

- Your education

- Any criminal history

- Any political exposure

- Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: The role will be fully remote, with work from home five days a week However, if you are based in Singapore, the role will follow a hybrid model. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

JOB SUMMARY

One More Child is seeking to employ a full-time Data Analyst to support its mission of impacting vulnerable children and struggling families through the collection, integration, analysis, forecasting, and visualization of organizational data. This position will be responsible for analyzing data from multiple sources, developing semantic data models, identifying trends and opportunities, conducting predictive analysis, and delivering interactive Power BI dashboards that translate data into meaningful business insights. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, advanced Microsoft Fabric and Power BI expertise, and the ability to communicate complex data findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Position: PDF Annotation & Transcription Experts – Bengali

Role Responsibilities

  • Source documents: find a publicly accessible Bengali PDF in an assigned document type, containing at least one multimodal element (images, tables, diagrams, or handwriting), and record where you obtained it.
  • Annotate structure: identify and bound every meaningful region of the page - document title, section heading, paragraph, list, table, figure, diagram, caption, formula, question, answer field - and assign each a component type and a reading-order index.
  • Record relationships: link each region to the figure or table it belongs to through a parent component identifier.
  • Transcribe faithfully: reproduce all text exactly as it appears in Bengali script, including handwritten content, flagging any region where the source is not legible.

  • Native Bengali speaker with full command of the script, its diacritics, and its conjunct forms.
  • Experience with documents: annotation, transcription, translation, localization, subtitling, proofreading, journalism, or regional-language data review.
  • Exact character-level accuracy; a single wrong diacritic is a defect.
  • Systematic application of a taxonomy across hundreds of pages.

jobs.title: Technical Co-founder (CTO) - AI for Automotive Retail
jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityEvery used-car dealer's profit is made or lost the moment they buy the car — not when they sell it.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Every used-car dealer's profit is made or lost the moment they buy the car — not when they sell it. That decision runs on gut feel, spreadsheets, and whoever has a spare hour, inside a $500B+ industry that hasn't meaningfully modernized how it buys. We think that's an AI-native category waiting to be built, and we're going first.

The problem and solution are validated with a domain co-founder who lives this daily and has already hand

The Venture

Atrium is an always-on AI workforce, not a dashboard — agents that watch, learn, and earn the right to act on their own, deployed inside dealer groups' existing workflows. The same decision logic has to show up everywhere the work already happens — web, desktop, our own browser, mobile — so the workforce follows the person, not the other way around. One brain, every surface.

This isn't a weekend's worth of CRUD. Think dozens of specialist agents organized into a handful of coordinated workflows, sharing one memory, each one earning the right to act on its own track record — across four surfaces at once. If that sounds like a fun problem rather than a scary one, keep reading.

A real technical moat if built right, and a wide-open field — no dominant AI-native player has claimed this category yet. Specifics on the product, the model, and where we stand commercially are best shared in conversation; we're early and staying deliberately quiet in the market.

The Partnership

CEO and domain co-founder are in place; the problem is validated. We're looking for a technical co-founder to own product and engineering from the first commit — full authority, founder equity, a real seat at the table on every major call.

This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will take over the production code and continue building the product (the first lines of production code), set the technical direction, and lead execution end-to-end.

  • Own the core architecture decision that shapes everything else — how the agents actually see and act in a dealer's world, and how one system stays coherent across a web app, a desktop app, our own browser, and mobile, without four separate products drifting apart
  • Design the autonomy model: how an agent earns the right to act alone, and how that trust is never assumed
  • Build the integration layer into a data ecosystem that won't always cooperate
  • Build partnerships with ecosystem data providers and third-party systems to land unconventional integrations no standard API gets you
  • Own unit economics as an architecture problem, not an afterthought — this many agents, across this many surfaces, has to add up
  • Own the design and layering of the system for the dev team, and keep the build matched to what the business and sales side actually need
  • Be the technical voice with dealers, design partners, and investors
  • Hire and lead the founding engineering team

Co-Founder Profile

Must Have:

  • Has shipped agentic or LLM systems into production where being wrong actually costs something
  • Has shipped desktop and mobile apps connected to a larger web platform — comfortable with one product living across multiple facets and surfaces, not just a single app
  • Has shipped LLM-based products, but also worked with SLMs and SLM fine-tuning
  • Has dealt with the real nuances of web scraping — anti-bot defences, rate limits, brittle DOMs, the gap between "works in a demo" and "works at scale against a site that doesn't want you there"
  • Has built complex, modelled data graph layers for intelligence — not just a data pipeline, but a structure that reasoning can actually run on
  • Comfortable owning infra, data, and product alone — then hiring past yourself
  • Treats guardrails and reversibility as core product, not overhead
  • Good to have: edge computing and power-constrained systems, high-frequency distributed computing infrastructure

Great to Have:

  • Experience building against locked-down or adversarial third-party data
  • Vertical/operational domain grit (Automotive)
  • Pragmatic and creative — a solution finder who gets to "working" fast and iterates from there
  • Co-operative, strategic, and hands-on in equal measure

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

This role sits at the intersection of content, technology, and execution. You’ll lead a talented team responsible for email design and production, internal communications, CRM campaign execution, marketing automation, campaign optimization, and the processes that keep it all moving.

You’ll be equal parts people leader, problem solver, and champion of great work. You know how to build high-performing teams, create smart and scalable processes, use data to improve results, and turn a steady stream of requests into thoughtful, effective campaigns.

We’re looking for someone who can see the big picture without losing sight of the details and that there’s always something to test, learn, optimize, or make better.
