  • Measure what matters. Oversee campaign reporting and performance, identifyopportunities and translate insights into action through testing, optimization, and continuous improvement.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Technology, Compliance, and other stakeholders to translate business needs into effective marketing solutions.

  • Champion data quality and thoughtful data management, ensuring campaigns use the right audiences, segmentation, logic, and information.

  • Create and maintain standards and best practices for CRM execution, automation, testing, quality assurance, documentation, and campaign governance.

  • Stay curious. Keep an eye on emerging CRM, lifecycle marketing, automation, personalization, and AI capabilities and identify practical ways to make the teamand our marketingbetter.

  • Be awesome to work with. Bring a collaborative mindset, a solutions-oriented approach, and the ability to make complex work feel manageable.

Qualifications & Skills

We’re interested in great marketers and great leaders, not just candidates who check every box. If much of the following sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of experience leading and developing high-performing teams, ideally within lifecycle marketing, CRM, email marketing, or a related discipline.

  • A proven track record of delivering measurable results and improving marketing performance.

  • Deep knowledge of CRM and marketing automation platforms; Total Expert experience highly preferred.

  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation, campaign development, audience segmentation, and customer journeys.

  • A results-oriented mindset with the ability to turn campaign performance and data into clear recommendations and action.

  • Strong understanding of email marketing best practices, including design, testing, personalization, deliverability, measurement, and optimization.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical partners.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail, particularly when managing complex campaigns, workflows, and segments.

  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives in a fast-moving environment.

  • A collaborative leadership style and the ability to build strong relationships across teams and functions.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and comfort learning and adopting new technologies.

  • Familiarity with mortgage industry workflows, terminology, and compliance standards is a plus, but not required.

  • A proactive, curious mindset—you’re willing to learn, challenge the status quo, and look for a better way to get things done.

What Success Looks Like

You build a team that people trust and want to work with. Campaigns launch accurately and on time. Our automation gets smarter. Our processes get easier. Performance improves because we’re constantly learning from what we do.

And when someone comes to the team with a great idea, your first instinct is to figure out how we can make it happenand make it work even better.

jobs.title: Assistenz der Geschäftsführung / Executive Assistant (w/m/d)
jobs.excerpt: welche aufgaben warten auf dich?  Deine MissionDu behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn für andere längst das Chaos beginnt?
jobs.description:
welche aufgaben warten auf dich?

Deine Mission

Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn für andere längst das Chaos beginnt? Dann suchen wir dich! Als Assistenz der Geschäftsführung sorgst du dafür, dass sich unsere Geschäftsleitung auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren kann, weil im Hintergrund alles läuft: Organisation, Korrespondenz, Termine, Verträge und die vielen kleinen Alltagsthemen drumherum. Kurzum: Du bist die Person, die unserer Geschäftsleitung den Rücken frei hält.

Deine Aufgaben

Organisation & Tagesgeschäft

  • Du übernimmst die tägliche organisatorische und administrative Unterstützung unserer Geschäftsführung: Von der Strukturierung des Tagesablaufs bis zu den vielen kleinen Themen, die dazwischen auftauchen und trotzdem nicht liegen bleiben dürfen.

  • Du behältst offene To-dos im Blick: Du hakst proaktiv nach und sorgst dafür, dass Zusagen und Deadlines eingehalten werden, ohne dass dich jemand extra daran erinnern muss.

  • Du bereitest Termine inhaltlich und organisatorisch vor und nach: Du stellst relevante Unterlagen zusammen, hältst Ergebnisse und nächste Schritte fest und sorgst dafür, dass aus einem Gespräch auch tatsächlich Handlung wird.

Korrespondenz, kaufmännische & rechtliche Themen

  • Du übernimmst die Bearbeitung und Organisation von Postfächern und Korrespondenz: Du sortierst, priorisierst und beantwortest eigenständig, was du eigenständig beantworten kannst und bereitest den Rest entscheidungsreif auf.

  • Du unterstützt bei buchhalterischen Prozessen: Du unterstützt z.B. beim Prüfen und Zuordnen von Belegen oder der Vorbereitung für die Buchhaltung.

  • Du unterstützt bei rechtlichen und vertraglichen Themen: Du prüfst Verträge, erstellst Vorlagen und recherchierst rechtliche Fragestellungen. Du hältst Fristen nach und sorgst dafür, dass nichts durchs Raster fällt.

Kommunikation & Dokumentation

  • Du koordinierst und kommunizierst mit internen und externen Ansprechpartner:innen: Du agierst oft als erste Kontaktperson und behältst dabei die Prioritäten der Geschäftsleitung und des Unternehmens im Blick.

  • Du erstellst Dokumente, Auswertungen und Präsentationen: Du weißt, welche Inhalte überzeugen und direkt verwendet werden können, ohne dass noch groß nachgearbeitet werden muss.

was bringst du mit?

  • Du hast Vorerfahrung in der Assistenz der Geschäftsführung bzw. Executive Assistance

  • Du hast einen sicheren Umgang mit allgemeinen kaufmännischen und administrativen Prozessen

  • Du besitzt grundlegende Kenntnisse in buchhalterischen Themen

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Verträgen, rechtlichen Unterlagen und Fristen

  • Du besitzt ein hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein sowie ein Höchstmaß an organisatorischen Fähigkeiten

  • Du hast eine sehr strukturierte, zuverlässige und eigenständige Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Diskretion

Bevor du dich bewirbst: drei kleine Aufgaben, die uns mehr über deine Denkweise verrät als jeder Lebenslauf:

  1. Die Geschäftsführung ist unterwegs und nicht erreichbar. Zwei wichtige Termine kollidieren plötzlich, beide Ansprechpartner bestehen auf dem ursprünglichen Termin. Wie triffst du die Entscheidung, wen du verschiebst, und wie kommunizierst du das?

  2. Die Geschäftsführung gibt dir kurz vor einem langen Termin eine knappe, unklare Anweisung zu einem wichtigen Thema und ist danach für Stunden nicht erreichbar. Wie gehst du vor, wenn du nicht sicher bist, was genau gemeint war?

  3. Du hast einen vollen Tag mit Deadlines geplant, als die Geschäftsführung dir spontan drei neue, unterschiedlich dringende Aufgaben gibt. Wie strukturierst du deinen Tag neu?

was bieten wir dir?

  • Du besetzt eine vertrauensvolle Schlüsselrolle direkt an der Seite der Geschäftsleitung mit viel Verantwortung

  • Teilzeit oder Vollzeit möglich – wir finden gemeinsam das passende Modell

  • Das Arbeiten in einem Team mit flachen Hierarchien, kurzen Kommunikationswegen und schnellen Entscheidungen

  • 100% Remote-Arbeit: Arbeite da, wo du dich am wohlsten fühlst mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten

  • Du hast stets andere Tierliebhaber um dich und freust dich am Monatsende über eine leistungsgerechte Entlohnung

  • Preisnachlässe auf unsere Produkte, Vermögenswirksame Leistungen und Team-Events sind ebenfalls Bestandteil unseres Angebots an dich

We believe the future of travel should be seamless and powered by technology that delights customers at every step. To make this vision real, we're looking for exceptional, mission-driven people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel.

More than 30,000 companies already rely on Engine to support over 1 million travelers and billions in annual bookings each year. This isn't a traditional channel sales role. As a Partner Acquisition Lead, Transportation, you will lead the development and acquisition of partnerships across fleet payments, transportation management systems (TMS), telematics, and fuel networks — building on our existing relationships with partners like WEX and Trimble to reach hundreds of thousands of fleets, owner-operators, and professional drivers who book lodging on the road every night. This includes the number and opportunity size of active partner opportunities in the pipeline, number of signed partners, and revenue generated from newly signed partners.

jobs.title: Open Call - Soil Carbon Field Tech (Contract - Central US based)
jobs.excerpt: Overview Yard Stick is looking for a number of Soil Carbon Field Technicians to help us fight climate change with soil.
jobs.description:
Overview
Yard Stick is looking for a number of Soil Carbon Field Technicians to help us fight climate change with soil. This role is an essential part of Yard Stick’s primary on-the-ground operations, deploying our novel soil carbon measurement technology as well as traditional soil testing methodology on fields across the US. This is a contracted seasonal/part-time 1099 position. We are a small company with big ambitions, and therefore we need people who are highly entrepreneurial, reliable, comfortable with travel, and committed to working towards solving climate change.
Location flexible, and significant cross-country travel is required. Hourly pay (including pay for time spent travel), and travel expenses will be paid for.
About Yard Stick PBC
Yard Stick is a remote-first, seed-stage company, with founders based in Boston and Oakland. We are on a mission to reverse climate change with agriculture. Scientists and farmers alike know that climate-friendly agricultural practices have the potential to remove atmospheric CO2 at gigaton/year scale. When these practices are adopted, more carbon is stored in soils, improving soil health and fighting climate change. But significant measurement challenges have held soil carbon efforts back - until now.
By reducing the cost of soil carbon measurement by 90%+, Yard Stick will dramatically expand the opportunities for evidence-based regenerative practices to simultaneously improve ecosystem health, increase farmer income, and combat climate change.
Current soil carbon measurement technologies are slow, expensive, and cumbersome, relying on conventional soil cores and labs to quantify carbon stocks. In contrast, Yard Stick is fast and cheap - without sacrificing accuracy. As a testament to our technology’s potential, alongside our scientific collaborators, we were awarded a $3.6M grant from the DOE ARPA-E Smartfarm as well as other highly competitive grant programs which reward technical merit like NSF SBIR. For more background, check out some coverage in TechCrunch or Treehugger.
We've also raised money from top climate VCs, including Breakthrough Energy Ventures (Bill Gates' climate fund), Lowercarbon Capital (Chris and Crystal Sacca's climate fund), MCJ Collective, and others. Details of the financing aren’t announced in a press release or article, because that can feel a bit cart before the horse, but we're happy to share more detail about our funding when we chat.
About The Role
This Soil Carbon Tech role is critical to the success and rollout of Yard Stick’s offerings and works in-field across the country and a variety of project types to meet our R+D and client goals. The Yard Stick team and our client base is spread across the country, but our current focus is primarily in the Midwest. We’re growing quickly, and this position will be an essential role with significant responsibility.
You will be primarily responsible for testing our hardware and software in fields across the US to help us evaluate and improve our technology’s accuracy, durability, and usability. You will be leading projects geared towards calibrating our technology, as well as collecting measurements to quantify stocks on client lands using a variety of different methodologies.
You’ll provide feedback on hardware and software tools alike, as Yard Stick has innovative offerings in both domains. Obviously, when stuff breaks, you’ll document why and help us brainstorm ways to improve.
Yard Stick’s offerings combine a large number of disparate disciplines, including highly technical hardware, a web app which manages carbon measurement and GIS data, and ML pipelines which connect the two. This person ultimately will work cross-disciplinarily along with our hardware, software, soil science, and business teams alike to maximize the pace of Yard Stick’s R&D and therefore climate impact, so the ability to communicate clearly to a wide range of people is a must.
We need someone who can handle rigorous field work with efficiency and exceptional precision. The ideal candidate for this role is comfortable traveling, working outdoors, handling a wide array of equipment, and working in a team off 2-6 people through projects that can include rapid schedule changes, long days, and inclement weather.
Currently, Yard Stick is focused on proof of concept of our in situ spectral probe. Generating high-quality, publishable data requires excellent field operations. In parallel, we’re also creating our commercial offerings. This role will be crucial in carrying out both streams of work.

Qualifications - Must Have

  • Some combination of education and/or experience in natural sciences, agriculture, conservation, soil science, natural resource management or another related field of study. We don’t require formal education, but one way or another, you have the experience that’ll make you comfortable on farms and around producers, and are no stranger to having your hands in the dirt.
  • Extensive experience and comfort with physical field work. Experience working with your hands out in the field is key to this role. You don’t flinch at the idea of 8 hours in the sun moving from customer farm to farm, sometimes for two weeks straight.
  • Comfort with field tools, technologies and strategies. Our offerings use technologies like GPS, ATVs, and mobile app-based sample inventory tracking systems. You can drive an ATV, or you’re not afraid to learn. You use mechanical tools comfortably. Note: Yard Stick will provide a vehicle if you don’t have one for this role, or will generously reimburse if you do.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to craft. When you take a 30 cm soil core, it’s 30 cm. You care deeply about the details. You take written instructions well, triple-check your work by nature, and will follow an SOP to the letter. You are proud to do your work very well.
  • Strong personal independence and entrepreneurial autonomy. If you can’t get your boss on the phone, you figure it out. You assess the situation, consider solutions, make a plan, and execute, even if your closest coworker is 100 miles away.
  • Comfort with extended travel. Projects can often be in remote areas of the country -- spending a week or two at a time away from home is essential to this role.
  • Personal enthusiasm and comfort in agricultural contexts. You care about farming or ranching. The idea of helping activate agriculture to fight against climate change excites you. It matters to you that you’re working on a problem of existential significance.
  • Ability to share product feedback to improve systems. When you’re asked for feedback, you pay attention and communicate observations clearly, especially in writing. You document things carefully and are curious when using new products or technologies.
  • Existing permanent authorization to work in the United States.

Qualifications - Nice To Have

  • Personal, durable enthusiasm for the challenge of climate change.
  • Awareness of current issues in carbon markets - particularly carbon removal. You’ve heard of offsets/credits and some of the attendant criticism of low-quality projects of the past and present. You’ve got some basic knowledge about how carbon markets work, and you’ve heard about how carbon removal is a new, exciting, and controversial approach to climate challenges.
  • There will be a significant portion of the year that we’re not sampling, and we’re interested in other skills you can bring to the team! Specifically if you have any of the following, we’d love to hear about it: GIS or other mapping software; vehicle and equipment maintenance; equipment + logistics management; agricultural sales or similar; agronomy; data science, etc.

Compensation and Other Details

  • $30-40/hr to start, with travel expenses (including time) paid. Performance raise after a set number of projects have been completed.
  • Remote first, Midwest/Plains preferred (NE/KS/CO/IA)
Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
Yard Stick’s impact goals go well beyond climate science (although our #1 core value is Climate Impact). Why? Our company operates primarily in the US agricultural sector, which is predicated on centuries of mass land theft and disenfranchisement of Native and Black people. This harm continues today. If we’re going to work in this sector, we need to actively work to make it better.
Consistent with our core value of “Pursue Justice,” we speak up about these issues, and we support emerging solutions and relevant policy efforts such as and . We also publicly highlight the risk of further racial discrimination in emerging agricultural legislation like the Growing Climate Solutions Act.
Regarding hiring and culture, we work to create a work environment where everyone feels confident sharing their ideas, problem-solving happens openly and collaboratively, and mistake-making is welcomed. We also standardize our interview process and questions to reduce “likeability” bias, benchmark salaries against industry databases to reduce negotiation, and utilize tools like the Gender Decoder (this one is feminine-coded, fwiw). Climate change is arguably the most complex challenge ever faced by humanity - we need all of humanity activated to fight back, and that motivates us to build a diverse team.

The role covers VPC/VNet design, hybrid connectivity, transit topologies, edge networking, DNS, and the security controls that make cloud networking reliable and safe at scale. The ideal candidate combines deep traditional networking knowledge with cloud-native networking patterns, has built production cloud networks at meaningful scale, and brings strong automation discipline to networking work. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect edge networking including CDN, global load balancing, and WAF integration.
  • Implement DNS strategies including Route 53, Azure DNS, or Cloud DNS with hybrid resolution.
  • Design private connectivity to managed services using PrivateLink, Private Endpoints, or Private Service Connect.
  • Automate cloud networking with Terraform, providing infrastructure-as-code coverage across the network estate.
  • Implement network security controls including firewalls, NACLs, security groups, and DDoS protection.
  • Operate Kubernetes networking including CNI selection, ingress strategies, and service exposure patterns.
  • Build observability for cloud networking including flow logs, traffic insights, and packet capture.
  • Drive cost optimization including data transfer reduction and right-sizing of network resources.
  • Partner with security teams to harden the network perimeter and enforce zero-trust principles.
  • Troubleshoot complex cloud networking issues across cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Stay current with cloud networking platform updates and emerging patterns.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Networking, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of experience in networking, with significant time on cloud networking.
  • Deep hands-on experience with networking on at least one major cloud provider.
  • Strong understanding of routing, switching, BGP, and modern networking fundamentals.
  • Hands-on experience with hybrid connectivity (Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, or equivalents).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code for cloud networking, especially Terraform.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security and network controls.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes networking and service mesh fundamentals.
  • Strong troubleshooting and packet-level analysis skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Responsible for providing leadership and strategic direction for the Commercial Surety business, driving underwriting excellence, profitable growth, portfolio performance, and market competitiveness. Serves as the senior underwriting executive accountable for establishing and executing underwriting strategy, risk appetite, product direction, and distribution objectives across the business. Leads a geographically dispersed team of underwriting leaders and directs the development of talent, succession strategies, and organizational capabilities to ensure long-term business success.

Oversees portfolio management, underwriting governance, capacity deployment, and emerging risk assessment to optimize profitability, growth, and operational effectiveness. Maintains key relationships with distribution partners, reinsurance stakeholders, and industry leaders while ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements, underwriting standards, and enterprise risk management practices. Acts as the principal subject matter expert and strategic advisor for the Commercial Surety business, influencing business outcomes through data-driven decision-making, market insight, and disciplined underwriting execution.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Business Leadership & Distribution Management

  • Provides executive leadership for the Commercial Surety line of business, establishing and executing long-term strategies that drive profitable growth, market expansion, and sustainable competitive advantage.

  • Leads a team of Home Office and Regional Directors, creating alignment between underwriting, distribution, and business objectives across the operating territory.

  • Develops and maintains executive-level relationships with key agencies, brokers, producers, and industry stakeholders, influencing distribution strategy and optimizing market presence.

  • Directs agency and broker appointment strategies, ensuring alignment with growth objectives, risk appetite, and profitability goals.

Underwriting Strategy, Portfolio Management & Risk Governance

  • Establishes and maintains underwriting philosophy, risk appetite, authority structures, guidelines, and governance frameworks for the Commercial Surety portfolio.

  • Serves as the senior underwriting authority and principal subject matter expert, ensuring consistent underwriting discipline and portfolio management practices across the organization.

  • Oversees portfolio performance, capacity utilization, emerging risk assessment, and underwriting results to achieve profitability and growth objectives.

  • Collaborates with internal business partners on underwriting audits, quality assurance processes, and compliance activities to ensure adherence to underwriting standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Engages with reinsurance partners and executive stakeholders to communicate portfolio performance, strategic initiatives, and risk management outcomes.

Financial Performance & Product Management

  • Accountable for achieving financial objectives for the Commercial Surety business, including premium growth, profitability, retention, and expense management targets.

  • Oversees pricing strategy, risk selection practices, and portfolio optimization efforts to maximize underwriting performance and return on capital.

  • Maintains full management accountability for performance management, compensation decisions, employee engagement, and workforce effectiveness.

  • Develops future underwriting leaders and strengthens organizational bench strength to support long-term business objectives.

Operational Excellence & Business Transformation

  • Provides executive sponsorship and strategic direction for underwriting technology, workflow optimization, and business transformation initiatives.

  • Partners with technology, analytics, and operations leaders to enhance underwriting platforms, predictive modeling capabilities, and portfolio management tools.

  • Drives continuous improvement efforts that improve underwriting efficiency, decision quality, scalability, and customer experience while supporting enterprise objectives.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Experience managing large accounts, complex surety programs, and significant underwriting authority. Demonstrated success leading geographically dispersed underwriting teams and developing underwriting leaders. Experience working with brokers, agents, producers, and key distribution partners. jobs.excerpt: Lead Ember's Southeast Asia team into its next chapter, shaping the vision, strategy and delivery of our policy work across one of the quickly emerging regions in the clean energy transition.
jobs.description:
Lead Ember's Southeast Asia team into its next chapter, shaping the vision, strategy and delivery of our policy work across one of the quickly emerging regions in the clean energy transition.

The Role

Ember is recruiting a Southeast Asia Regional Lead to build on our established, successful team - deepening our influence with regional policymakers and ensuring our analysis lands where decisions are made. You will set the vision, strategy and delivery of our policy programme across the region, leading a team of analysts and researchers, working within Ember’s organisational strategy and the quality standards set by the team director.

You will shape Ember’s strategy for the region, ensure high-quality delivery of the team's outputs and champion Ember's work directly with Southeast Asian policymakers, funders and media. You will also collaborate with our Comms and Data teams to collectively ensure our work lands with real reach and impact.In your first months, you'll work with the Deputy CEO through a defined process to shape how work and roles are organised within the team

This role reports to the Deputy CEO on an interim basis and will report to the team director once that role is in place. You will lead a team with direct line management of up to 4 staff. The team's internal structure is expected to evolve, and you'll play a central role in shaping it during your first months, with support from the Deputy CEO.

About Ember

Ember is an independent, not-for-profit energy think tank that aims to accelerate the clean energy transition with data and policy. We gather, curate and analyse data on the power sector and coal mine methane emissions, and use our findings to improve energy and climate policy.

See our work at and

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and drive Southeast Asia's programme strategy, translating Ember's overall direction into a compelling plan for the region, agreed with the team director.
  • Own delivery of the team's outputs, ensuring high-quality, timely work in line with regional priorities and funder KPIs, acting as the point of quality sign-off for regional outputs within standards agreed across regions
  • Champion and represent the team's work externally with Southeast Asian policymakers, media and partners
  • Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with Ember's network partners across Southeast Asia, positioning Ember as a reliable, collaborative partner in the region
  • Support funder relationships and grant reporting for the team, working with senior leadership on new fundraising opportunities with fundraising strategy and budget planning led by the team director, with the CEO and Deputy CEO.
  • Mentor and develop the Southeast Asia team, giving clear direction, setting objectives and supporting their growth
  • Co-create a close, day-to-day working relationship with Comms and Data team colleagues, so the three function as one delivery team
  • Coordinate with other Regional Leads to share learnings and align on cross-cutting issues

Location - Remote, based in Southeast Asia. Must have the right to work in your country of residence and be able to attend periodic in-person team meet-ups.

Requirements

Must have

  • Significant experience in a policy, research, or programme leadership role in Southeast Asia, with a track record of setting direction and delivering outputs that lead to real policy impact
  • Solid technical understanding of clean energy transition issues relevant to Southeast Asian countries and experience of influencing the clean energy narrative
  • Line management experience, including managing experienced staff and a track record of developing others with evidence of readiness to grow into managing managers, for example through leading senior colleagues, deputising, or coordinating work across multiple workstreams
  • Confidence representing an organisation's work internally, and externally with policymakers, media and funders
  • A track record of making sound decisions within their remit without needing constant consensus
  • Strong relationships with, or a credible path to building relationships with, Asian funders, policymakers, and media
  • Experience managing distributed or remote teams

Nice to have

  • Existing network of Southeast Asian policymakers, funders, and media contacts
  • Fundraising or grant management experience
  • Experience helping shape or restructure a growing team

We are an equal opportunities employer committed to diversity and treating all employees with dignity and respect regardless of background.

Salary: £54,880 per year, based on our standard local cost-of-living adjustment. The salary may be adjusted upwards for candidates based in higher cost-of-living locations in Asia; the applicable salary will be confirmed based on the candidate's location.

Contract: Full time (but only working 9 days every fortnight with no reduction in pay).

Location: Remote, based in Southeast Asia. Must have the right to work in your country of residence and be able to attend periodic in-person team meet-ups.

Further benefits: We offer a competitive benefits package, including:

  • We operate a nine-day fortnight meaning our full-time staff are given every other Friday off work with no reduction in pay
  • A minimum of 25 days holiday, plus public holidays
  • For each year that you're part of the team at Ember you'll receive an additional day of holiday, up to a maximum of 5 additional days.
  • Flexible working conditions, including the opportunity for part-time work and home working.
  • Access to a local working space can be arranged
  • Free annual eye tests
  • Access to a counselling service
  • Funding and allocated time for your training and development
  • Paid volunteer day
  • Four paid days off per year to enable low carbon travel
  • Time off to donate blood

jobs.description:
Horizon Blue Cross Blue Shield of New Jersey empowers our members to achieve their best health. For over 90 years, we have been New Jersey’s health solutions leader driving innovations that improve health care quality, affordability, and member experience. Our members are our neighbors, our friends, and our families. It is this understanding that drives us to better serve and care for the 3.5 million people who place their trust in us. When our employees bring their best and succeed, the Company succeeds.

About the Role

The role is responsible for conducting data collection and analyses to support process improvement programs and projects to reduce cost and complexity across the enterprise. The role will lead a variety of projects in support of the goals of business divisions. Additionally, the incumbent may work in partnership with other BPI colleagues in support of cross-functional enterprise initiatives. The incumbent will draft and review project deliverables and analyses such as value-stream mapping and statistical analyses and supervise business process analysts in the project team environment. The role will also be responsible for business case development using ROI models in direct relationship to departmental goals. The incumbent of this position will interact with process and subject matter experts to develop solutions that improve process performance by increasing productivity and efficiency and/or managing process demands while enhancing the customer experience. In addition to BPI project work, the incumbent must also plan and participate in BPI organization building and activities to help promote the BPI brand, and serve as a mentor to business staff pursuing their Green Lean and Green Belt certifications. This position requires an individual with a strong background in process improvement with the ability to deliver significant sustainable business results.

Leadership:

  • Experienced process improvement practitioner with a focus on driving cost reduction
  • Execute complex process improvement initiatives with some supervision and guidance
  • Report and communicate the results from process improvement efforts to division
  • Influence business partners to make informed decisions
  • Ability to influence small teams without direct authority
  • Act as a change agent/coach to instill and sustain changes
  • Build positive relationships and credibility with the BPI team and business partners
  • Assess change readiness and prepare plans for helping stakeholders through change
  • Utilize process improvement principles and tools to achieve significant improvement results
  • Direct the analyses of process improvement analysts
  • Drive for high quality results

Process Improvement:

  • Utilize Lean, DMAIC and Design for Six Sigma tools and methodologies to define activities that are aligned with business objectives
  • Identify and manage project risks and issues that impact project progress
  • Prepare detailed plans to track project performance and assure timely completion and achievement of project deliverables
  • Develop practical solutions and methodologies to solve complex business problems
  • Effectively coach, mentor and assist Lean and Green Belt candidates to certification
  • Develop internal and external content for leadership team presentations
  • Ensure deployment of common solutions across divisions and businesses
  • Identify and present new project opportunities to leadership
  • Develop and share best practices among fellow process improvement coaches and clients

​

Financial Management:

  • Partner with Finance and Business to develop and track project metrics
  • Develop business cases using ROI models
  • Develop control plans and monitor performance and improvement in key metrics
  • Deliver significant operational improvement and financial benefits to meet annual targets

What You Bring

Education/Experience:

  • High School Diploma/GED required
  • Bachelor degree preferred or relevant experience in lieu of degree
  • Requires a minimum of 5 years business process improvement or process redesign experience

Additional licensing, certifications, registrations:

  • Lean Six Sigma Green-level certification from an industry recognized academic or quality institution (e.g. Universities, American Society for Quality) plus the commitment to achieve Horizon Black Belt certification within two years of hire

Knowledge:

  • Healthcare industry experience preferred
  • Experience in a multi-divisional corporate environment desired
  • Understanding of change management challenges related to process improvement
  • Proven project management and process improvement skills including strong knowledge of lean and Six Sigma methodologies
  • Experienced with Minitab and/or other statistical software
  • Must be proficient in MS Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio)

Skills and Abilities:

  • Ability to lead the work of others
  • Strong verbal/written communication skills, both verbal and in written
  • Strong presentation and facilitation skills
  • Demonstrated ability to create strong working relationships with others
  • Ability to gather, synthesize and analyze data and draw logical conclusions
  • Strong project management experience
  • Well organized and results-driven individual

Travel (If Applicable):

  • Occasional travel may be required to alternate Horizon sites

Why Horizon?

At Horizon, you’ll do meaningful work that directly improves lives—while being supported by a mission‑driven organization that values expertise, collaboration, and growth. We believe that when our people thrive, our communities do too. If you are passionate about making an impact, we’d love to hear from you!

$97,800 - $133,455

This range has been created in good faith based on information known to Horizon at the time of posting. Compensation decisions are dependent on the circumstances of each case. Job Title: Director, Medical Writing WCH

Job Location: Remote, USA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

About This Role:

As the Director of Medical Writing for the West Coast Hub you are responsible for the writing and/or managing complex marketed and development programs at the portfolio level based on Therapeutic Area, disease state, and/or phase of development. You are also responsible for providing direct supervision for the Medical Writing program leads, including response to potential Medical Writing issues with internal cross-functional teams and external development partners. You will contribute to the long-term growth strategy of the department and ensure that standard procedures are followed across and within projects. You will synchronize prioritization of projects and in some cases, he/she represents Medical Writing in meetings with governance committees, regulatory agencies, and external development partners. Performs outreach within pharmaceutical/biotech industry to maintain knowledge of evolving/emerging industry standards and to establish medical writing best practices within company.

What You’ll Do:

  • Have the knowledge and be independently able to prepare clinical and regulatory documents and packages: protocols and amendments, CSRs, IBs, INDs/CTAs, submissions.Thorough understanding of industry best practices to strategically design documents that fulfil their purpose but written with public disclosure requirements in mind.

  • Lead the planning, development, and delivery of documents according to ICH guidelines, company SOPs, templates, and regulatory requirements.Support the development and maintenance of SOPs and templates for document development.

  • Ability to critically analyze and synthesize complex scientific information, and ensure scientific accuracy and consistency of documents.Develop and integrate messaging and medical writing strategy and ensure consistency through documents in a therapeutic area and/or disease state.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional SMEs including (but not limited to), Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Biostatistics, Pharmacovigilance, Clinical Operations.

  • Participate in regulatory submission planning, timelines, and document development.

  • Manage and/or provide oversight of in-house and/or contractor/vendor medical writers, ensuring high-quality deliverables.Mentor and provide professional development guidance to junior writers. May serve as the MW liaison for one or more Functional Service Providers (FSP)

  • Provide mentoring and career development to direct reports to create a high-quality and productive group.

  • Review statistical analysis plans and clinical data reports that are incorporated in data-related documents (CSRs, IBs, etc).Provide strategic input to TFL outputs to streamline TFL production.

  • Lead departmental initiatives as necessary.

Who You Are:

In addition to having exceptional written and communication skills, you successfully worked in a matrix environment where you collaborated with other clinical teams. You have strong regulatory writing experience and strong teamwork capabilities.You have expert knowledge of global requirements related to all aspects of clinical regulatory documentation to support all phases of clinical development (Phase 1-4), and acts as a medical writing subject matter expert to other departments. You have a demonstrated management, scientific, and customer-focused leadership skills.People management skill is nice to have but not must have.

Required Skills

  • Minimum of BSc + 12 years’ experience in Medical Writing, or Advanced degree + 7 years’ experience in Medical Writing (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO setting)

  • Experience with global regulatory submissions (e.g. BLA/NDA, MAA)

  • Familiarity with eCTD format and relationships between documents.

  • Familiarity with ICH, FDA, and EMA guidelines and regulations, as well as public disclosure requirements for documents.

  • Proven experience authoring documents and leading teams through the authoring process.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

  • SME in MS Word, and proficiency in document management systems (Veeva, SharePoint).

  • Experience in managing and/or mentoring other medical writers or external vendors preferred

Job Level: Management

The base compensation range for this role is: $191,000.00-$263,000.00

Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.

Location
Our Full Stack Software Engineer will be an integral part of our R&D team. This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, Sweden and Israel. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal.

Who We Are
DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.

Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity

Cloud spend is no longer just AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Our customers now run a large and growing share of their technology spend through SaaS platforms, data clouds and AI vendors - and every one of those vendors is an integration that brings another slice of their spend into view.

You'll own DoiT's Integrations Framework and the experience built on top of it. This is a chance to define what a great integration experience looks like: a customer connects a new vendor in minutes, sees at a glance that their data is flowing, and handles credential rotation, reconnects and backfills themselves without thinking twice. On the framework side, you'll make adding the next vendor a small, well-understood piece of work rather than a project - so coverage grows as fast as the vendor landscape does.

You'll work AI-augmented from day one. Integration development is spec-driven work against constantly changing third-party APIs: one of the highest-leverage places to apply agentic AI tooling. We expect you to use it across your whole workflow and to have real opinions about where it earns its place.

Responsibilities

  • Building new integrations. This is the core of the role. Design and ship integrations against third-party billing and usage APIs - authentication, incremental sync, rate limits, error handling, schema drift - and invest in the Integrations Framework itself, along with testing harnesses and scaffolding, so the tenth integration takes a fraction of the effort of the first.
  • Working AI-augmented. Use AI daily across the full span of your work - exploring unfamiliar codebases and third-party APIs, prototyping approaches, generating and reviewing code, debugging, writing tests, and producing documentation. Push on what agentic tooling can do for this codebase, and bring judgement about where AI raises velocity and where a human still has to hold the quality bar.
  • Integration management experience. Build the interfaces customers use to connect, configure and trust their integrations: health and status visibility, actionable error states, credential and key rotation, and clear feedback when something needs attention.
  • Self-service by default. Design self-service into the framework from the start - backfills, reconnects and diagnostics that customers and internal teams run themselves.
  • API-first. Build capabilities so they're fully available through APIs, not just the UI. Both humans and agents should be able to drive the platform.
  • Implementing features end-to-end. From proposal, through spec and implementation, to maintenance. You're expected to propose things you think would be a good addition, not wait for a spec.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, shipping and owning features in production
  • Strong TypeScript, including modern frontend work - React preferred
  • Hands-on experience with Go, or strong backend experience in another language (Python, Java, Node.js, C#) with genuine enthusiasm for ramping up in Go quickly
  • Real experience designing and consuming REST APIs, and integrating third-party APIs with all the mess that entails: auth flows, pagination, rate limits, partial failures, breaking changes
  • Comfortable across the stack. You may lean backend or lean frontend, but you can own a feature from the database through to the interface
  • Working proficiency in SQL
  • Experience developing solutions in the cloud and/or using cloud services (GCP, AWS or Azure)
  • A user-facing instinct for operational tooling - you care whether the error message actually tells someone what to do next
  • AI-augmented working style - you already use AI tools across your engineering workflow and can talk concretely about what you've got out of them
  • Strong knowledge of software engineering practices, design patterns and architectural principles
  • Demonstrated passion for creating high-quality web/SaaS apps
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal
  • Self-organized, goal-oriented and self-motivated; confident, thorough and tenacious

Bonus Points

  • Experience building integration platforms or extensibility frameworks as a core part of a product
  • Experience with cloud or SaaS billing data - AWS/GCP/Azure cost and usage exports, AI vendor billing data, marketplace billing, or the FOCUS specification
  • Experience with Google BigQuery, or with data pipelines and orchestration tooling (Dagster, Airflow)
  • Experience building AI-powered product features (LLM integration, intelligent automation)
  • Exposure to FinOps practices or cloud financial management products
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience

Are you a Do'er?
Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our core values.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor Page.

We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

  • Unlimited Vacation
  • Flexible Working Options
  • Health Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Stock Option Plan
  • Home Office Allowance
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Peer Recognition Program

Many Do'ers, One Team DoiT unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal-it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.

jobs.description:
VetsEZ is seeking a Data Quality Analyst & Testerto support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Data Migration and Management (DMM) Support Services for Electronic Health Record Modernization (EHRM). This role is critical to ensure that data migrated from VistA through VX130 to Oracle Health is complete, correct, traceable, and ready to support bulk migration, cutover, and VA site go-live activities.

Responsibilities:

  • Execute and monitor daily Data Quality (DQ) checks across multiple VA sites and large datasets using DMM / IRIS data-quality tools.
  • Investigate data-quality discrepancies, identify root causes, coordinate corrective actions, and drive issues through resolution to protect Data Migration integrity.
  • Validate migration queries, extracts, transformed data, and transmitted data for completeness and correctness in support of bulk migration, cutover, and site go-live activities.
  • Partner with InterSystems IRIS developers, VA staff, Oracle Health, and appropriate SMEs to research and resolve migration-data discrepancies and validation issues.
  • Prepare, maintain, and support weekly Data Quality reporting demonstrating results against VA / DMM-defined standards, and provide accurate status for Weekly Progress Reporting.
  • Gather requirements, implement, test, and deploy new or enhanced Data Quality capabilities, checks, queries, and reporting functions.
  • Create, validate, and troubleshoot SQL queries and data extracts across multiple clinical and administrative data domains.
  • Monitor DQ applications and supporting environments, identify application/server issues, and coordinate resolution with the appropriate engineering or platform teams.
  • Administer DQ application access and permissions as assigned and maintain accurate documentation of DQ tools, checks, processes, and operating procedures.
  • Facilitate recurring Data Quality meetings and communicate status, findings, risks, and resolution plans clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Use and support DMM applications such as the Data Quality Tool, Data Quality Control Panel, Journal File Search, Enterprise Domain Activity by Site, Query Management Tool, Cutover Check Application, Data Migration Event Tracker, and DMM Ticketing System.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience performing data validation, data-quality analysis, testing, reconciliation, or troubleshooting across large datasets.
  • Strong SQL skills, including the ability to create and validate ad hoc queries used for investigation and reconciliation.
  • Experience with automation, monitoring, data mapping, testing, or analytical tools.
  • Knowledge of database architecture, data integrity concepts, and security considerations for on-premises and cloud-hosted systems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate discrepancies, identify patterns, and communicate clear findings and recommended actions.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, including the ability to lead technical discussions and present findings to customers and stakeholders.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience with InterSystems IRIS / Caché, VistA, VX130, or VA healthcare data.
  • Familiarity with Linux, Kubernetes / containers, Power BI, GitHub / Azure DevOps, and Agile / Scrum environments.
  • Experience supporting data migration, cutover validation, or healthcare data reconciliation.
  • Experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) or other federal healthcare environments.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required Government background investigation / access authorization.

Security Clearance Requirements:

U.S. Citizenship is required.

All selected candidates must successfully complete a background check.

Ability to obtain and maintain a Government/Public Trust clearance, including required fingerprinting, when required for the position.

Benefits:

• Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance

• 401(k) with Employer Match

• PTO and Federal Holidays

• Corporate-provided Laptop

  • Training and Professional Development Opportunities

• Fully Remote Role

Note: Selected candidates will be required to complete fingerprinting at a government facility and undergo a background check as part of the hiring process.

Meet the Team

The GTM Strategy & Operations team for Splunk is the strategic engine behind Splunk's go-to-market motion, partnering directly with the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) organization to shape sales strategy, planning, and executive decision-making. We translate market dynamics, business performance, and sales data into the frameworks and recommendations that guide how Splunk goes to market.

The team operates at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and operations - developing GTM frameworks, running independent analyses, and delivering executive-ready recommendations that directly influence CRO-level priorities and investment decisions.

Our team members are trusted advisors to senior leadership: independent, analytically rigorous, and comfortable owning ambiguous problems end-to-end. We value clear thinking, sharp executive communication, and a collaborative approach to solving cross-functional business challenges.

Your Impact

As the Strategy & Planning Lead on the GTM Strategy & Operations team, you will lead strategic projects supporting Splunk's CRO organization largely independently, with light guidance from your manager. You will build direct, trusted relationships with senior executives, translate ambiguous business questions into structured analyses, and develop the GTM frameworks that shape strategic decisions across the sales organization.

You bring strong analytical rigor, executive presence, and a track record of owning complex strategic work from framing through recommendation - and you're comfortable moving between deep quantitative analysis and polished executive storytelling.

● Independently lead strategic GTM projects end-to-end - from problem framing and analysis through executive-ready recommendations - requiring minimal day-to-day direction.

● Build and manage relationships with senior executives and cross-functional leaders, serving as a trusted strategic partner to the CRO organization.

● Develop and apply GTM frameworks and models to evaluate market opportunities, sales strategy options, and business performance.

● Conduct deep quantitative and qualitative analyses, synthesizing sales, pipeline, and business data into clear, actionable executive insights.

● Build and deliver polished, executive-ready presentations and business models (Excel, PowerPoint) for CRO and senior leadership reviews.

● Partner cross-functionally with sales, marketing, finance, product, and, operations to align GTM priorities and drive execution against strategic plans.

● Own analysis, reporting, and materials for recurring strategic planning cycles and executive business reviews.

Minimum Qualifications

● Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

● 7+ years of experience in GTM strategy, business/sales operations, strategic planning, or management consulting.

● Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, with demonstrated ability to build financial/business models and executive-ready presentations.

● Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex strategic initiatives from ambiguity to executive-ready recommendations.

● Strong executive presence, business writing, and communication skills, with experience presenting to senior leadership.

● Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to translate data into strategic insight.

Preferred Qualifications

● Working knowledge of SQL, Salesforce (SFDC), and/or Tableau for data extraction and analysis.

● Experience developing GTM or strategic planning frameworks used to guide executive decision-making.

● Background in management consulting, corporate strategy, or sales/business operations.

● Proven experience managing relationships with C-suite or senior executive stakeholders.

● Familiarity with Cisco/Splunk's business, sales motion, or enterprise B2B software GTM.

● Self-driven and highly proactive, with a track record of operating effectively with minimal oversight.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.description:
THE ROLE

Gorilla Commerce is seeking a Manager, PLM & Product Data to serve as the business owner and super-user of the company's PLM platform.

Gorilla Commerce has successfully implemented PLM as the system of record for product specifications, BOMs, materials, suppliers and costing, and the platform is live across the sourcing organization. This role owns it from here — closing the residual data gaps that follow any implementation, raising the standard of governance, and maturing the platform through its next phases of capability.

The scope is broad but well supported. Sourcing teams own day-to-day data entry and maintenance following go-live. A dedicated analyst supports bulk uploads, reconciliation and heavy data work. IT leads the technical build of the PLM–ERP integration. This role sets the standards, makes the system decisions, and directs the work.

There is genuine white space here. An 18-month roadmap is defined — stronger specification and BOM structure, packaging and artwork governance, warning-label and claims data — and the person in this role will shape how it is prioritized, sequenced and delivered.

The role can be based globally and works core US Eastern hours to stay aligned with the VP and the wider team, with some flexibility for Asia-based sourcing partners.

This is not a data-entry or system-administration role. It is a product-data ownership role focused on structure, governance, adoption and system maturity.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

System Ownership & Configuration

  • Own the day-to-day health, configuration and evolution of the PLM platform.

  • Act as the internal authority on how PLM should be structured and used across parent and SKU hierarchy, specifications, BOMs, materials, supplier and factory records, quotes and costing.

  • Determine whether an issue is best solved through configuration, data architecture, process design or vendor development.

  • Own integration keys and mappings between PLM and the ERP.

Product Data Governance & Integrity

  • Own product data quality as an ongoing discipline rather than a periodic cleanup.

  • Establish validation standards, naming conventions and audit routines that prevent errors upstream.

  • Reconcile PLM against ERP master data and resolve discrepancies at root cause.

  • Close residual implementation gaps across product hierarchy, suppliers and factories, BOMs, color/size and supplier quote data.

Workflow, Change & Version Control

  • Design and govern state models, approval workflows and revision control.

  • Define how specification and BOM changes are requested, approved, tested and released.

  • Assess downstream impact of data and configuration changes before release.

  • Establish clear decision rights across this role, functional owners, IT and leadership.

Adoption, Training & Process Discipline

  • Drive adoption across a distributed sourcing organization as a core deliverable of the role.

  • Build and maintain SOPs, training materials and onboarding for new users.

  • Move remaining product workflows off spreadsheets and email and into PLM.

  • Identify recurring process failures and resolve the root cause rather than the symptom.

Vendor Partnership & Roadmap

  • Own the day-to-day relationship with the PLM software vendor.

  • Manage tickets, requirements, testing and feature scoping independently, escalating commercial matters to the VP.

  • Own the business-side PLM roadmap and translate business needs into practical system and process solutions.

  • Sequence future capability including deeper Level 2 and 3 BOM structure, packaging governance and claims data.

Integration Support

  • Support the IT-led PLM–ERP integration through requirements definition, mapping validation and UAT.

  • Diagnose whether issues originate in source data, PLM configuration, integration logic or the ERP.

  • Keep integration keys complete and accurate across all active SKUs.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • 5+ years in PLM, product data management or product operations, including direct ownership of a PLM or comparable product-data platform.

  • Strong grasp of product hierarchy, multi-level BOMs, specifications and revision management.

  • Experience maintaining product data integrity against an ERP, including reconciliation and integration keys.

  • Experience designing or governing approval workflows and version control.

  • Advanced Excel and confident handling of large product datasets.

  • Excellent written and verbal English.

Preferred

  • Experience through a PLM implementation or major system rollout.

  • Vendor management experience with software providers.

  • Experience in Centric PLM would be a plus.

  • Familiarity with REST APIs, integration mapping and UAT.

  • Python, SQL or Power Query for data reconciliation and automation.

  • Exposure to packaging, artwork or compliance documentation data.

  • Background in consumer products, retail, sourcing, manufacturing, apparel, footwear or hardlines.

Competencies

  • High ownership and accountability

  • Strong systems and structured-data thinking

  • Comfortable acting as a data gatekeeper

  • Independent problem solver — brings recommendations, not questions

  • Clear communicator across time zones and functions

  • Builds processes and standards that scale

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

  • PLM is live, but no single person owns its structure, standards and evolution.

  • Product data underpins sourcing, costing, compliance, quality and planning.

  • Residual implementation gaps need closing — and preventing.

  • Adoption determines whether the platform delivers its value.

  • This role exists to own PLM end to end, raise data standards, drive adoption and deliver the roadmap.

Selection process developed by matteria

Location and Work Mode

Remote (Preferably based in Latin America).

Who we are

We partner with mission-driven organizations and high-growth ventures to build leadership teams that move the world forward. Our approach blends rigorous executive search, data-informed market mapping, and a human, long-term relationship with both clients and candidates.

We’ve delivered 1,900+ placements across 15 countries (Latin America, North America, and Europe), worked with 600+ organizations across the private, public, and civil sectors, and host a talent platform with 90,000+ registered users. This scale helps us run sharper searches, faster, with a consistently excellent candidate experience.

Our impact

  • 1,900+ executive and leadership placements completed.

  • Active across 15 countries in Latin America, North America, and Europe.

  • Trusted by 600+ organizations across the private, public, and social sectors.

  • Community of 90,000+ professionals within our talent platform.

Purpose of the Position

The Senior Talent Consultant at matteria leads executive searches end to end, partnering with leaders who are changing the world, wherever they happen to be building. This person brings both the technical execution of headhunting and a strategic, consultative lens, listening closely to translate a client's ambitions into winning candidate profiles, and becomes the client's senior point of contact, able to navigate complex conversations fluently in English.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Client Advisory

  • Lead executive discovery sessions to deeply understand organizational challenges and leadership needs.

  • Translate loosely defined client expectations into structured search strategies and compelling leadership profiles.

  • Serve as the senior strategic point of contact throughout every engagement.

  • Facilitate executive-level conversations and decision-making in English with confidence and independence.

Executive Search Leadership

  • Own the full executive search lifecycle, including intake meetings, role definition, compensation calibration, sourcing strategy, executive outreach, candidate assessment, client presentations, offer management, and successful placement.

  • Design tailored search strategies for leadership positions across multiple industries and geographies.

  • Conduct sophisticated market mapping and direct headhunting of passive executive talent.

Leadership Assessment & Consulting

  • Conduct structured executive interviews and leadership assessments.

  • Evaluate candidates based on competencies, leadership capabilities, cultural alignment, and mission fit.

  • Advise clients on market dynamics, candidate trade-offs, and hiring decisions with sound judgment and objectivity.

Candidate Experience

  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience through transparent communication, timely feedback, and respectful engagement.

  • Lead executive negotiations and support successful onboarding and post-placement follow-up.

Market Intelligence & Operational Excellence

  • Produce executive search reports, market intelligence, compensation insights, and pipeline analytics.

  • Continuously leverage technology and AI tools to strengthen research, sourcing, documentation, and decision-making.

  • Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, methodology improvements, and mentoring of junior consultants when appropriate.

Requirements and competences to work with us

Education

  • We prioritize proven capability over credentials. No specific degree required.

  • What matters: a track record delivering end-to-end executive searches, sharp judgment, and consistent results.

  • Advanced studies or certifications (e.g., executive coaching, org psychology, OD, analytics) are welcome but optional if your experience speaks for itself.

Experience

  • 7–12+ years in executive search, senior recruiting, or leadership hiring—agency or in-house—delivering Director/C-Suite or hard-to-fill leadership roles.

  • Proven track record of direct headhunting and closing passive candidates across multiple markets/time zones.

  • Comfortable running multiple searches concurrently in a freelance/independent setup with clear SLAs and outcome accountability.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Professional, fluent, bilingual English, able to lead client calls, negotiations, and written deliverables independently, with no translation support required; additional languages such as Spanish or Portuguese are an asset.

  • Expertise in leadership assessment, behavioral interviewing, and talent mapping.

  • Outstanding project management and organizational abilities.

  • Fluency with technology and AI tools as a core part of how you work, not an afterthought, using them to accelerate research, sourcing, and decision-making.

  • Proficiency in digital recruitment platforms, applicant tracking systems (ATS), and professional networking tools.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Competencies

  • Ownership & speed: bias to action, proactive risk mitigation, reliable on-time delivery.

  • Judgment: sharp evaluation of leadership competencies and cultural/mission fit.

  • Consultative seniority: the instinct to ask the right questions, truly listen, and translate loosely defined client needs into concrete, actionable deliverables.

  • Global mindset: comfort working across cultures, languages, and sectors; high adaptability.

  • Integrity & empathy: candidate-first approach with uncompromising ethics and confidentiality.

  • Learning agility: iterate on playbooks, test new channels, and share best practices.

Our team profile

At matteria, Executive Search is fundamentally a people business. We believe outstanding results come from combining technical excellence with empathy, curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Our culture is built around ten guiding principles:

  • We Connect with People: curiosity, empathy, and meaningful opportunities.

  • We Solve for the Client: their impact is our impact; we exceed expectations.

  • We Are World-Class: rigorous preparation, professional presence, never late.

  • Responsible Autonomy: freedom with sound judgment; ownership and speed.

  • We Solve with Data: evidence over opinion; reduce bias, decide better.

  • We Take Care of EVERY Detail: impeccable deliverables; craft matters.

  • Immediate Feedback: candid, caring, and frequent—growth is a team sport.

  • Curiosity: learn daily, research proactively, elevate collective knowledge.

  • AI Collaborates with Us: tech amplifies our creativity and execution.

  • We Love to Laugh: humility and humor as resilience and connection.

Key interests for working with us

This role is designed for someone who wants to become a trusted advisor to organizations creating meaningful change around the world, not simply someone who fills executive positions.

Our team is inspired by organizations addressing challenges such as:

  • Climate action

  • Sustainable development

  • Education

  • Healthcare

  • Economic inclusion

  • Entrepreneurship

  • Social innovation

  • Technology for good

  • Institutional strengthening

  • Purpose-driven business

We believe leadership changes organizations, and organizations change the world.

Reasons to join our team

  • Partner directly with founders, CEOs, Boards, and leadership teams driving meaningful impact.

  • Lead sophisticated international executive searches with significant autonomy.

  • Build a long-term consulting career with one of Latin America's leading executive search firms focused on impact organizations.

  • Learn advanced executive search methodologies, leadership assessment frameworks, and AI-powered recruiting practices.

  • Join a collaborative culture that values excellence, ownership, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

  • Enjoy the flexibility of a fully remote work environment.

  • Benefit from a performance-based compensation model with strong earning potential.

Relevant details before applying for this vacancy

  • Fully remote position.

  • Preferred location: Latin America.

  • Independent Contractor / Freelance engagement.

  • Project-based work with clearly defined deliverables and service agreements.

  • Expected capacity to manage 2–4 executive search assignments simultaneously.

  • Professional bilingual English is mandatory.

  • Spanish is required; Portuguese is highly valued.

  • Availability to collaborate across AMER and partial EMEA time zones.

GROWMARK is an agricultural cooperative serving almost 400,000 customers across North America, providing agronomy, energy, facility engineering and construction, and logistics products and services, as well as grain marketing and risk management services. Headquartered in Bloomington, Illinois, GROWMARK owns the FS trademark, which is used by its member cooperatives. GROWMARK also owns and operates SEEDWAY, the largest full-line seed company in the United States. More information is available at growmark.com.

PURPOSE AND SUMMARY STATEMENT

Is responsible for assisting in the development of standard safety and environmental loss prevention and compliance programs, in addition to executing related assessments for GROWMARK and the FS System.

SUPERVISION AND LEADERSHIP

Provides solutions through mentoring as needed, necessary, and appropriate.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Assists in evaluation, development, and implementation of policies, programs, and procedures regarding GROWMARK safety standards and expectations.

Contributes to the development and implementation of annual Risk Management Reviews/Plans.

Monitors environmental and safety laws and regulations which may impact compliance programs.

Is a perpetual resource providing solutions to safety and regulatory issues brough forth by affected parties throughout the GROWMARK and FS System.

Assists GROWMARK and the FS System by providing local training as needed, necessary, and appropriate.

Collaborates in the creation and implementation of standardized inspections, audits, and assessments designed to benchmark the execution of safety initiatives throughout GROWMARK and the FS System.

Conducts job hazard assessments as well as monitors Process Safety Management protocols as needed and necessary.

Develops and implements DHS Chemical Facility Anti-Terrorism Standards (CFATS) plans and DOT Hazardous Material Security plans at applicable facilities.

Develops environmental compliance procedures for new facilities and makes updates or revisions to existing procedures as necessary.

Responds to and assists with crisis related emergencies as needed and necessary throughout GROWMARK and the FS System.

OTHER JOB FUNCTIONS

Follows GROWMARK’s Code of Conduct and Corporate Compliance Program, Environmental Health and Safety, OSHA and DOT policies and procedures, as they apply.

Acts as a liaison with regulatory agencies.

Performs all other duties as assigned.

REQUIREMENTS

Normally requires a bachelor’s degree in safety, environmental, or industrial technology or equivalent, or 2 years or more of advanced safety, environmental or OSHA related experience to demonstrate the ability to provide safety, environmental, compliance, and accident prevention training to the GROWMARK and FS System.

Ability to obtain the HAZWOPER 24-hour certification to conduct certified training within 1 year of employment.

Ability to conduct effective presentations and training.

Requires professional communication and customer service skills.

Requires organization, time management, and problem-solving skills.

Requires the ability to work independently and in team-oriented environment.

Requires skill, ability to learn, and relative proficiency with the Microsoft 365 suite of products.

Must have and maintain a valid driver’s license and ability to travel independently and overnight.

Ability to lift 25 lbs. and use man lifts, stairs and ladders.

Occasionally exposed to extreme weather conditions and contact with chemicals and dust requiring the proper use of personal protective equipment.

Occasionally required to work extended hours.

Requires the ability to maintain complete confidentiality.

Ability and willingness to participate in required training that may include education on GROWMARK’s policies and procedures and additional training as it relates to the requirements of the position.

At GROWMARK, we are dedicated to supporting the long-term financial well-being of our employees through a fully funded pension, a cornerstone benefit that ensures security for the future. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, along with a variety of supplemental plans like accident, critical illness, disability, hospital indemnity, and identity theft protection. Whether you're starting your career, balancing family life, or planning for retirement, our company is committed to providing employees with a comprehensive and competitive Total Rewards package that meets your needs at every stage. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, location, and other factors permitted by law. In addition to base pay, certain roles may be eligible for bonuses, incentives, and commissions.

We are an equal opportunity/Disabled/Protected Veteran Employer. All individuals, regardless of demographic or other background, are encouraged to apply. Further, as a federal, state, and local contractor, we comply with government regulations and executive orders as applicable, including affirmative action responsibilities for qualified individuals with disability and protected veterans.
