jobs.excerpt: Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.
jobs.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


Department & Team: Facilities & Real Estate
Reports to: Director, Global Workplace
Location: New York, NY preferred; Virtual US / East Coast Time Zone

Role Overview

The Technical Facilities and Project Manager is a key member of the Global Facilities and Real Estate team responsible for delivering and continuously improving Genesys workplaces globally. The role combines project leadership with technical facilities expertise to ensure offices are well designed, efficiently operated, sustainable, secure, and aligned with consistent standards. It leads complex design, construction, renovation, and infrastructure initiatives while developing scalable solutions across building systems, energy and sustainability, physical security, occupancy, and facilities operations.

Supporting a portfolio of more than 40 locations, this role translates global workplace strategy into repeatable, sound solutions while adapting to local requirements. Reporting to the Director, Global Workplace, the position partners with regional facilities teams, business leaders, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, landlords, vendors, sustainability and security teams, and other senior stakeholders.

This role provides meaningful visibility across global workplace initiatives and the opportunity to influence how Genesys facilities evolve as the portfolio and workplace needs change. Through close partnership across regions and functions, the role helps create reliable, sustainable, and effective workplaces that support employees and the broader business.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Delivery

  • Lead multiple concurrent workplace design, construction, renovation, infrastructure, and facilities improvement projects from planning and due diligence through design, construction, commissioning, turnover, and closeout.

  • Act as an owner-focused project lead, protecting Genesys interests and balancing business objectives, employee experience, technical performance, cost, schedule, quality, risk, and long-term operational value.

  • Develop and manage scopes, schedules, budgets, forecasts, procurement plans, change controls, risk registers, governance, reporting, and escalation paths; identify issues early and drive corrective action.

  • Coordinate architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, vendors, landlords, and internal stakeholders across regions and time zones, and support site selection and technical due diligence.

  • Lead operational readiness and turnover, including commissioning, punch-list completion, asset documentation, training, O&M manuals, warranties, and transition to facilities operations.

Technical Facilities Leadership

  • Provide technical leadership across HVAC, electrical, lighting, controls, plumbing, life safety, building automation, metering, and related workplace infrastructure.

  • Assess existing facilities and system performance, risks, deficiencies, lifecycle needs, and improvement opportunities; read and review architectural and engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.

  • Evaluate designs for functionality, constructability, maintainability, regulatory compliance, sustainability, reliability, lifecycle cost, energy performance, and employee experience; participate in design reviews, value engineering, commissioning, and technical problem solving.

  • Translate workplace strategies into specifications, standards, workflows, and repeatable implementation guidelines, using lessons learned to continuously improve global practices.

Global Standards, Workplace Integration & Data

  • Develop and maintain global technical standards, design criteria, specifications, checklists, templates, and performance requirements for facilities, building systems, sustainability, security integration, and project delivery.

  • Partner with regional teams to apply global standards while addressing local codes, regulations, landlord requirements, climate, operations, and cultural needs; ensure project decisions transition effectively into ongoing operations.

  • Establish measurable requirements and verify completed projects perform as intended; support occupancy measurement, space performance, facilities analytics, and clear technical documentation that strengthens portfolio consistency and institutional knowledge.

Sustainability, Energy & Environmental Compliance

  • Embed sustainable design and operating practices into projects and facilities, supporting Genesys environmental objectives and alignment with ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems.

  • Advance energy efficiency, water conservation, responsible materials, waste reduction, indoor environmental quality, carbon reduction, and high-performance building practices; identify opportunities in HVAC, controls, metering, lighting, equipment, operations, and green-energy procurement.

  • Partner with stakeholders to measure, validate, track, and report energy, water, waste, and related environmental performance, and support applicable regional requirements such as CSRD, EED, and evolving sustainability frameworks.

  • Support LEED strategies for interior fit-outs and ongoing operations, and use post-implementation data to identify further efficiency and performance improvements.

Physical Security & Life Safety Integration

  • Partner with Corporate Security and other stakeholders to assess and integrate physical security and life-safety requirements into projects and existing facilities, including access control, surveillance, visitor management, intrusion detection, and related technologies.

  • Ensure security requirements are addressed early and coordinated with architectural, engineering, IT, facilities, and building infrastructure.

Financial, Procurement & Risk Management

  • Prepare and maintain project budgets, forecasts, cash-flow projections, cost reports, and variance analyses; evaluate proposals, bids, estimates, change orders, and contractor recommendations for cost, quality, and value.

  • Partner with Procurement and Legal on sourcing, selection, contract administration, and vendor negotiations; monitor external partner performance and hold consultants and contractors accountable for commitments and outcomes.

  • Identify technical, financial, schedule, operational, compliance, and delivery risks; develop mitigation strategies and business cases that clearly present costs, benefits, alternatives, and long-term implications.

Stakeholder Leadership & Communication

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor and primary project contact for regional teams, business leaders, and senior stakeholders, translating complex topics into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Facilitate project meetings, design reviews, workshops, executive updates, and decision-making sessions, with clear visibility into status, risks, decisions, budget, and schedule.

  • Build effective relationships across a geographically distributed organization and navigate competing priorities while maintaining focus on successful project outcomes.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Facilities Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

  • 10+ years of experience in facilities, design, engineering, construction, or project management, including significant responsibility for complex commercial workplace projects and multiple concurrent, multi-phase initiatives.

  • Strong working knowledge of commercial building systems, construction methods, project controls, facilities operations, and the ability to read architectural and engineering drawings, specifications, scopes of work, and technical documentation.

  • Demonstrated experience managing budgets, schedules, forecasts, procurement, risks, change controls, commissioning, and operational turnover.

  • Working knowledge of environmental management and sustainability practices, including ISO 14001, energy management, high-performance building principles, building codes, workplace safety, accessibility, and regulatory compliance.

  • Excellent organization, problem solving, decision-making, written and verbal communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills; able to work independently and collaboratively in a global, remote-working environment.

  • Ability to periodically participate in meetings outside normal business hours for international collaboration and to travel domestically and internationally as business needs require, generally not expected to exceed 20%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience serving as an Owner’s Representative for corporate workplace, commercial interiors, or facilities projects and/or managing global or multi-regional project portfolios.

  • Professional certification or licensure such as PMP, LEED AP, PE, RA, CFM, or equivalent.

  • Experience with LEED ID+C or O+M, ESG initiatives, energy-management programs, environmental or energy reporting requirements, commissioning, building automation, metering, facilities analytics, or asset lifecycle planning.

  • Familiarity with BIM, AutoCAD, facilities-management and project-management platforms, reporting dashboards, and related digital tools.

  • Experience developing global technical standards, specifications, playbooks, or design guidelines for a corporate real estate portfolio.

  • Strong global perspective and commitment to continuous improvement, sustainability, resilience, accessibility, safety, workplace excellence, and employee experience

Application Security Engineer

Parallels is seeking a highly motivated and talented Application Security Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will make security decisions that impact millions of our customers while gaining hands-on experience in exploit development and CVE discovery. The ideal candidate will combine an attacker mindset with the humility and detail-oriented attitude required to coordinate fixes and security architecting with busy engineers.

Your primary responsibility will be to coordinate with more senior members of our team to write exploits and design fixes for existing application vulnerabilities. You will also help search for new critical/high risk vulnerabilities in our codebase. In addition, you will assist in vulnerability disclosure processes and help implement repeatable secure development practices.

As issues are uncovered, you will communicate with the appropriate technical and leadership teams to ensure a focus on risk mitigation – allowing for business continuity, but without negligent risk. Application security engineers are constantly assessing applications for weaknesses and finding resolutions before they can be abused.

Parallels: anytime, anywhere, any-device productivity.Why Parallels, why now?

The top creative and technical minds could sell anywhere. So why are so many choosing Parallels? Three reasons:

This is the moment.It's an exciting time at Parallels — strong leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to how the world works. The EUC market is shifting fast, and we're at the front of that wave. We want you riding it with us.

We want you to be you.Too many companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Ours is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe being who you are, taking risks, and showing us what you've got.

It's your world.We know you have a life. We want to be part of it — not all of it. At Parallels, we're serious about empowering people to work when, how, and where they want. Couch? Sweatpants? Cool with us. Happy sellers mean happy customers. That's why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

Sound good so far? Awesome. Let's talk about the role

What you'll do:

  • Reproduce and triage incoming vulnerabilities from security automation/bug bounty programs, then propose granular fixes to engineers
  • Discover vulnerabilities and construct exploits for core Parallels applications such as Parallels Remote Application Server
  • Assist in the CVE disclosure process
  • Provide threat models and design reviews for teams throughout the company
  • Assist in tuning existing static analysis, dynamic analysis, and dependency management tools

Desired Qualities:

  • An attacker mindset: engineers will often want proof before fixes are implemented
  • Eagerness to learn – you are not expected to know everything coming in, but you should continuously learn new techniques on the job
  • The ability to communicate clearly, acknowledge mistakes, and disagree when necessary
  • Demonstrable passion for offensive security
  • Experience reading, writing and debugging C++ and Python code
  • Basic experience with memory exploitation techniques
  • Demonstrable experience with web exploitation techniques and tools (e.g. PortSwigger lab scoreboards)
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

Ideal Candidate Will Have:

  • BSc/MS in computer science or a related field
  • Previous CVEs in desktop applications
  • Proficiency with reverse engineering tools
  • Significant experience in memory exploitation techniques (e.g. gaining code execution from memory vulnerabilities in modern operating systems)
  • Familiarity with cloud security best practices
  • 3+ years of industry experience
  • OSCP/OSWE/OSED/RET2 certification

What are you waiting for? Apply now. We can't wait to meet you.

(FYI, we're lucky to get a lot of interest and we appreciate every application — please note we'll only reach out if you've been selected for an interview.)

jobs.description:
Job Post: Patient Outreach Specialist

Position Type: Full-Time (40 hours per week)

Work Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Central Time

Work Days: Monday – Friday

Salary: $5 - $6 per hour, depending on experience

Workplace: Remote

Our client is a well-established U.S.-based prosthetics and orthotics healthcare provider with approximately 30 clinic locations. We are seeking a compassionate, organized, and proactive Patient Outreach Specialist to join the remote scheduling and patient access team.

In this patient-facing role, you will help patients move efficiently from an initial inquiry, referral, or prescription to a scheduled appointment at the appropriate clinic. You will communicate with patients through phone, email, chat, and text while coordinating with physician offices and internal healthcare teams to ensure required information and documentation are complete.

This position is ideal for someone who combines excellent patient communicationwith strong organization and follow-through. You should be comfortable making outbound calls, guiding patients through next steps, handling objections or concerns professionally, and managing multiple patient cases in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

Above all, you will help create a positive patient experience by making the scheduling process as clear, efficient, and supportive as possible.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Outreach & Communication

  • Handle inbound and outbound patient inquiries through phone, email, chat, and text
  • Communicate with patients professionally, empathetically, and in accordance with HIPAA requirements
  • Promptly contact patients following an inquiry, referral, or prescription
  • Gather required demographic, insurance, referral, prescription, and relevant clinical information
  • Assess patient needs using established product, service, and scheduling guidelines
  • Clearly explain scheduling requirements, next steps, and expectations
  • Address questions and concerns while helping patients understand what is needed to proceed
  • Follow up consistently with patients who have incomplete information or outstanding requirements
  • Maintain professionalism when communicating with upset, hesitant, or difficult-to-reach patients
  • Send approved patient reminders, updates, newsletters, or other communications as needed

Patient Scheduling & Access Coordination

  • Schedule patients for prosthetic and orthotic appointments at the appropriate clinic
  • Determine the appropriate scheduling location based on patient needs, location, device type, documentation status, and provider availability
  • Support patient-facing scheduling and calendar coordination
  • Ensure required information and documentation are received and reviewed before scheduling
  • Coordinate with patients, physician offices, intake, billing, clinic teams, and other support departments to resolve barriers to care
  • Escalate difficult patient concerns, incomplete documentation, unreachable patients, or workflow barriers to the appropriate supervisor or department
  • Help ensure each patient interaction ends with a clear and appropriate next step

Documentation & Follow-Up

  • Review and confirm required documentation, including prescriptions, insurance information, physician details, referrals, and other necessary records
  • Accurately enter and maintain patient information in applicable systems
  • Document all patient interactions, outreach attempts, appointment details, and follow-up actions
  • Sort, prioritize, and respond to patient emails, text messages, and other communications in a timely manner
  • Maintain organized follow-up workflows for multiple patient cases
  • Protect patient confidentiality and ensure all documentation and communication meet HIPAA standards
  • Take ownership of assigned patient interactions through the appropriate next step or escalation

Additional Support

  • Collaborate with intake, billing, clinic operations, support teams, and leadership
  • Participate in virtual training, coaching sessions, team meetings, and remote huddles
  • Assist with internal calendar coordination when needed
  • Participate in community outreach events or virtual health education sessions when requested

What Success Looks Like

A successful Patient Outreach Specialist delivers an exceptional patient experience while helping patients get scheduled quickly, accurately, and compassionately.

Success in this position includes:

  • Timely and consistent patient outreach
  • Accurate and complete documentation
  • Strong follow-up and ownership of patient cases
  • Efficient and accurate appointment scheduling
  • Clear, compassionate, and professional communication
  • Effective coordination with internal teams and physician offices
  • Proper escalation of barriers or incomplete requirements
  • Consistent adherence to HIPAA and confidentiality standards
  • Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Relevant experience in healthcare, patient scheduling, patient access, customer service, call center operations, sales, or another patient-facing role
  • Experience handling inbound and/or outbound calls
  • Comfortable conducting proactive patient outreach and following established scripts or workflows
  • Ability to professionally address questions, concerns, and objections while guiding patients toward an appropriate next step
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong listening skills and ability to understand patient needs, concerns, urgency, and scheduling barriers
  • Compassionate, patient, and professional communication style
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to manage multiple patient cases, communications, follow-ups, and deadlines simultaneously
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced and metrics-driven environment
  • Strong follow-through and ownership of assigned patient interactions
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with intake, billing, clinic operations, physician offices, support teams, and leadership
  • Knowledge of HIPAA requirements and commitment to protecting confidential patient information
  • Positive and resilient attitude when handling rejection, upset patients, incomplete information, or unsuccessful outreach attempts

Preferred Experience

  • 1–3 years of relevant patient-facing or healthcare experience
  • Previous experience with prosthetics and orthotics
  • Durable Medical Equipment (DME) experience
  • Medical scheduling or patient access experience
  • Referral and prescription coordination experience
  • Experience verifying or collecting insurance information
  • Experience communicating with physician offices
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms
  • Familiarity with EHR/EMR systems
  • Experience with VoIP or healthcare phone systems
  • Experience with chat or text-based patient communication platforms
  • Experience working with a U.S.-based healthcare organization

Basic requirements

  • Must be proficient in speaking and writing clear, professional English
  • Must have relevant healthcare, administrative, customer service, or patient-facing work experience
  • Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory)
  • Must be available for video meetings with camera on when required
  • Must be comfortable participating in virtual training, coaching sessions, and remote team huddles
  • Must maintain HIPAA-compliant work practices and patient confidentiality at all times
  • Must not have concurrent employment during scheduled working hours
  • Must be available for the required 40-hour workweek

Technical Requirements

  • Device: Reliable laptop or desktop computer
  • Internet: High-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps)
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset
  • Video: Webcam for virtual meetings
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

jobs.excerpt: Make a measurable and mission-critical impact.  Join us on theProduct Management team as a Product Manager –Mobile Platform, and help shape the future of safer, more efficient, and more reliable operations across the globe.
jobs.description:
Make a measurable and mission-critical impact.

Join us on the

Product Management team as a Product Manager –Mobile Platform, and help shape the future of safer, more efficient, and more reliable operations across the globe.

Start your journey with Anova today!

Role Summary

This role's center of gravity is the customer — their experience of the Anova solution and their ability to realize meaningful value from it. You'll grow into deeper ownership as you build your track record here.

The Product Manager owns discovery and delivery across a defined product area within the Anova Unify platform. Working closely with a Senior PM or Director, you drive the full product lifecycle for your area — from structured customer research through to shipping, measuring adoption, and iterating. This is a hands-on execution role: you will write specs, manage a backlog, partner daily with engineering, and get close to customers. You won't be handed a roadmap to execute — you'll help shape it.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Lead deep customer discovery. Design and run ongoing discovery programs — interviews, site visits, usage analysis, win/loss reviews. Develop a differentiated point of view on what customers need, what they'll pay for, and what will create durable competitive advantage. Use AI tools to accelerate research and synthesis. Build conviction before building product.
  • Own your backlog end-to-end. Write specs and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from. Prioritize ruthlessly. Keep the backlog current and free of ambiguity.
  • Ship and measure. Define success metrics before each release. Monitor adoption post-launch. Share what you're learning with the broader team and make fast, evidence-based adjustments.
  • Partner with engineering and design daily. Be a reliable, responsive partner. Unblock your team. Make trade-off calls with good judgment and know when to escalate.
  • Reason across the full stack. Understand how Anova's physical devices, connectivity layer, and cloud platform interact — and make product decisions that account for hardware constraints, firmware cycles, and sensor data quality, not just software capabilities.
  • Enable go-to-market. Write clear release notes, internal briefings, and customer-facing materials. Help sales and customer success understand what you've shipped and why it matters.
  • Support customers. Triage escalated product issues in your area. Maintain a feedback loop with support and customer success to surface patterns early.

Outcomes you'll own

  • Anova leads customer insight amongst the IoT market. Your deep curiosity about customers, their processes, and how IoT transforms their business will keep Anova the leading player that best understands how IoT leads to value for our customers' customers.
  • Feature adoption and customer value realization. Features you ship get used, and customers can point to the value. You define the adoption metric before you ship, track it after, and iterate until it moves.
  • Discovery pipeline. A healthy, evidence-backed backlog — prioritized from real customer insight, validated with data, and ready for engineering.
  • On-time, high-quality delivery. Your area ships on cadence and predictably. Specs are clear, edge cases are handled, and engineering isn't blocked waiting for answers.
  • Squad metrics. You track velocity, cycle time, and escaped defects — not to report up, but to spot friction early and remove it.
  • NPS contribution. Customers in your product area trust the product and feel heard. You stay close to feedback, close the loop on issues, and bring the voice of the customer into every decision.

How you'll work at Anova

  • Specs, one-pagers, and decision memos are how we align a global, distributed team — writing clearly forces clear thinking. AI can help you draft, but writing well remains your skill to own.
  • You use AI as leverage. You're fluent with LLMs for research, synthesis, drafting, and analysis, and you bring a clear point of view on where AI should — and shouldn't — show up in B2B industrial products.
  • You reason from data. You define the metric before you ship the feature, and you're comfortable pulling the numbers yourself in a modern BI tool.

What you’ll need to succeed:

Minimum Requirements -

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience with mobile platform development, device connectivity, and software deployment.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with direct ownership of product area strategy and adoption outcomes.
  • 6+ years of total professional experience, spanning product management, software engineering, or related technical functions.
  • You have at least one example of taking a product, feature, or initiative from zero — no spec, no playbook — to something real and used.
  • Track record of shipping SaaS or enterprise software in close partnership with engineering teams — from spec to production — using Agile/DevOps.
  • Experience conducting customer discovery interviews and translating qualitative and quantitative insight into prioritized, well-scoped backlog items.
  • Demonstrated use of AI and LLM tools in a PM context — for research, synthesis, spec drafting, competitive analysis, data work, or customer insight.
  • Ability to write clear, structured specs, one-pagers, and narratives for cross-functional audiences.
  • Comfort reasoning about technical trade-offs — APIs, data models, integration patterns — credibly with engineers.
  • Data fluency: define metrics, pull and analyze data in BI tools, and make evidence-based roadmap calls.

Preferred Qualifications -

  • Prior experience in IIoT, connected-hardware, SaaS, or industrial technology environments.
  • Experience shipping ML- or AI-assisted features in a SaaS product.
  • Exposure to industrial or field-operations workflows — understanding how things work in the physical world.
  • Background in venture or private-equity-backed high-growth industrial technology companies.

ABOUT ANOVA

We are very proudly “one” Anova — built by integrating the best in IIoT technology and expertise. Anova monitors more than 1,250,000 assets across nearly 80 countries for over 2000 clients, from family businesses to the largest LPG, Industrial Gases, and chemicals companies in the world. Our scale is global. Our service is local. We partner directly with customers, taking a holistic approach and delivering tailored solutions that drive innovation and improvement and make our world safer, more efficient, and reliable.

We believe that rewarding work should reward you. As part of Anova, your work, integrity, and commitment are rewarded through competitive compensation and reward strategies, through sincere appreciation, and through opportunities for growth and advancement. We put people first by providing benefits that support your life and well-being, from health and finance to recognition and reward, and so much more — we've got you covered.

If this sounds like a fit for you, apply to join Anova in connecting the industrial world — for better.

For more information about how Anova is transforming the Industrial IOT industry, visit us at Anova.com.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer I - Mexico
jobs.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is looking for an experienced Technical Support Engineer to provide world-class hardware and software support experience to our customers. You will be a part of our Tier 2 support team within the umbrella of the Global Technical Support organization. You will be responsible for resolving complex customer problems and improving support across all teams. Your work will be collaborative in nature, working together with other support engineers in multiple support locations to serve our customers and troubleshoot complex issues.

The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background with experience in a technical support role, proven customer-facing skills, and strong communication skills. You understand the day-to-day aspects of customer support including managing tickets, building knowledge base articles, and providing product feedback to Engineering and PM teams.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.


In this role, you will:

  • Product Expertise: Become an expert on Samsara’s product portfolio of complete Internet of Things (“IoT”) solutions combining hardware, software, and cloud to bring real-time visibility, analytics, and AI to operations across multiple industries.
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Use your technical knowledge and product expertise to troubleshoot and resolve customer issues with medium to high complexity.
  • Responsiveness & Resolution: Respond to customers and resolve their inquiries in a timely and helpful manner with a primary focus on meeting our SLA goals.
  • Documentation: Partner with Enablement to author and maintain customer-facing knowledge base articles to help improve the self-serviceability for our end users.
  • Partnerships: Work closely to develop partnerships with our Engineering and Product teams in order to reproduce bugs and build testbeds as necessary.
  • Feedback Loop: Provide direct feedback to Support Management for product and process improvements to help enhance the customer experience.
  • Team Player: Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical), or other technical fields.
  • 1-3 years of experience in support, engineering, or other technical roles.

Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish is a must.

  • Experience with troubleshooting and supporting hardware & software products.
  • Strong familiarity with using CRMs like Zendesk or Salesforce.
  • Technical know-how - you’re comfortable interfacing with engineers, translating complex technical concepts into everyday language, and working with SaaS systems.
  • Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills coupled with the ability to influence individual contributors and leaders across the company.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible language for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, improve processes, and drive greater efficiency
  • Strong bias for action, ability to dive deep, and insistence on the highest standards.
  • Ability to work in a hyper-growth environment with shifting priorities.
  • Willingness to work holidays and weekends as needed to meet customer demands.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with industrial systems, electronics, tinkering with cars or IoT devices, or similar hands-on work is a big plus.
  • French or German proficiency is a big plus.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Skills

  • Critical thinking and analytical skills.

Professional

Job Description


Senior Product Manager - Blue Prism (SS&C Technologies)

Location: USA - Remote (Eastern Time Zone)

Team: Blue Prism Product

Reports to: Group Product Manager

About SS&C Technologies

SS&C Technologies (NASDAQ: SSNC) is one of the world's largest independent providers of software and services to the financial services and healthcare industries. With over 29,000 employees across 150+ offices in 40+ countries, SS&C serves more than 20,000 organizations globally - from the world's leading asset managers and insurers to hospitals, biotech firms, and government agencies. Our scale, resilience, and depth of domain expertise give our product teams a rare vantage point: the ability to build software that touches real operational workflows at some of the most complex enterprises in the world.

About SS&C Blue Prism

SS&C Blue Prism is a recognised leader in the intelligent automation space, trusted by many of the world's largest organisations to automate mission-critical work at scale.

Our flagship platform, SS&C Blue Prism WorkHQ, is the modern headquarters of work - a holistic enterprise automation platform that brings together humans, digital workers, AI agents, and enterprise systems into a cohesive automation fabric, orchestrating work through intelligent workflows. It's how enterprises design, deploy, govern, and continuously improve AI-powered work across their business -- and it's the product platform you'll help shape.

The intelligent automation market is being reshaped in real time by advances in generative AI and agentic frameworks. Blue Prism sits at the centre of that shift, and we're looking for a Senior Product Manager who wants to help define what enterprise automation looks like next.

The Role

As a Senior Product Manager at SS&C Blue Prism, you'll own a product area that directly shapes how the world's largest enterprises adopt and scale intelligent automation. You'll operate in a highly dynamic, competitive market being reshaped by AI, set strategy in the face of market ambiguity, and partner across a large product organisation to ship products that customers love and that drive measurable revenue.

You'll be part of a sizeable, tightly aligned product management team -- which means your job is not just to run your own area well, but to make the whole portfolio better through the clarity of your thinking, the quality of your roadmap, and the discipline of your trade-offs.

What you'll do

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for your product area, from discovery through launch and iteration.
  • Work alongside a large product management team to ensure your area is fully aligned to the overall product portfolio strategy -- no orphaned roadmaps, no drift, no surprises.
  • Maintain a clear, well-organised roadmap that stakeholders across the business can understand and trust.
  • Make the tough trade-offs -- cutting scope, resequencing, saying no - and communicate the reasoning cleanly.
  • Ensure every release ties to a measurable customer or revenue outcome.
  • Develop deep customer and market understanding - talking to users, sitting with sales, watching automations run in production - and translate that into a sharp point of view on where to invest.
  • Take products zero-to-one: identify unmet needs, validate them fast, define the MVP, drive it to revenue, and iterate.
  • Write detailed, high-quality product requirements. Prototypes accelerate our thinking, but they don't replace the rigour of a well-defined spec.
  • Use AI daily - for research, synthesis, prototyping, and communication - to move faster and socialise complex ideas with clarity.
  • Partner with engineering, design, research, data, marketing, sales, support, and executive stakeholders to align on outcomes and unblock delivery.
  • Define and track the metrics that matter: adoption, revenue, retention, and customer impact.
  • Represent the product externally with customers, analysts, and partners.

What we're looking for

Required:

  • 3+ years of product management experience in B2B enterprise SaaS.
  • A track record of taking products from zero to one, with demonstrated revenue impact — not just launches.
  • Comfort operating in significant ambiguity and in fast-moving, competitive markets shaped by rapid technology change.
  • Fluency using AI as a day-to-day thinking, building, and communication partner — including using AI to prototype ideas and socialise complex concepts with stakeholders.
  • A genuine passion for automation and business transformation.

Ideal:

  • Prior experience in the automation or AI/agentic product space.
  • A technical background (engineering, computer science, or equivalent hands-on experience).
  • Deep understanding of modern agentic frameworks, LLM tooling, and how AI agents are built and evaluated in enterprise contexts.

Our culture

We're a highly collaborative, market-aware, and highly organised product management team, working with a large number of engineering, design, research, and go-to-market teams across many domains. We hold ourselves to a high bar on clarity, rigour, and follow-through - clear strategy, clear roadmaps, clear trade-offs, clear communication. We stay close to the market and to our customers, and we expect every PM to bring an informed point of view.

We look for people who take ownership of outcomes rather than tasks, and who lift the teams around them.

Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services.

SS&C Technologies offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and future. Our benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) plan with company match; paid time off, holidays, and parental leave; and professional development reimbursement opportunity.

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

jobs.description:
Wing is a fast-growing, Silicon Valley-based, venture-backed multinational startup.

We are looking for an exceptional, highly motivated individual to serve as a Client Delivery Operations Manager.

The Client Delivery Operations Manager is responsible for the day-to-day management, visibility, and operational health of Wing's end-to-end client fulfillment pipeline.This role ensures that opportunities and accounts move efficiently through each stage of the business, from Sales handoff, talent requirements, recruitment and staffing, candidate presentation, client selection, onboarding, launch, and early account stabilization.

The Client Delivery Operations Manager serves as the central operational owner of the pipeline, continuously monitoring movement, identifying bottlenecks, enforcing timelines, coordinating cross-functional teams, and resolving process gaps that could delay revenue, staffing, or client activation.

This is not primarily an administrative tracking role. The position is expected to actively manage the pipeline, challenge stalled items, drive accountability, escalate risks, and improve the underlying processes that keep the pipeline moving.

Key Responsibilities

    1. End-to-End Pipeline Management

    • Own the daily operational management of Wing's active pipeline.
    • Maintain visibility across every account and requirement from Sales handoff through successful launch.
    • Ensure every pipeline item has a clear status, owner, next action, and expected completion date.
    • Monitor accounts that are stalled, delayed, blocked, or at risk.
    • Proactively follow up with responsible teams to move accounts forward.
    • Ensure pipeline stages accurately reflect the actual operational status of each account.

      2. Pipeline Health Monitoring

      • Conduct daily reviews of pipeline movement and outstanding requirements.
      • Identify aging accounts, stalled stages, capacity issues, and process bottlenecks.
      • Flag accounts at risk of missing staffing or launch timelines.
      • Monitor pipeline volume against available recruitment, staffing, onboarding, and operational capacity.
      • Maintain clear visibility into what is entering, moving through, and exiting the pipeline.

        3. Cross-Functional Coordination

        Work closely with:
        • Sales
        • Customer Success
        • Talent Acquisition
        • Staffing
        • Onboarding
        • Training
        • Operations
        • Product or specialized service teams
        • Finance and other support teams when required
        • Ensure clean handoffs between departments and prevent accounts from being delayed because of unclear ownership or incomplete information.

          4. Sales-to-Operations Handoff

          • Review newly closed accounts and confirm that operational requirements are complete.
          • Validate role requirements, client expectations, staffing needs, timelines, and special conditions.
          • Identify incomplete, unrealistic, or unclear requirements before they create downstream delays.
          • Coordinate with Sales when clarification or expectation resetting is required.
          • Ensure specialized products or services follow the correct operational process.

            5. Staffing and Candidate Pipeline Oversight

            • Monitor recruitment and staffing progress against client requirements.
            • Track candidate availability, endorsement, interviews, client selections, replacements, and pending decisions.
            • Identify roles with insufficient candidate supply or prolonged staffing timelines.
            • Coordinate with Talent Acquisition and Staffing leadership on priority requirements.
            • Escalate accounts requiring intervention, sourcing adjustments, compensation review, or expectation management.

              6. Client Selection and Decision Management

              • Track candidates presented to clients and outstanding client decisions.
              • Ensure follow-ups occur within established timelines.
              • Identify accounts where client responsiveness is delaying fulfillment.
              • Coordinate with CSMs, OBS, Sales, or account owners when client intervention is required.
              • Maintain visibility into candidate rejection reasons and recurring selection barriers.

                7. Onboarding and Launch Readiness

                • Monitor accounts approaching onboarding and launch.
                • Confirm that staffing, documentation, equipment, access, training, schedules, and client requirements are ready.
                • Surface launch risks before they become client-facing issues.
                • Coordinate resolution between responsible departments.
                • Ensure accounts transition cleanly from pipeline management into normal account operations.

                  8. Pipeline Escalation Management

                  Serve as the first operational escalation point for pipeline-related issues. Examples include:
                  • Staffing delays
                  • Missing client requirements
                  • Candidate shortages
                  • Interview delays
                  • Client decision delays
                  • Incorrect Sales handoffs
                  • Compensation mismatches
                  • Training capacity concerns
                  • Onboarding blockers
                  • Ownership gaps
                  • System or CRM inaccuracies
                  • Accounts repeatedly moving backward in the pipeline
                  • Determine the appropriate owner, establish an action plan, and monitor the issue until resolution.

                    9. Pipeline Governance and Accountability

                    • Establish and enforce pipeline SLAs.
                    • Ensure teams update their respective pipeline stages consistently.
                    • Hold stakeholders accountable for overdue actions.
                    • Require clear next steps for every active account.
                    • Escalate repeated SLA breaches or operational blockers to leadership.
                    • Ensure pipeline meetings focus on decisions and corrective actions rather than status reporting alone.

                      10. Pipeline Reporting and Forecasting

                      Provide leadership with clear visibility into:
                      • Total active pipeline
                      • New accounts entering the pipeline
                      • Accounts staffed
                      • Accounts awaiting candidates
                      • Accounts awaiting client decisions
                      • Accounts scheduled for launch
                      • Aging by pipeline stage
                      • Average time spent per stage
                      • Staffing turnaround time
                      • Bottleneck trends
                      • At-risk accounts
                      • Projected launches
                      • Expected revenue activation
                      • Pipeline capacity and resource constraints
                      • Produce weekly and monthly pipeline health reports with clear recommendations and required leadership actions.

                        11. Process Improvement

                        • Continuously evaluate how accounts move through Wing's pipeline.
                        • Identify unnecessary steps, duplicated work, unclear ownership, and communication gaps.
                        • Design improved workflows and escalation protocols.
                        • Recommend automation opportunities.
                        • Partner with system owners to improve CRM and pipeline architecture.
                        • Standardize handoff requirements between departments.
                        • Document processes, SLAs, escalation paths, and ownership matrices.
                        • Measure whether process changes improve pipeline velocity and client experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience in operations, program management, revenue operations, staffing operations, customer success operations, or similar environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex workflows involving multiple departments.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfortable working with high-volume operational pipelines.

  • Strong understanding of SLAs, workflow management, escalation management, and process optimization.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and follow-through.

  • Ability to challenge teams constructively and drive accountability.

  • Strong written and verbal communication.

  • Experience using CRM, project management, reporting, and workflow management platforms.

  • Ability to interpret operational data and convert findings into actionable recommendations.

  • Able to travel to the Philippines as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in BPO, outsourcing, staffing, recruitment, SaaS, or service-based organizations.

  • Experience managing client implementation or fulfillment pipelines.

  • Experience working across Sales, Recruitment, Customer Success, and Operations.

  • Familiarity with HubSpot, ClickUp, Power BI, or similar systems

  • Experience designing SLAs, dashboards, workflow automation, or operational governance.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Senior Records Information Management Specialist for a project that supports a large-scale outreach and engagement effort, delivering strategic communications, content and creative services, digital strategy, and audience engagement across public-facing websites, applications, and social media platforms. The work is paired with the IT, cybersecurity, and data operations needed to keep that digital presence secure, reliable, and available around the clock. The program's mission is to ensure the intended audience receives timely, accurate, and accessible information about the programs, services, and policies that affect them — with content and platforms built to scale, adapt to changing needs, and hold up to federal compliance and security standards.

The Senior Records Information Management Specialist will lead the design, governance, and day-to-day administration of the program's records management function, ensuring that electronic records generated across public-facing websites, applications, and social media platforms are properly captured, controlled, archived, and preserved in accordance with federal recordkeeping law and DoD policy. This role serves as the primary bridge between the content operation and the Government Records Manager, translating recordkeeping requirements into practical, user-centric processes that content and digital teams can execute consistently.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award by our client, with a defined performance period of one year with two one-year option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $92,000 – $95,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Administer the organization's records management program, ensuring records of business and mission activity are properly identified, scheduled, captured, and preserved in compliance with federal recordkeeping law and DoD records management policy.

  • Develop, implement, and annually update records management SOPs and guidance, keeping pace with evolving Federal, DoD, and program-specific policy.

  • Develop and maintain a records management plan governing the transfer, accessioning, and eventual disposition of permanent electronic records to the appropriate federal archival authority, and lead execution of related transfer activities.

  • Conduct periodic compliance reviews and risk assessments of the records program, documenting gaps and recommending corrective actions to leadership.

  • Partner with the Government Records Manager and content stakeholders to design intuitive, user-centric records management systems and workflows; conduct user research to identify pain points and streamline compliance.

  • Direct archiving and digital preservation activities, including secure storage, metadata tagging and indexing, and backup/disaster-recovery practices that ensure long-term accountability, availability, and integrity of records.

  • Ensure archived and published content remains tamper-proof, verifiable, and retained per applicable records schedules, conducting regular audits of archiving, access-control, and publishing workflows.

  • Establish and enforce access-control, permissions, and audit-trail practices across content systems to maintain a defensible chain of custody.

  • Ensure records considerations are reflected in broader digital strategy planning, content governance, and reporting.

  • Deliver required records-related compliance and status reporting on established schedules, and brief findings and recommendations to Government stakeholders.

  • Provide subject-matter guidance and training to content and digital teams on records identification, tagging, and retention responsibilities.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified/trained to perform

Qualifications:

  • This position requires an active Secret Clearance.

  • BA/BS in Information Science, Library/Archival Studies, Records Management, or a related field.

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in records information management, including electronic records management within a federal or DoD environment.

  • Demonstrated working knowledge of federal records management law, DoD recordkeeping policy, and archival transfer/accessioning processes.

  • Experience developing and maintaining records management SOPs, retention schedules, and compliance reporting.

  • Experience working within a content management system (CMS) environment and coordinating with cross-functional content/digital teams.

  • Strong written communication skills, with experience producing compliance and governance reporting for government stakeholders.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Certified Records Manager (CRM) or Information Governance Professional (IGP) certification.

  • Familiarity with cloud-hosted content environments and associated backup and disaster-recovery controls.

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Sales Service Representative to support inbound sales inquiries and deliver exceptional customer service to individuals seeking debt settlement and debt consolidation solutions.

This is a consultative sales role focused primarily on inbound leads, while also conducting follow-up outreach to help prospective clients make informed financial decisions. You’ll build trust, understand each client’s unique situation, and guide them toward the most suitable solution with empathy and professionalism.

If you’re passionate about helping people, enjoy building relationships, and thrive in customer-focused sales environments, this is an excellent opportunity to grow your career.

Nurse Practitioner

Integrated Women’s Care (IWC)Employment Type: Full-Time
FLSA Status: Exempt

Reports To: Nurse Practitioner Manager
Work Location: Remote — work must be completed within the United States

You built your career caring for women at a time when the healthcare system largely ignored them. You know HRT, you understand the complexity of perimenopause, and you’ve spent years earning the clinical instincts it takes to actually get this right. Now you want to do it at scale — for more patients, with fewer barriers, and in a practice model that matches how you already think and work.

That’s what Midi is. A fully virtual, fast-paced clinical environment built specifically around women’s midlife health — and designed for NPs who are ready to practice at their best.

THE ROLE

You’ll carry a full patient panel, managing perimenopause, menopause, weight, sexual health, mood, and sleep — all virtually. This is ongoing, relationship-based care, which means your patients come back to you — visit after visit, over months and years. You’ll prescribe and independently manage HRT (estrogen, progesterone, testosterone), evaluate patients for pharmacologic weight management including GLP-1 therapies, and make autonomous clinical decisions every day.

It’s a high-volume environment. Documentation, follow-through, and productivity benchmarks are part of the job — and the NPs who thrive here don’t fight that reality, they’re built for it. If you’re the kind of clinician who runs efficient visits without sacrificing warmth, closes every loop without being reminded, and moves comfortably between patients and platforms, you’ll feel at home here.

WHO THRIVES HERE

Our most successful NPs tend to share a few things in common:

  • They are genuinely passionate about women’s midlife health — this isn’t a stopover, it’s their calling
  • They are fluent with technology — EHR, video, AI scribe tools, Slack, clinical decision support — and they adapt quickly when tools change
  • They hold themselves to a high standard without needing to be managed toward it
  • They can carry a full panel, hit productivity targets, and still make every patient feel like the only one
  • They’ve practiced independently long enough to trust their own clinical judgment
  • They believe that listening deeply and documenting accurately are both forms of excellent care

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Active board certification: FNP-C / FNP-BC or WHNP-BC
  • 3+ years independently managing perimenopause and menopause patients
  • 3+ years independently prescribing and titrating HRT
  • 3+ years managing a continuous NP patient panel — building ongoing relationships and making autonomous clinical decisions over time
  • 3+ years of synchronous telemedicine experience
  • 1+ year evaluating and prescribing pharmacologic weight management therapies, including GLP-1 agonists
  • Multiple active state licenses (Including Pennsylvania)
  • Preferred: certification in Menopause (MSCP) and/or Obesity Medicine

WHY MIDI

  • A patient population that is engaged, informed, and deeply grateful for real care
  • Full clinical autonomy within a supportive, protocol-driven framework
  • Fully remote with scheduling between 7am–7pm patient local time
  • Desirable benefits package
  • Accredited training eligible for Continuing Education (CE)
  • Clinician Professional Development Allowance
  • Paid time off
  • A team that takes women’s health as seriously as you do

WORKING ENVIRONMENT

This is a fully remote position requiring reliable high-speed internet access and the ability to work effectively in a virtual environment. The role involves prolonged computer use, including extended periods of sitting, video conferencing, and electronic documentation. To support patient access and business needs, occasional evening, weekend, or multi-time-zone coverage may be required.

At this time, Midi is unable to provide visa sponsorship. All Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship needs.

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Senior AI Automation Engineer

Mexico (Virtual)

Role Overview:
Shape the architecture and engineering standards behind automation systems that improve how Genesys operates at scale. As a Senior AI Automation Engineer within IT, you will own the design and delivery of production-grade automation across a portfolio spanning established RPA solutions, modern browser automation, API-driven workflows, and emerging AI and agentic systems.

You will set technical direction for complex automation initiatives, making architectural decisions around reliability, modularity, observability, testing, security, cost, and long-term maintainability. The role combines hands-on software engineering with strategic ownership, including responsibility for keeping business-critical RPA automations reliable while determining when modernization through Playwright, APIs, AI, or agentic approaches creates meaningful value.

Working across IT, engineering, and business teams, you will translate complex process challenges into scalable automation solutions and influence how Genesys applies technologies such as Python, JavaScript or TypeScript, LLMs, and enterprise AI platforms. Your work will help reduce operational risk, improve automation performance, and enable teams to solve higher-value business problems with greater efficiency and reliability.

This role offers visibility into enterprise automation and AI initiatives while providing opportunities to expand your influence across architecture, engineering standards, and AI-enabled operations. You will help Genesys advance practical, customer-focused innovation through thoughtful technical decisions, strong collaboration, and ownership of systems that deliver measurable value.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the end-to-end architecture and delivery of complex automation systems, establishing scalable approaches to modularity, error handling, state management, observability, testing, and long-term maintainability
  • Define automation engineering standards across code structure, testing practices, deployment patterns, version control, documentation, and architectural conventions to improve consistency and production reliability
  • Lead technical design reviews for automation initiatives, identifying architectural risks, scalability constraints, integration dependencies, and operational considerations before significant engineering investment is committed
  • Drive the reliability and modernization of the existing RPA portfolio, using operational data and engineering judgment to determine which automations should be maintained, refactored, migrated, or replaced
  • Lead transitions from legacy RPA solutions to Playwright, API-native automation, or other modern approaches when they provide clear technical and business value, while protecting continuity of business operations
  • Design and productionize AI-integrated and multi-step agentic workflows that combine LLM reasoning, tool use, APIs, and deterministic process logic while addressing context management, failure recovery, output reliability, and cost
  • Integrate enterprise AI platforms, including Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise, and Amazon Q, into automation pipelines while managing APIs, model or platform versioning, prompt strategies, and output quality as engineering concerns
  • Partner with IT, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate ambiguous process challenges into scalable automation requirements, drive alignment on technical tradeoffs, and constructively challenge assumptions that could create brittle solutions
  • Instrument automation systems with telemetry for execution reliability, volume, latency, failures, and cost, using operational insights to improve architecture and guide portfolio prioritization
  • Provide technical leadership on high-complexity automation initiatives by decomposing work into deliverable increments, reviewing code and designs, mentoring teammates, and resolving implementation decisions that require advanced engineering judgment

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in automation engineering, software engineering, systems integration, or a related discipline, including substantial experience delivering and supporting automation solutions in production
  • Strong proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript or TypeScript, with the ability to write production-quality code, conduct effective code reviews, and make independent architectural decisions
  • Hands-on experience with RPA platforms such as Automation Anywhere, Microsoft Power Automate, UiPath, or equivalent, including maintaining production automations, diagnosing failures, and managing changes to dependent systems
  • Demonstrated expertise designing resilient automation systems with retry strategies, alerting, state management, observability, and recovery paths incorporated into the architecture
  • Hands-on experience integrating REST APIs, including authentication patterns, rate limiting, pagination, error handling, and orchestration across multiple services
  • Strong background in software engineering principles, including system design, maintainable code, testing, version control, and production-grade delivery
  • Proven track record of establishing or contributing to engineering standards covering areas such as code review, automated testing, documentation, deployment practices, or architectural patterns
  • Demonstrated ability to make sound technical decisions across legacy and modern automation technologies, balancing reliability, scalability, maintainability, cost, and business value
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working across technical and business teams to clarify requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and guide complex initiatives

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Playwright or comparable browser automation frameworks, or demonstrated success adopting new automation technologies quickly
  • Experience building production agentic AI systems using frameworks such as LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent, including context management, tool calling, reliability, and cost considerations
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment practices, and version control workflows applied to automation systems
  • Background in enterprise IT operations, IT service management (ITSM), systems integration, or large-scale business process automation
  • Experience integrating large language models or enterprise AI platforms into production automation workflows
  • Familiarity with monitoring, telemetry, and observability practices for measuring automation reliability, performance, usage, and cost

  • A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work.

Location: Mexico
Project type: One-time paid project
Time commitment: Approximately 1–2 hours
Compensation: $75 for completing the project activity

About the opportunity

CloudFactory is looking for participants to support a short-term transaction validation project that we are administering on behalf of a global payments processing company.

The project is designed to help evaluate the accuracy of how payment transactions are matched to individuals.

As a participant, you'll review a set of recent payment transactions and indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself.

How it works

If selected for the project:

  1. You'll provide the email address(es) you use with selected merchants, subscriptions, apps, or online accounts.
  2. Our payments processing client will use those email address(es) to identify payment transactions it believes are associated with you and securely provide a list of those transactions for the project.
  3. You'll be presented with approximately 50 recent transactions from the last 3 months through the designated project platform. The information shown may include details such as the merchant name, date, amount, payment method, card identifier, and card issuer to help you recognize each transaction.
  4. You'll indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself and, where helpful, add a short note.

The activity is expected to take approximately 1–2 hours.

You will not be asked to provide or upload your own transaction history, bank statements, full card number, online banking login credentials, banking password, PIN, or CVV.

Please note that this is a data validation activity only.

Requirements

To participate, you must:

  • Be 18 years of age or older.
  • Currently reside in Mexico.
  • Be an active debit and/or credit card user.
  • Have made purchases or payments within the last three months across a variety of merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be able to recognize your own recent purchases and transactions.
  • Have access to the email address(es) you use with the merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be comfortable providing those email address(es) if selected for the project.
  • Be willing to review approximately 50 transactions and confirm whether or not you recognize them as your own.

Privacy and consent

Because this project involves personal and financial transaction information, privacy and informed consent are essential.

Before participating, you'll receive our Participant Consent & Confidentiality Terms, which explain how your personal information and transaction data will be used and processed as part of the project.

If you qualify and provide your consent, relevant payment transactions will be securely provided to CloudFactory by the end-customer and made available to you through the designated project platform for validation.

You may withdraw your consent and participation in accordance with the terms provided to you before the project begins.

Interested? Complete our short eligibility questionnaire to be considered for this paid project.

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
