En Espiral MS, empresa tecnológica certificada por Great Place to Work®, buscamos incorporar a una persona para el puesto Customer Success Manager, y unirse al equipo comercial de Proactivanet®, herramienta líder en ITSM (Gestión de Servicios de TI) e ITAM (Gestión de Activos de TI) en España y Latinoamérica.

Sobre nosotros

Somos una compañía con presencia en 5 países, más de 500 grandes organizaciones clientes en todo el mundo y un equipo de más de 100 profesionales apasionados por la tecnología y el servicio.
Vivimos una etapa de crecimiento y expansión internacional, y nuestra cultura se basa en tres pilares fundamentales:

  • Compromiso con las personas.

  • Compromiso con el éxito de nuestra clientela.

  • Compromiso con la excelencia en todo lo que hacemos.

En Grupo Espiral creemos en el trabajo en equipo, el aprendizaje continuo y en disfrutar del camino mientras alcanzamos grandes resultados. Estamos además certificados por Great Place to Work®, que nos reconoce como un excelente lugar para trabajar.

Tu misión

Buscamos un/a Customer Success Manager con base técnica sólida capaz de asegurar adopción, valor y expansión en cuentas estratégicas, orquestando personas, procesos e integración de la herramienta.

Como Customer Success Manager, serás clave para garantizar el éxito de nuestros clientes a lo largo de toda su experiencia con Proactivanet. Tu objetivo: construir relaciones estratégicas, de confianza y duraderas, ayudando a que cada cliente alcance sus metas gracias a un uso óptimo de nuestra solución.

¿Qué harás? (responsabilidades clave)

  • Plan de éxito por cuenta: definir y facilitar hojas de ruta técnicas, KPIs y gobernanza, asesorando estratégicamente a los clientes para alinear sus objetivos de negocio con Proactivanet.

  • Onboarding técnico/funcional: orientado al proceso, en coordinación con Preventa/Soporte para promover la adopción efectiva de la herramienta.

  • Adopción y cambio: impulsar comunicaciones, formación y adopción según cada perfil de cliente, coordinando con Consultoría/Soporte acciones técnicas cuando aplique.

  • Voz del cliente y valor: recoger feedback estructurado, documentar casos de uso/ROI, preparar reportes ejecutivos y generar referencias.

  • Gestión de cartera: priorizar acciones de impacto, mitigar riesgos de churn, identificar expansión (up/cross).

  • Métricas: GRR >95%, NPS > +45, Churn <3%, TTFV ≤30 días, TTV ≤90 días, utilización de licencias >85%.

Qué no es este puesto

  • No es soporte, implementación, ni “solo cuentas”: es un rol de éxito técnico y de negocio.

  • No es preventa pura: aunque colaborarás estrechamente, el foco es adopción, valor y renovaciones.

Requirements

Lo que buscamos

  • 3+ años en Customer Success / TAM / Consultoría en entornos tecnológicos (idealmente SaaS).

  • Conocimiento de ITIL (ideal ITIL 4 Foundation o superior).

  • Alfabetización tecnológica conversacional: comprender a nivel conceptual API/SSO/Directorio/CMDB/Discovery para liderar la conversación y traducir necesidades a requerimientos para los equipos técnicos.

  • Español nativo/C2 y inglés mínimo C1 (reuniones y documentación).

  • Enfoque consultivo, orientación a resultados y excelentes habilidades comunicativas.

  • Gestión de stakeholders: trabajo con sponsors, áreas TI y negocio; capacidad de priorizar un backlog de valor y coordinar con Consultoría/Soporte/Producto.

Deseables

  • Certificaciones ITIL intermedias, ISO 20000/27001 u otras afines.

  • Experiencia con clientes enterprise en España y con áreas de Seguridad/Compliance.

  • Experiencia en plataformas ITSM/ITAM (p. ej., Proactivanet, ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, BMC, Ivanti, ManageEngine, Freshservice).

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Somos conscientes de que el talento es nuestro mayor activo y nos esforzamos en cuidarlo ofreciéndote un entorno equitativo, diverso e inclusivo:

  • Formar parte de un proyecto líder y en expansión internacional.

  • Integrarte en un equipo donde el talento y las personas son lo más importante.

  • Aprender, crecer y aportar en un entorno innovador, colaborativo y dinámico.

  • Trabajo remoto desde España, con disponibilidad para viajar ocasionalmente a nuestras oficinas en Gijón y a visitar clientes en distintas regiones de España.

  • Horario flexible para facilitar la conciliación trabajo-vida personal. No se trabaja los viernes por la tarde, fines de semana ni festivos. Horario de verano intensivo para disfrutar de tardes libres.

  • Formación intensiva a cargo de la empresa. Te formaremos en aspectos técnicos y marcos de gestión que te permitirán mejorar tus capacidades e impulsar tu carrera profesional en un entorno altamente innovador.

  • Estabilidad profesional, continuidad y crecimiento profesional en un proyecto en expansión. Salario en función de la valía y experiencia de la persona candidata.

  • Dietas adicionales en caso de desplazamiento.

  • Programa de beneficios corporativo.

Si te apasiona construir relaciones sólidas, te motiva el éxito de tus clientes y te encanta trabajar en equipo dentro de un entorno tecnológico en plena expansión…

¡Nos encantará conocerte!

jobs.excerpt: Chef Robotics is bringing AI into the physical world, starting with one of the world’s largest industries: food manufacturing.
jobs.description:
Chef Robotics is bringing AI into the physical world, starting with one of the world’s largest industries: food manufacturing.

Food production faces one of the most severe labor shortages in the US, with more than 1 million open jobs today and demand continuing to grow. Our robots help manufacturers automate repetitive food-preparation and assembly tasks so they can increase throughput, improve consistency, and keep production onshore.

Today, Chef robots operate in production facilities across North America and Europe, serving customers including Amy’s Kitchen, gategroup, and CookUnity. Our robots have made over 100 million servings in production, creating the world’s largest proprietary dataset for AI-powered manipulation of deformable food. Every meal our robots produce makes the system smarter.

Backed by leading investors including Avataar Ventures, Construct Capital, Bloomberg Beta, Promus Ventures, and Kleiner Perkins, we’re scaling rapidly with a robotics-as-a-service (RaaS) model and long-term customer partnerships. Our team includes engineers and leaders from Google, Cruise, Tesla, Amazon Robotics, Dexterity, Bear Robotics, Saildrone, and Zoox, united by a mission to build intelligent machines that solve meaningful problems in the real world.

If you’re excited about solving hard problems, creating real customer impact, and shipping systems that operate in production every day, not just in the lab, you’ll feel at home at Chef.

About The Role

As a Key Account Executive, you will own the full sales cycle, from outbound discovery and demos to complex negotiations and closing. You will be a foundational member of our enterprise team, shaping how enterprise sales are built at Chef Robotics.

What You’ll Do:

  • Manage multi-stakeholder buying processes within large-scale food manufacturing and contract manufacturing firms.
  • Drive enterprise-grade deals with an average contract value (ACV) ranging from $100K to $1M.
  • Own the end-to-end sales process, including discovery, demos, and proposals, with the support of a strong SDR and technical team.
  • As an early member of the enterprise team, you will help define the Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) and the future of our sales motion.

Who You Are:

  • You have a proven track record of navigating complex organizations and closing deals that move the needle for the business.
  • You thrive in high-stakes environments and are motivated by closing six-figure enterprise deals.
  • You are excited by the prospect of deploying AI and robotics to solve critical labor challenges in the food industry.
  • You enjoy the "inflection point" stage of a startup—where the product is proven, but there is still significant room to shape the direction of the company.

Why Join Us Now?

  • We are in a sector that has been slow to adopt automation but is now moving fast.
  • Join a team heading into a Series B with a pipeline that is already outgrowing our current capacity.
  • This is a window where career-defining deals are made, and you will have a direct hand in scaling a leader in AI robotics.

Chef Robotics is solving one of the hardest problems in AI: bringing intelligence into the physical world.

Our robots are already operating in production facilities every day, generating the real-world data that powers the next generation of embodied AI. If you want to build technology that leaves the lab, ships to customers, and transforms an industry, Chef is the place to do it.

Sales Manager (B2B Sales, Team Leadership & Revenue Growth)

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Sales Manager to lead, coach, and scale a high-performing B2B sales team.

This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll drive revenue growth by improving team performance, optimizing sales processes, and owning pipeline management and forecasting. If you have a proven track record of leading successful sales teams and consistently achieving revenue targets, this is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Required Experience & Skills

  • Strong understanding of the complete sales cycle.
  • Experience with CRM platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
  • Excellent leadership, coaching, communication, and analytical skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, agency, or high-growth startup environments.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent team quota attainment and revenue growth.
  • Healthy pipeline and improved conversion rates.
  • Accurate forecasting and CRM discipline.
  • High-performing, engaged sales team.
  • Scalable sales processes that drive long-term growth.

Interview Process

  • Initial Recruiter Screening
  • Recruiter Interview
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. It’s a short, self-recorded video that completes your application and allows hiring managers to get to know you before the interview process begins.

Rather than repeating your background during multiple screening calls, you’ll tell your story once, allowing future interviews to focus on meaningful conversations.

Don’t overthink it—you can record as many takes as you’d like before submitting. Your invitation will come from Spark Hire, so please check both your inbox and spam folder.

jobs.title: Instructional Content Writer and Editor
jobs.excerpt: Job PostingSick of commuting?  Tired of “hybrid” jobs that are really “in office” jobs in disguise?
jobs.description:
Job Posting

Sick of commuting? Tired of “hybrid” jobs that are really “in office” jobs in disguise? If you’re discovering that you’re more productive at home than in an office, and want to make that arrangement permanent, we may have the position you’re after.

At CarriersEdge, we’re focused on producing great quality products and happy customers. We don’t care about being the coolest company in town, having the most amazing office perks, or the hippest staff. If you’re interested in those things, you’ll hate us.

On the other hand, if you’re not looking for a social group and just want to do great work, then you may be exactly what we’re looking for. We don’t care where you work and we won’t be looking over your shoulder micromanaging you. You’ll have minimal meetings disrupting your week, and plenty of time to focus on doing the best job possible. We’re growing quickly, but not so quickly that things are chaotic.

As part of that growth, we’ve got an opening for an InstructionalContent Writer and Editor.

The ideal candidate has a keen eye for detail, a solid foundation in the skills outlined below, and a passion to continually improve those skills. This isn’t an agency where you’ll get buried under endless client projects, a marketing job where you're writing sales pitches, or contract writing position churning out blog postings.

We’re serving an industry undergoing massive transformation and we need great storytellers who can produce well-researched, accurate, and engaging content to support people through that transformation.

About you

  • You love long-form writing and enjoy all stages of the process, from research to editing.
  • You have a proven ability to turn complex material into easily understood content.
  • You have extensive experience with research and looking at regulations doesn’t make you cringe.
  • You’re able to collaborate effectively as part of a team, but also comfortable completing work on your own.
  • You have extra-sharp communication skills and you’re not afraid to ask questions.
  • You are willing to occasionally travel to and participate in industry events.
  • You can’t stand bad Spelling or Grammar. The incorrect use of capitals in the previous sentence is driving you crazy right now.
  • You’re eager to learn a new industry and are not afraid to learn new tools for content development.

Your typical week

Day to day, you will work with other content writers to develop course material on subjects relating to regulatory changes, human resource topics, and other task-specific skills for the transportation industry.

You will be responsible for the comprehensive outline, storyboard, final test and audio script and will work with translators, graphic designers and voice-over artists to bring the words to life in a final online form using CarriersEdge proprietary tools.

In a normal week, you will spend time researching the subject matter for your current topic, writing storyboards and content, participating in reviews with senior team members, and assembling the various components into a finished product. Through the research-organize-write-review process, your stories will continue to evolve until they create an engaging narrative that can be applied to real world activities.

As part of a remote team, you will connect with team members across the company through Slack, email, and Zoom.

You’ll participate in occasional in-person meetings, attend industry events, and visit customer sites to oversee photoshoots in support of your content creation. You’ll track activities in weekly status reports.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • At least 6 years of experience with long-form writing in a professional capacity (e.g., technical writer or educational material/course developer)
  • Demonstrated ability to research subject matter and create stories that include accurate information and details
  • Demonstrated ability to tell a story through your writing that doesn’t rely on regurgitated bullet points
  • Expert knowledge of spelling, grammar and writing style, and the ability to use Microsoft Word styles, tables, tracking and other advanced features
  • Excellent attention to detail, so please find a way to mention soup in your cover letter
  • Ability to adapt your workflow to fit established processes
  • A portfolio of your work. You must be able to produce samples of your past work or projects that demonstrate your skills to be considered for this position.
  • You reside in Canada

Additional notes

  • Principals only, no recruiters please.
  • This role has a salary range of $60,000–$80,000 annually. Actual compensation within this range will be based on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location.
  • CarriersEdge provides an inclusive workplace, welcoming and encouraging people of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. Accommodations are available upon requests for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Join us on the Sales team as a Sales Director, and help shape the future of safer, more efficient, and more reliable operations across the globe. Start your journey with Anova today!

You’ll take Business Development Representative (BDR)-sourced opportunities and run point on Enterprise and Mid-Market deals, turning Anova’s IIoT tank-monitoring data into a business case that drives real decisions for fuels & lubricant distributors leadership teams. What you’ll need to succeed:

Minimum Requirements -

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and professional experience
  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise or mid-market B2B sales, with a track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota
  • Experience managing a full sales cycle in complex, multi-stakeholder deals (6+ month cycles)

  • Experience negotiating and finalizing contract terms and pricing

  • Self-starter with strong time and territory management skills

Preferred Qualifications -

  • Experience selling into the fuels, lubricants, or oil & gas distribution industry
  • Experience in adjacent industries such as supply chain, logistics, chemical distribution, or other industrial verticals
  • Experience in IIoT, industrial technology, SaaS, or telemetry/monitoring solutions
  • Familiarity with structured sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC/MEDDPICC, Challenger)
  • Experience owning renewal/expansion motions in addition to net-new logo acquisition
  • Adept at learning and positioning new technology hardware/cloud-based platforms against competitive alternatives

We are very proudly “one” Anova — built by integrating the best in IIoT technology and expertise. Anova monitors more than 1,250,000 assets across nearly 80 countries for over 2000 clients, from family businesses to the largest LPG, Industrial Gases, and chemicals companies in the world. We believe that rewarding work should reward you. As part of Anova, your work, integrity, and commitment are rewarded through competitive compensation and reward strategies, through sincere appreciation, and through opportunities for growth and advancement. We put people first by providing benefits that support your life and well-being, from health and finance to recognition and reward, and so much more — we've got you covered.

Career-defining. Life-changing.

At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

About This Role:

About This Role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically skilled Biostatistician/Data Analyst III to support the design, analysis, documentation, and reporting of clinical and healthcare-related activities. This position provides ongoing statistical and SAS programming support for Quality, production-related analyses, FDA and other regulatory topics, clinical studies, and scientific communications, with a focus on cardiology medical devices. The role requires strong statistical expertise and advanced proficiency in SAS programming to ensure the integrity, accuracy, and traceability of analyses used by cross-functional teams and in regulatory submissions.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Design and analyze clinical trials and observational studies in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
    - Develop and validate SAS programs for data manipulation, statistical analysis, and report generation.
    - Create and review statistical analysis plans (SAPs), study protocols, and data specifications.
    - Perform quality control checks on datasets, tables, listings, and figures (TLFs), including materials supporting Quality and regulatory activities.
    - Conduct statistical analyses using SAS and interpret results in the context of study objectives, quality questions, production needs, and FDA topics.
    - Provide statistical consultation and programming support to Clinical Research, Quality, Production, and other cross-functional teams.
    - Support FDA remediation, regulatory submissions, responses to agency questions, and associated documentation in compliance with applicable standards (e.g., CDISC, FDA, ICH).
    - Present statistical findings and explain analytical methods to internal and external stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.
    - Maintain and apply current statistical methodologies, SAS programming techniques, and best practices for data quality and reproducibility.

Experience and Minimum Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in Biostatistics, Statistics, or a related field.
  • At least 3 years of biostatistics or statistics work experience.
    - Strong proficiency in SAS programming (Base, Macro, SQL, and Statistical procedures).
    - Experience with clinical trial data and regulatory submissions (e.g., CDISC SDTM/ADaM standards).
    - Knowledge of statistical methods such as regression, survival analysis, and mixed models.
    - Familiarity with other statistical software (e.g., R, STATA) is a plus.
    - Excellent problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
    - Ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines with high attention to detail.

jobs.description:
Websites are crucial for businesses—helping them get found and chosen online. Yet for many small businesses, websites become a burden. They launch with high hopes, spending countless hours on every little detail, aiming for perfection. But soon after launch... no more updates. The website sits untouched, slowly becoming outdated, broken, and buried by search engines, eventually joining the ranks of the "living dead" websites in the vast online cemetery.

To address this issue, CentralApp (soon rebranding to ) is moving away from a template-first approach (such as Wordpress or Wix) and is developing an innovative method for website creation. This new approach integrates numerous pre-designed business modules, alongside a branding engine that offers millions of possibilities. This combination aims to deliver an optimal design and content with minimal effort.

Our solution is currently used by thousands of businesses across Europe, mostly in France, Belgium, Italy & Spain.

In addition to our website product, we offer a suite of tools designed to enhance your impact: an Integration Marketplace, Advanced Website Forms, Client inbox & clients list, Local SEO with Listing Management, an Instagram Wall, and a Review Wall.

What will you be doing?

This is not a narrow frontend role or backend role

We are looking for a Product Engineer who can take an ambiguous product problem and drive it to production: clarify the user experience, define the expected behavior, prototype quickly, implement the frontend, shape the API contract, and work with backend owners to ship the full solution.

Your strongest execution layer should be backend & dev ops. You should be able to review Haskell code independently and maintain a high bar on performance, accessibility, maintainability, and product correctness.

You do not need to be a production front-end engineer aswell (AI will do the translation, or frontend focused colleague can help) but you do need to be able to reason about front-end constraints, including UX and be able to implement Front-end parts of the project you will work on.

Current stack

Our backend includes Haskell services and Node.js

Our frontend stack includes: React, including server-side rendering and Node.js

Our infra is AWS focused.

Responsibilities

As a Product Engineer, you will:

  • Turn ambiguous product problems into clear user flows, product behavior, edge cases, and success criteria.
  • Build and maintain scalable, modular, high-performance frontend code.
  • Review backend and frontend implementation independently across UX, code quality, performance, accessibility, maintainability, and product correctness.
  • Define API contracts and backend expectations clearly.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers on architecture, data models, permissions, error handling, observability, and performance.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate prototyping, implementation, refactoring, testing, debugging, and technical exploration.
  • Critically review AI-generated output and stay accountable for correctness, maintainability, and product quality.
  • Balance speed, simplicity, performance, maintainability, and user experience.
  • Keep the end user, business impact, SEO, accessibility, and product quality in mind.

Requirements

We are looking for a Product Engineer who can operate like a one-person product strike team when needed.

This role is for you if

  • You want to own outcomes end to end: clarify the problem, define the product behavior, implement the frontend, coordinate backend work (or even develop it depending on which service we need to act on), and ship.
  • You are strong enough in frontend to review React code independently, while also reasoning about APIs, data models, permissions, backend constraints, and edge cases.
  • You use AI to move faster, but still trace the logic, adapt the output to the codebase, and verify the result before it reaches review.

This role is not for you if

  • You want a pure frontend implementation role with detailed tickets, finalized designs, and predefined APIs.
  • You expect product managers, designers, or backend engineers to make the hard product and technical decisions before you start.
  • You prefer narrow specialization, heavier process, or avoiding ownership of backend or UX constraints, edge cases, and AI-assisted output quality.

Benefits

  • Remote-first role, with flexibility in how and where you work.
  • Preferred timezone: anywhere between London and Singapore
  • High ownership: you will have real influence over product direction, technical decisions, and the evolution of the stack.
  • Flexible working setup, focused on output, autonomy, and impact rather than rigid process.
  • Opportunity to work across product, design, frontend, backend architecture, and AI-assisted engineering workflows.
  • Small, experienced team where strong contributors can move fast and have visible impact.

IT & Business Systems Administrator
Location: Fully remote opportunity for the right candidate (must reside in the U.S.). Otherwise, hybrid office locations include: Hebron, KY / Cincinnati, OH; Nashville, TN; Denver, CO; Indianapolis, IN.
Salary Range: $65,000–$80,000, depending on experience. Bonus Opportunities.

Company Overview
Would you enjoy using technology to help people work more effectively and support the systems behind complex, high-impact projects?

Connico is a national construction consultancy known for its experienced team and commitment to exceptional client service. With deep experience in aviation and complex infrastructure, we are continuing to expand our work across energy, federal, and defense markets.

Behind that work is a growing need for reliable technology, secure systems, efficient workflows, and responsive internal support. Our IT and business systems functions play an important role in keeping our teams connected, productive, and equipped to serve our clients.

Our work is technical, but how we do the work matters just as much as the quality of what we deliver. Our core values of Respect, Integrity, Innovation, Resiliency, Inclusivity, and Thoughtfulness guide how we work with our clients and with one another.

About the Role
Connico is seeking an IT & Business Systems Administrator to serve as a key internal resource for employee technology support, business systems, and cybersecurity compliance.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving everyday technology problems while also working with the systems and processes that support Connico’s project teams. You’ll manage routine employee technology and device needs, administer SharePoint and other business systems, coordinate with external technology partners, and help carry out Connico’s CMMC cybersecurity requirements.

You do not need to arrive as an expert in every system or compliance framework we use. We’re looking for someone with a strong IT foundation, sound troubleshooting judgment, and the ability to learn new systems and take on greater technical depth as they become familiar with Connico’s operations.

What You’ll Do

End-User Support, Devices & Technology Coordination

  • Serve as Connico’s primary internal resource for Tier 1 technology support, resolving routine issues involving connectivity, account access, Microsoft 365, software, printing, peripherals, and other everyday technology needs.
  • Manage employee technology onboarding and offboarding, including device setup and recovery, software installation, accounts, permissions, security groups, and multi-factor authentication.
  • Maintain company devices and coordinate updates, endpoint security, backups, repairs, upgrades, replacements, refresh cycles, and secure disposal.
  • Maintain device, software-license, warranty, and assignment records and support renewals and inventory management.
  • Coordinate with Connico’s external IT consultant and technology vendors when additional expertise is needed and track issues through resolution.
Systems, Workflow & Reporting
  • Administer SharePoint, including user access, permissions, document libraries, site structure, document organization, synchronization, and routine maintenance.
  • Support Connico’s business systems, including Monday.com and Deltek Ajera, with user access, project setup, boards, forms, workflows, and system configuration.
  • Build greater proficiency with system automations and integrations and help improve internal project-management workflows.
  • Support reporting needs and develop or maintain SQL-based reports and dashboards as proficiency with Connico’s systems grows.
  • Partner with Connico’s Digital Transformation team and other stakeholders to identify system and process improvements.
Cybersecurity & CMMC
  • Carry out Connico’s established CMMC and cybersecurity requirements, with support from leadership and external cybersecurity consultants as needed.
  • Support and monitor secured devices, employee accounts, access requirements, endpoint controls, and recurring security checks.
  • Maintain required compliance records and evidence and follow identified issues through remediation.
  • Support recurring CMMC activities, internal and external assessments, and audit readiness.
  • Report suspected security incidents or policy deviations and help reinforce secure technology practices across the organization.
As You Grow in the Role
As you become familiar with Connico’s people, systems, and processes, you’ll take on additional responsibilities such as:
  • Developing more advanced workflows, automations, integrations, reports, and dashboards.
  • Creating user guides, FAQs, technology documentation, and cybersecurity training resources.
  • Supporting employee technology education and following up on recurring training or support needs.
  • Maintaining Connico’s intranet and homepage and coordinating approved public website updates.
What We’re Looking For

Required
  • 3–5 years of experience in IT support, systems administration, software development, technical coordination, or a related role.
  • Strong experience supporting Windows devices, Microsoft 365, software installations, user accounts, access, and common connectivity issues.
  • Working experience administering SharePoint or a comparable document-management environment.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices, endpoint protection, and access management.
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot routine technology issues and determine when escalation is appropriate.
  • Strong organization, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple support needs.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical employees.
  • Curiosity and demonstrated ability to learn new technologies and systems.
Preferred
  • Experience with Monday.com, Deltek Ajera, or comparable business systems.
  • Experience or exposure to SQL, relational databases, dashboards, or reporting tools.
  • Familiarity with CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, or another cybersecurity compliance framework.
  • Experience with compliance documentation, access reviews, audit support, or system-security records.
  • Experience coordinating with outsourced IT providers, cybersecurity consultants, or software vendors.
  • Experience with workflow automation or process improvement.
Who Will Be Successful in This Role?
You may be a strong fit if you:
  • Enjoy solving technology problems and helping employees get back to work quickly.
  • Troubleshoot independently but recognize when an issue needs to be escalated.
  • Are interested in both day-to-day IT and how technology can improve business processes.
  • Communicate comfortably with technical partners and non-technical employees.
  • Are organized, responsive, curious, and motivated to expand your technical capabilities over time.

Compensation
The anticipated salary range for this position is $65,000–$80,000 annually, depending on experience and demonstrated capability.

Candidates are not expected to arrive with expert-level knowledge of every Connico system or CMMC requirement. The strongest candidates will bring the core IT and SharePoint foundation needed to contribute immediately, along with the aptitude to develop broader business-systems, reporting, automation, and compliance capabilities.

Work Location Options
Hybrid (T/W/TH in-office):

  • Hebron, KY (Cincinnati area)
  • Mt. Juliet, TN (Nashville area)
  • Denver, CO
  • Indianapolis, IN

Fully Remote:

  • Fully remote opportunity for the right candidate. Must reside full-time in the U.S.
  • Minimal travel required, up to 10% (site visits, meetings, conferences)

Why Join Connico?
This is an opportunity to do more than resolve support tickets. You will help improve the technology, systems, and workflows that keep Connico’s teams productive and support the delivery of complex projects across the country.

As Connico continues to grow across aviation, infrastructure, energy, federal, and defense markets, our internal technology and business systems are becoming increasingly important. In this role, you will have the opportunity to strengthen day-to-day IT support, improve how employees use core systems, support cybersecurity and CMMC requirements, and help develop more efficient workflows, reporting, and automation over time.

We value people who take ownership, bring solutions, learn quickly, communicate clearly, and look for better ways to work. You will have room to grow your technical capabilities while making a visible impact across the organization.

If you enjoy solving problems, helping people, improving systems, and building broader IT and business-systems experience, we would like to hear from you!

What sets us apart is our unique blend of big tech talent, data scientists, and former NFL personnel, who have a combined 600+ years of NFL experience. Our domain knowledge is augmented by AI and machine learning technologies to create a unique view into many aspects of Football.

We’re hiring a hands-on Computer Vision Engineer to build and improve sports video intelligence models—detection, tracking, pose, event understanding, and multi-view reasoning. You’ll spend most of your time on CV research + applied modeling (experiments, architectures, training, evaluation), and partner with data/platform teammates to ensure your work can ship reliably.

This role is CV-first. A bend toward scalable pipelines / MLOps is a plus, not a requirement. Level (mid vs senior) depends on scope ownership and how independently you can drive results.

Responsibilities

CV Modeling & Experimentation

  • Build and train CV models for sports video: player/ball detection, multi-object tracking, pose/keypoints, event/action recognition, identity association (re-ID).
  • Own the experimentation loop: hypotheses → ablations → error analysis → measurable improvements.
  • Design and maintain evaluation: task-appropriate metrics (e.g., MOT metrics, keypoint accuracy, event precision/recall), dataset slices, and failure taxonomy.
  • Improve data efficiency: augmentations, sampling strategies, handling label noise, weak/self-supervision where helpful.
  • Prototype and iterate on modern architectures (e.g., transformer-based detection/tracking, temporal models, multi-task setups).

Research that Ships

  • Collaborate on dataset + labeling design: formats, schemas, tooling, versioning.
  • Help productionize models: packaging, batch/stream inference patterns, throughput/latency tradeoffs, robustness checks.
  • Add lightweight quality gates: reproducibility, automated eval, regression detection

Qualifications

Must-have:

  • Strong applied CV experience with hands-on model development (not just running existing repos).
  • Solid PyTorch skills: training loops, debugging, data pipelines for vision workloads, DDP basics.
  • Comfort with video CV fundamentals: occlusion, identity switches, temporal consistency, calibration, domain shift.
  • Strong Python engineering and a bias toward measurable outcomes.

Nice-to-have (Bonus):

  • Sports video CV or adjacent domains (multi-agent tracking, pose, crowded scenes).
  • Experience with video tooling (FFmpeg), efficient dataset formats (WebDataset/shards), or streaming/batching to GPUs.
  • MLOps/production experience: model packaging, CI for training/eval, serving (Triton/TorchServe), monitoring.

  • Retirement savings plan (401k) with company match

Job Title: Personalization Science Product Leader, IQVIA Digital

IQVIA Digital powers exceptional brand experiences, delivering innovative solutions based on a customer-first, insights-driven, and integrated omnichannel vision. We provide authenticated, privacy-enhanced data and analytics, innovative fit-for-purpose healthcare technology, and the expertise to enable an effective and adaptable marketing model that drives better quality of care and patient outcomes. IQVIA is the leading global provider of data, advanced analytics, technology solutions and clinical research services for the life sciences industry. Learn more at

Product

The Product team is responsible for defining and executing the vision, strategy, and roadmap for IQVIA Digital's portfolio of data, technology, and media solutions. Through close partnership with clients and cross-functional collaboration with Go-to-Market, Technology, Data Management, and Operations teams, the team translates market insights and customer needs into innovative, scalable products. Built upon IQVIA's industry-leading healthcare data assets and privacy-by-design foundation, these solutions deliver differentiated value to clients, drive business growth, and advance IQVIA Digital's leadership in the healthcare marketing ecosystem.

Role Summary

We are seeking a Director of Product Management to lead a portfolio of data-driven personalization products within IQVIA Digital’s Personalization Science suite. This role will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution of solutions that enable healthcare brands to deliver highly targeted, omnichannel engagement with healthcare providers (HCPs) and consumers, powered by IQVIA’s proprietary data and analytics.

This is a hands-on leadership role at the intersection of data, analytics, and marketing technology—responsible for translating complex healthcare datasets and behavioral signals into scalable, client-facing products that drive measurable engagement and business outcomes.

What You’ll Own

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Define and execute the roadmap for a portfolio of personalization and audience products, including:
    o Behavioral intelligence and engagement platforms (e.g., activity and content consumption insights)

Product Delivery & Execution

Data & Analytics Innovation

o Identity resolution and audience building capabilities

Customer-Centric Product Development

o Validate product-market fit

o Gather requirements and prioritize features
o Ensure products deliver measurable marketing impact
• Incorporate feedback loops into roadmap decisions and product evolution.

Commercial Performance

  • Support go-to-market strategy, including positioning, packaging, and pricing of products.
    • Partner with sales and client teams to drive adoption, growth, and retention.
    • Track performance against product KPIs such as usage, revenue contribution, and client outcomes.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the connective layer across product, engineering, data science, and commercial teams.
    • Drive alignment across stakeholders in a matrixed organization.
    • Ensure products meet privacy, compliance, and consent standards critical to healthcare data usage.

What We’re Looking For

8–12+ years in product management, with experience delivering data-driven or platform-based products

Background in one or more of:

o Marketing technology (martech/adtech)

o Data and analytics platforms

o Healthcare, life sciences, or regulated industries (strongly preferred)

Experience working with:

o Audience segmentation and targeting products
o Behavioral data or digital engagement signals
o AI/ML or predictive modeling (practical application vs theory)

Core Capabilities

  • Strong product execution mindset—comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving delivery
    • Ability to translate complex data and technical concepts into clear product value propositions

Preferred

    • Growth in adoption and revenue across assigned portfolio

Why This Role Matters

Personalization is a core driver of modern healthcare engagement. IQVIA Digital’s Personalization Science platform connects data, analytics, and activation to enable more relevant, human-centered interactions across the care continuum.

In this role, you’ll directly shape how leading healthcare brands engage their audiences—turning complex data into meaningful, scalable experiences.

jobs.description:
Remote role

Sabot Consulting is assembling an independent assessment team to conduct a one-time retrospective assessment lasting four months of a large, multi-year public-sector enterprise modernization program.

This is an assessment engagement, not an implementation. You will not build, configure, integrate, remediate, or operate anything. You will examine what has already been built, review the evidence, interview the people who built it, and reach independent, defensible conclusions for executive leadership. Independence from the program's implementation vendors is a contractual requirement of the engagement.

The scope covers nine assessment domains and 65 discrete assessment requirements: program governance and risk, business process alignment, architecture and design, integration and data management, mainframe and legacy modernization, security and privacy compliance, software development lifecycle and configuration management, testing and quality assurance, and operational readiness. The technology environment includes a major cloud customer relationship management platform, a public cloud infrastructure estate, an enterprise integration platform, a content management platform, intelligent document processing, and a mainframe lift-and-refactor migration.

Deliverables include an assessment management plan, an initial assessment report, recurring status briefings, per-domain assessment reports, readiness assessments, an executive briefing, and a final assessment report.
You will work full time for four months in a small paired-team structure alongside senior peers. Findings go directly to executive leadership and to a legislative oversight body.

Required

  • 10 or more years in cloud architecture with deep Amazon Web Services (AWS) experience — network design, identity and access management, security groups, monitoring, resilience, disaster recovery, and governance controls
  • Security architecture assessment — identity and access management, encryption, logging, monitoring, and tracing security requirements through to their implementation in configuration
  • CJIS compliance experience — high priority. CJIS stands for Criminal Justice Information Services, the United States Federal Bureau of Investigation security policy that governs handling of criminal justice data. The client holds law enforcement data and employs sworn investigators, so this is a real requirement, not a nice-to-have.
  • Privacy controls, records retention, and audit logging assessment
  • Vendor risk management and software supply chain security — including SBOM
About Us: Sabot Consulting is a management consulting company focused on providing technical and management consulting to IT executives and managers in strategic, operational, and project-based practice areas. Our focus on providing expert staff that have the knowledge, experience, and professionalism to engage the client at all levels is the key to our success.

As an integral member of the Analytics Team, the Senior Technical Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst is responsible for providing advanced technical expertise in one or more analytics toolsets to support the creation of information-based, business intelligence deliverables that will be relied upon by organizational leaders to support critical business decisions. The Senior Technical BI Analyst will work with customers from clinical, administrative and/or operational areas across the System to provide advanced analytical tools that drive insights, complex data extracts and data integration, reports and/or advanced dashboard visualizations to facilitate discovery of insights, new opportunities, support data-informed decision-making for identified challenges as well as develop new and enhance existing metrics to analyze ongoing performance metrics. This position may be tasked to become competent in specific business areas or functional units to support transformation of data and information into actionable insights that answer complex business questions. The Senior Technical BI Analyst will work with customers to understand and define the problems being solved, facilitate procurement and integration of the disparate data sources necessary to analyze the needs appropriately, deliver relevant analytics tools to meet customer’s objectives and implement and support the solutions for ongoing utilization. This role will also troubleshoot complex technical problems and serve in a senior technical advisory role to other BI, Specialized BI and Technical BI Analysts as well as others across the System’s Analytics Community. The Senior Technical BI Analyst may also be responsible for analyzing and integrating disparate data sources to ETL into an EDW either through a direct integration or through a normalization process.

Job Description

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Education: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in computer science, management information systems, data science, business administration, statistics, or related field or equivalent experience required. Master’s degree highly preferred.

Licenses/Certifications: Technical certifications in relevant application(s) strongly preferred (i.e., Tableau). Associate Certified Analytics Professional (aCAP) or another vendor-neutral analytics certification preferred.

Experience / Knowledge / Skills:

    • Database and Query Languages – CCL, SQL, Nomad, Oracle, Vertica, Snowflake

    • Visualization tools – Tableau (preferred), Spotfire, Sisense, Qlik or Microsoft PowerBI

    • Data Visualization Server Administration tools – Tableau Core and Data Management Server

    • Data Prep/Transformation tools – Tableau Prep, Hadoop, Alteryx, Paxata, Trifacta, Altair, Talend

    • Statistical tools – R, SAS, SPSS, Matlab, Minitab

    • Data Science tools – R, Python, SAS, dataiku, DataRobot, Cnvrg, Anaconda

  • Proficiency with MS Office Suite: Excel (Pivot tables, VBA, Macros), Word, PowerPoint, Visio, Access, required

  • Minimum of 5 years professional experience collaborating with customers on the design, creation and execution of analytics deliverables.

  • Minimum of 5 years professional experience in building complex self-service analytic reports, dashboards and/or tools supporting decision-making and actionable metric monitoring by customers.

  • Demonstrated experience working in a dynamic, matrixed organization with executive exposure.

  • Demonstrated critical thinking and advanced creative problem-solving skills with aptitude to exert influence without authority through interpreting requirements and guiding customers to the desired analytics outcomes.

  • Analytic mindset able to draw conclusions from raw data and summarize results efficiently using logic and reasoning to identify approaches to problems.

  • Ability to visualize data in a meaningful way to communicate effectively the meaning and the necessary action to be taken.

  • Act with an intellectual curiosity to obtain insights from data and search for solutions to the problems being explored as well as new ones to be discovered.

  • Understand math and statistical concepts to provide analysis to formulate meaningful decisions.

  • Exceptional time management skills and attention to detail.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, specifically with an ability to communicate effectively across multiple management levels.

  • Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team under established deadlines to drive critical outcomes.

  • Create a positive work environment that fosters successful team performance.

  • Strong customer service, interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Advise, support and train fellow members of the Analytics Team as well as individual analytics efforts across the System through expertise with technical business intelligence tools, concepts, processes and techniques.

  • Serves as advanced-level, technical advisor to others offering high level support, mentorship, education and training.

  • Ongoing interactions with subject matter domain experts within the organization to enhance knowledge of business, clinical and administrative processes and applications utilized by the various clients.

  • Partner with respective customers to design, develop and implement high level analytics tools that drive actionable insights in support of operational, strategic and tactical metrics for optimization.

  • Partner with the greater Analytics team to evolve Memorial Hermann’s Analytics Maturity Level to incorporate the full analytics spectrum of descriptive, diagnostic, predictive and prescriptive analytics.

  • Collaborate with the greater Analytics Team to develop the data architecture strategy, implementation plan and customer-delivered toolset.

  • Active participation in and support of the Memorial Hermann Data Governance Program.

  • Provide support from data model, quality, integrity, validity analysis through resolution to correct deficiencies within analytic, reporting and visualization applications.

  • Continually further analytics knowledge and skill set through various channels to ensure MHHS remains on the cutting edge of the Healthcare industry.

  • Key member of the project team supporting curriculum development and responsible for training new analytic professionals to meet the established standard.

  • Ensures safe care to patients, staff and visitors; adheres to all Memorial Hermann policies, procedures, and standards within budgetary specifications including time management, supply management, productivity and quality of service.

Time commitment: Approximately 1–2 hours
Compensation: $75 for completing the project activity

About the opportunity

CloudFactory is looking for participants to support a short-term transaction validation project that we are administering on behalf of a global payments processing company.

The project is designed to help evaluate the accuracy of how payment transactions are matched to individuals.

As a participant, you'll review a set of recent payment transactions and indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself.

How it works

If selected for the project:

  1. You'll provide the email address(es) you use with selected merchants, subscriptions, apps, or online accounts.
  2. Our payments processing client will use those email address(es) to identify payment transactions it believes are associated with you and securely provide a list of those transactions for the project.
  3. You'll be presented with approximately 50 recent transactions from the last 3 months through the designated project platform. The information shown may include details such as the merchant name, date, amount, payment method, card identifier, and card issuer to help you recognize each transaction.
  4. You'll indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself and, where helpful, add a short note.

The activity is expected to take approximately 1–2 hours.

You will not be asked to provide or upload your own transaction history, bank statements, full card number, online banking login credentials, banking password, PIN, or CVV.

Please note that this is a data validation activity only.

Requirements

To participate, you must:

  • Be 18 years of age or older.
  • Currently reside in Germany.
  • Be an active debit and/or credit card user.
  • Have made purchases or payments within the last three months across a variety of merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be able to recognize your own recent purchases and transactions.
  • Have access to the email address(es) you use with the merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be comfortable providing those email address(es) if selected for the project.
  • Be willing to review approximately 50 transactions and confirm whether or not you recognize them as your own.

Privacy and consent

Because this project involves personal and financial transaction information, privacy and informed consent are essential.

Before participating, you'll receive our Participant Consent & Confidentiality Terms, which explain how your personal information and transaction data will be used and processed as part of the project.

If you qualify and provide your consent, relevant payment transactions will be securely provided to CloudFactory by the end-customer and made available to you through the designated project platform for validation.

You may withdraw your consent and participation in accordance with the terms provided to you before the project begins.

jobs.excerpt: Hometown empowers schools with seamless digital tools for ticketing, fundraising, and event management, enabling them to create memorable in-person experiences that bring communities together.
jobs.description:
Hometown empowers schools with seamless digital tools for ticketing, fundraising, and event management, enabling them to create memorable in-person experiences that bring communities together. As a trusted partner dedicated to supporting athletics, arts, and extracurricular activities, we help schools generate vital funding to ensure every student has access to enriching opportunities. With a deep passion for serving those who shape our future, we make event operations effortless – so schools can focus on what truly matters: creating lasting impact in their hometowns.

Job Description:

Location:Remote

Type: Full-time, independent contractor (long-term engagement)

Hours: Full-time, with a minimum of 5 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern Time (9:00am–5:00pm ET core business hours)

Who We Are:
Hometown is the trusted leader in the education space, equipping athletic directors, coaches, and school administrators with the tools they need to manage their department communications, live events, and fundraisers. Hometown offers an all-in-one, easy-to-use platform to support schools in creating memorable in-person experiences and lasting impact in their communities. We’re continuing to expand our technology and team to provide the best-in-class service to organizations across the country!

Hometown empowers all team members through a positive company culture. Exemplifying our core values of Hustle, Excellence, Resilience, and Ownership (HERO). We’re committed to providing a safe and inclusive work experience for everyone, both those working remotely and within our offices across the country. Consider joining our team today!

Role Summary:

We are looking for a Salesforce Solutions Architect to own our Salesforce instance end to end. You will be the technical owner of the platform that runs our go-to-market motion. You will be a part of our Business Operations team and report directly to our Senior Director of Operations.

This is a hands-on ownership role, not an advisory one. You will inherit a mature, actively used org with automations, integrations, and reporting dependencies, and you will be responsible for keeping it healthy, making it better, and expanding it to support our multi-product go-to-market strategy across ticketing, fundraising, and websites and mobile apps.

The person who succeeds here is someone who has done this at more than one company, can reverse-engineer an unfamiliar org, can receive business requirements directly from Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Finance, and can then design, build, test, and ship the change themselves. We are hiring for judgment and ownership as much as for build skill. You will be the person the business asks “can Salesforce do this?” and the person who decides the answer and implements it.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ownership of the Salesforce instance: declarative configuration, permission sets and profiles, page layouts, record types, sharing rules, sandbox strategy, and release management.

  • Maintain and stabilize: inherit the existing automation footprint (Flows, validation rules, assignment logic, approval processes), document what exists, retire what’s redundant, and eliminate the technical debt that accumulates in any fast-moving org.

  • Improve and expand: identify friction in how our reps and CS team actually work, propose the fix, and ship it. Reduce clicks, improve data quality, and make the system reflect how the business actually sells.

  • Build out our multi-product GTM in Salesforce: design the data model, opportunity architecture, product catalog, and pipeline structure required to sell, renew, and report on multiple products to the same school and district accounts. This includes cross-sell and upsell motion, product-level revenue reporting, bundling, and renewal architecture.

  • Own the integrated stack: maintain and improve how Salesforce connects to Snowflake (our data warehouse), Gong (conversation intelligence and deal insight), and our other go-to-market and billing systems. Partner on data flows in both directions and ensure Salesforce remains the trusted source of truth for GTM data.

  • Reporting and dashboards: build and maintain the reports, dashboards, and forecasting views that leadership, sales management, and Customer Success run on. Be opinionated about what “good” looks like.

  • Gather requirements autonomously: run your own discovery with stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Finance, and leadership. Translate business problems into system design without requiring a project manager or business analyst in between.

  • Governance and enablement: own user management and onboarding, data hygiene standards, field and object documentation, change control, and training for end users on what you build.

  • Vendor and AppExchange management: evaluate, implement, and rationalize the third-party tools connected to the org.

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • 4–8 years of hands-on Salesforce experience, including primary ownership of at least one production org.

  • Experience across multiple companies’ Salesforce instances. You’ve walked into orgs you didn’t build, figured out how they work, and improved them. We need someone who has done the inheriting before.

  • Deep declarative expertise: Flow (record-triggered, screen, scheduled), validation rules, formula fields, dynamic forms, approval processes, permission set and sharing architecture, and complex data modeling.

  • Comfortable reading, debugging, and reasoning about code. You can open Apex, triggers, and Lightning Web Components, understand what they do, identify when they’re the cause of a problem, and work with a developer or vendor to fix them.

  • Reporting and data fluency: advanced Salesforce reporting, data loading and migration

  • Integration experience. You’ve owned or heavily supported Salesforce integrations with a data warehouse, conversation intelligence tooling, marketing automation, or billing systems.

  • Salesforce Administrator certification required; Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Sales Cloud Consultant strongly preferred.

  • Professional English fluency, written and verbal. You’ll be running requirements conversations directly with US-based stakeholders, including leadership.

  • Demonstrated autonomy: a track record of operating as the only Salesforce person in the room, setting your own priorities against business goals, and driving change without being managed task to task.

Nice To Have:

  • Experience in B2B SaaS selling to schools, districts, higher education, or the public sector.

  • Sandbox and deployment discipline: change sets, SFDX, Gearset, Copado, or similar.

  • Experience with Salesforce AI features (Agentforce, Einstein) or Salesforce-connected AI tooling.

  • Experience supporting a company through a product expansion, acquisition integration, or org consolidation.

  • Experience architecting multi-product or multi-line-of-business selling in Salesforce (product catalog, CPQ or CPQ-adjacent quoting, bundling, product-level revenue reporting).

Compensation:
Fixed monthly amount of $5,000 USD

Our compensation ranges are determined by a variety of factors, including role responsibilities, market data, and an individual's skills, experience, and qualifications. The final offer will be based on these factors and discussed throughout the interview process.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to remain stationary for a long period of time, including working on a computer.

  • This position may also be required to travel to client sites or conferences. This could include standing and walking for prolonged periods of time, and while outdoors in various weather conditions.

  • Hometown values the importance of demonstrating to our customers that we care and are invested in our product and how it can be the best solution for them. All Hometown employees have a minimum amount of client events they must attend per year. This may include traveling to local client sites and could include standing and walking for prolonged periods of time, and while outdoors in various weather conditions.

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a QA Automation Engineer to build, maintain, and scale automated testing systems for a fast-growing, product-focused technology company.

This is an automation-first engineering role focused on Playwright and TypeScript—not manual QA. You’ll work closely with frontend and backend engineers to strengthen regression coverage, eliminate flaky tests, improve framework reliability, and ensure high-quality releases across the development lifecycle.

Responsibilities

Test Automation

  • Build, maintain, and expand end-to-end automation using Playwright and TypeScript.
  • Develop scalable automation frameworks for critical product workflows.
  • Improve regression coverage across frontend and backend systems.
  • Write reliable, reusable, and maintainable automated tests.

Framework Reliability

  • Identify and eliminate flaky tests.
  • Improve test execution speed and framework stability.
  • Troubleshoot issues related to DOM interactions, asynchronous behavior, and network requests.
  • Maintain reliable automation environments across releases.

CI/CD & Quality

  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Support reliable deployments through continuous testing.
  • Maintain test environments and test data strategies.
  • Improve release confidence through automated quality validation.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with frontend and backend engineers throughout feature development.
  • Participate in release planning and testing strategy discussions.
  • Leverage AI tools to improve exploratory testing and automation workflows.
  • Continuously improve automation coverage, reliability, and engineering best practices.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright (Cypress experience is acceptable with willingness to transition).
  • Proven experience building and maintaining end-to-end automation frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of DOM interactions, asynchronous behavior, network requests, and debugging flaky tests.
  • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building automation frameworks from scratch.
  • Knowledge of test data management strategies.
  • Experience testing B2B SaaS or multi-tenant applications.
  • Familiarity with role-based access and permissions testing.
  • Experience with AI-assisted testing tools and workflows.
  • Startup or product-led environment experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • Stable and reliable automation frameworks.
  • Reduced flaky tests and production defects.
  • Increased automated regression coverage.
  • Faster, more reliable CI/CD testing.
  • Improved test execution speed and release quality.

Interview Process

  • Initial Recruiter Screening
  • Technical Assessment
  • Client Technical Interview
  • Final Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. It’s a short, self-recorded video that completes your application and allows hiring managers to get to know you before the interview process begins.

Rather than repeating your background during multiple screening calls, you’ll tell your story once, allowing future interviews to focus on meaningful conversations.

Don’t overthink it—you can record as many takes as you’d like before submitting. Your invitation will come from Spark Hire, so please check both your inbox and spam folder.

  • Support CI/CD pipelines through automated quality gates and continuous testing.
  • Build automated validation frameworks for AI-generated summaries.
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for clinical completeness, consistency, usability, accuracy, and reliability.
  • Identify omissions, inaccuracies, hallucinations, and other AI-generated defects that could impact clinical workflows.

  • Experience with healthcare interoperability standards and clinical data exchange.

Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Build digital products and services 0-1

Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights

Hadoop Solutions Developer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Hadoop Solutions Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Hadoop Developer to design, build, and operate large-scale data processing pipelines and analytics platforms on Hadoop and related big-data ecosystems. In this role you will be responsible for ingesting, transforming, and analyzing massive volumes of structured and unstructured data to support enterprise analytics, machine learning, and reporting workloads. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise across the Hadoop ecosystem with strong software engineering fundamentals and a clear understanding of how to deliver reliable, performant, and cost-effective data platforms in production environments.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and operate end-to-end big-data pipelines on Hadoop, ingesting data from a diverse mix of relational, file-based, streaming, and API-driven sources.
  • Build robust ETL/ELT workflows using Apache Spark, Hive, Pig, and Sqoop, with strong attention to data quality, idempotency, error handling, and recoverability.
  • Develop high-throughput streaming data pipelines using Kafka, Spark Streaming, or Flink, and integrate them with downstream analytical and operational systems.
  • Optimize Spark and MapReduce jobs through careful tuning of partitioning, memory, serialization, and skew handling to meet demanding SLAs at minimal cost.
  • Design and maintain data models and storage layouts on HDFS, Hive, HBase, and modern lakehouse formats (Parquet, ORC, Delta, Iceberg, Hudi) to balance flexibility and performance.
  • Implement data governance, lineage, and quality controls in collaboration with data governance and security teams.
  • Build robust monitoring, alerting, and logging strategies for big-data pipelines, including job-level SLAs and proactive failure detection.
  • Partner with data scientists and analysts to deliver curated, reliable, and well-documented datasets that accelerate their work.
  • Automate pipeline orchestration using Airflow, Oozie, or similar workflow engines, with clean dependency management and clear ownership boundaries.
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt new technologies in the big-data and cloud ecosystem (EMR, Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery) where they offer meaningful improvements.
  • Lead performance reviews and architecture audits of existing pipelines, proposing concrete refactoring and optimization initiatives.
  • Document data architectures, schemas, pipeline behaviors, and operational runbooks in a way that makes the platform supportable as the team scales.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the team’s engineering standards and best practices.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of professional experience designing and operating big-data pipelines on Hadoop.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Apache Spark (Scala, Python, or Java) in production environments.
  • Solid experience with Hive, HDFS, Sqoop, HBase, and the broader Hadoop ecosystem.
  • Hands-on experience with streaming data platforms such as Kafka, Spark Streaming, or Flink.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with both relational and NoSQL data stores.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow or Oozie.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems concepts, including partitioning, replication, and fault tolerance.
  • Strong scripting skills in Python or Shell.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, debugging, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience operating Hadoop on cloud platforms such as AWS EMR, Azure HDInsight, or Databricks.
  • Familiarity with modern lakehouse formats (Delta, Iceberg, Hudi).
  • Exposure to data governance tooling such as Apache Atlas or Collibra.
  • Experience with Kubernetes-based data platforms (Spark-on-K8s, Trino).
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code in data engineering workflows.

This role combines day‑to‑day SEIT technical leadership with stewardship of a SEIT Center of Excellence: defining engineering standards, playbooks, toolchains, CONOPS and the roadmap for Sapphire archetypes (Make‑to‑Order, Remanufacturing, Research & Design (R&D)/Prototyping, etc.). The role is responsible for enabling consistent, repeatable, high‑quality delivery across bedrocks Product Data Management (PDM)/ Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) /Manufacturing Operations Management (MOM) /Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and Integrated Product Team (IPTs), while also driving continuous improvement, knowledge transfer, and best‑practice adoption across the program.

If you are driven to lead complex system initiatives and want to influence the future of BDS enterprise systems, apply now to shape the Sapphire program’s success.

Position Responsibilities: What You’ll Do

  • Lead the SEIT team (project engineers, test leads, requirements/architecture Subject Matter Expert (SMEs), embedded SEs) in day‑to‑day execution of SEIT deliverables; act as the SEIT Sr. Manager’s deputy and decision owner in their absence

  • Own and operate the SEIT Center of Excellence (CoE): develop and maintain SEIT standards, templates, governance artifacts (Work Breakdown Structure (WBS)/ Statement of Work (SOW) templates, Change Control Board (CCB) / Configuration Management (CM) playbooks, test & verification master plan templates), and a reusable artifact library for Sapphire

  • Drive SEIT operational excellence by establishing and maturing a SEIT Foundation of Practice: define, collect, and report a standard set of program health metrics and Key Performance Indicator (KPIs), institutionalize repeatable processes and playbooks, and continuously improve team performance through data‑driven governance and coaching

  • Own the SEIT CONOPS for Sapphire: define, maintain, and socialize the Concept of Operations that describes how SEIT enabled capabilities (PDM, ERP, MOM/MES, integrations, and test infrastructures) will be used across lifecycle phases (Design, Build, Test, Deploy, Sustain). Ensure the CONOPS links operational scenarios to requirements, architecture, IPT responsibilities, test strategies, and deployment/hypercare plans

  • Define and lead the Sapphire archetype roadmap: translate program strategy into archetype delivery plans (Make‑to‑Order, Commercial Parts, Remanufacturing, R&D/Prototyping, etc.), identify dependencies across bedrocks, define capability increments for 1.0+ releases, and maintain the archetype backlog and release priorities in collaboration with PIO and IPT leads

  • Institutionalize engineering best practices and toolchains (Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) workflows, requirements management, traceability, integration test automation, digital thread artifacts) to ensure traceability, repeatability, and audit readiness. Champion integrated tool use (Teamcenter/ Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), DOORS/Polarion, ADO/Jira, BORIS, Planner, Power BI)

  • Serve as the SEIT technical focal for cross‑functional integration planning and execution with Dev IPTs, I&I, PIO, Deployment, and Business Change Management; remove cross‑IPT execution blockers and establish recurrent cadences for alignment (schedule, risk, CCB, test calendars)

  • Lead the development and operationalization of SEIT KPIs and health metrics (schedule adherence, traceability coverage, CCB throughput, defect escape/closure rates, integration pass/fail rates, automation coverage) and present monthly to program leadership

  • Drive continuous improvement via lessons‑learned, capability increment retrospectives, and adoption of repeatable artifacts; run Communities of Practice, training, and “teach” sessions to scale skills across SEIT and IPTs

  • Executive Engagement: Prepare and present milestone readiness evidence and technical status updates to senior leadership, milestone review boards, and governance committees

  • Drive SEIT operational excellence by establishing and maturing a SEIT Foundation of Practice: define, collect, and report a standard set of program health metrics and KPIs, institutionalize repeatable processes and playbooks, and continuously improve team performance through data‑driven governance and coaching

  • Own the SEIT CONOPS for Sapphire: define, maintain, and socialize the Concept of Operations that describes how SEIT enabled capabilities (PDM, ERP, MOM/MES, integrations, and test infrastructures) will be used across lifecycle phases (Design, Build, Test, Deploy, Sustain). Ensure the CONOPS links operational scenarios to requirements, architecture, IPT responsibilities, test strategies, and deployment/hypercare plans
