Recognized as a global leader in subscription commerce, Infiterra combines innovation, performance excellence, and trusted expertise to help partners transform and grow.

At Infiterra, we are growing our teams with care, intention, and a strong focus on quality. Hiring the right people is one of the most important ways we protect our culture, support business growth, and strengthen the employee experience.

We are looking for a Senior Talent Partner whose focus will be in taking ownership of our hiring needs while also leading broader HR initiatives. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys attracting talent, influencing hiring managers, and leading people processes — someone who can be a partner and balance strong execution with thoughtful judgment.

About The Role

As a Senior Talent Partner, you will be part of the People team and will work closely with hiring managers, team leads, and senior stakeholders across the company.

This is a senior individual contributor role with strong ownership. You will own end-to-end recruitment process, attract talent, guide hiring teams, improve candidate experience, and help us make thoughtful hiring decisions. This is the primary focus of the role.

Alongside talent acquisition, you'll contribute to and/or own People projects and broader HR activities — such as Employer Branding, Onboarding, and Performance Management cycles, Learning and Development etc. — depending on business priorities.

We're looking for someone with deep Talent Acquisition expertise who also brings hands-on experience across other HR areas — able to support and contribute to projects outside recruitment when priorities call for it.

You should be confident managing senior-level conversations, structured in the way you run hiring processes, and thoughtful in how you assess both skills and values. You are likely to thrive in this role if you:

  • Take ownership and follow through without needing close supervision.

  • Move fluidly between owning strategic talent acquisition and contributing to HR projects, without losing quality on either.

  • Build trust quickly with different stakeholders, hiring managers and candidates.

  • Care about both speed and quality.

  • Communicate clearly, directly, and respectfully.

  • Ensure an excellent candidate experience, with clear communication, timely updates, structured interviews, and a professional representation of Infiterra.

  • Improve recruitment practices and tools, including job descriptions, scorecards, interview guides, hiring workflows, reporting, and recruitment metrics.

  • Support onboarding and employee lifecycle activities, helping new hires transition smoothly and contributing to a consistent employee experience.

  • Act as an HR Business Partner to selected teams, coaching managers, supporting team changes, and advising on people matters.

  • Lead and contribute to broader People Function initiatives, such as engagement actions, performance review cycles, employer branding, and process improvements and owning selected projects end to end.

Qualifications

Required

  • Solid experience (5+ years) in Talent Acquisition, ideally in a fast-paced technology, SaaS, or international business environment

  • Experience partnering with hiring managers and senior stakeholders.

  • Strong sourcing skills, especially through LinkedIn and direct outreach.

  • Ability to assess both technical/role-related skills and behavioral fit.

  • Proven track record owning full-cycle recruitment for multiple roles simultaneously.

  • Solid working knowledge of core HR operations: onboarding, policy administration, and employee relations basics.

  • Comfortable working with HRIS/ATS systems and producing clean, accurate reporting.

  • Fluent in Greek and English (written and spoken).

  • Experience hiring for technical or product roles (e.g. software, telecom/BSS, or SaaS environments).

Preferred

  • Strong working knowledge of Greek employment law and statutory compliance policy requirements.

  • Prior experience in a scaling company where the HR function was still being built out.

Benefits

  • Work-from-anywhere scheme (travel and work).

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Health and life insurance program.

  • Learning & development budget.

  • Tech-driven, friendly team with an international mindset.

If you feel you’re a great fit, please apply!We’d love to hear from you!

Rocket Doctor is a digital health platform and marketplace that breaks down obstacles limiting access to quality, comprehensive, and cost-effective healthcare. jobs.excerpt: About the Program:Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online.
jobs.description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

A Sneak Peek of Your Role 🔭

  • Demonstrated ability to coach rep behavior and change output, not just report on it
  • Data fluency: you pull your own reports, read pipeline signals before they become problems, and coach to leading indicators

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience with HubSpot, Nooks, or similar outbound tech stacks

Our culture

At CloudFactory, we believe in building a workplace where everyone feels empowered, valued, and inspired to bring their authentic selves to work. We are:

  • Mission-driven: we focus on creating economic and social impact.
  • People-centric: we care deeply about our team's growth, well-being, and sense of belonging.
  • Innovative: we embrace change and find better ways to do things, together.
  • Globally connected: we foster collaboration between diverse cultures and perspectives.

Location: Brazil
Project type: One-time paid project
Time commitment: Approximately 1–2 hours
Compensation: $75 for completing the project activity

About the opportunity

CloudFactory is looking for participants to support a short-term transaction validation project that we are administering on behalf of a global payments processing company.

The project is designed to help evaluate the accuracy of how payment transactions are matched to individuals.

As a participant, you'll review a set of recent payment transactions and indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself.

How it works

If selected for the project:

  1. You'll provide the email address(es) you use with selected merchants, subscriptions, apps, or online accounts.
  2. Our payments processing client will use those email address(es) to identify payment transactions it believes are associated with you and securely provide a list of those transactions for the project.
  3. You'll be presented with approximately 50 recent transactions from the last 3 months through the designated project platform. The information shown may include details such as the merchant name, date, amount, payment method, card identifier, and card issuer to help you recognize each transaction.
  4. You'll indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself and, where helpful, add a short note.

The activity is expected to take approximately 1–2 hours.

You will not be asked to provide or upload your own transaction history, bank statements, full card number, online banking login credentials, banking password, PIN, or CVV.

Please note that this is a data validation activity only.

Requirements

To participate, you must:

  • Be 18 years of age or older.
  • Currently reside in Brazil.
  • Be an active debit and/or credit card user.
  • Have made purchases or payments within the last three months across a variety of merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be able to recognize your own recent purchases and transactions.
  • Have access to the email address(es) you use with the merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be comfortable providing those email address(es) if selected for the project.
  • Be willing to review approximately 50 transactions and confirm whether or not you recognize them as your own.

Privacy and consent

Because this project involves personal and financial transaction information, privacy and informed consent are essential.

Before participating, you'll receive our Participant Consent & Confidentiality Terms, which explain how your personal information and transaction data will be used and processed as part of the project.

If you qualify and provide your consent, relevant payment transactions will be securely provided to CloudFactory by the end-customer and made available to you through the designated project platform for validation.

You may withdraw your consent and participation in accordance with the terms provided to you before the project begins.

Interested? Complete our short eligibility questionnaire to be considered for this paid project.

This role requires a writer who is equally comfortable developing high-impact acquisition campaigns, supporting digital product experiences, and managing ongoing content operations. This position is 100% remote. East Coast candidates are preferred.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Create High-Impact Digital Content

  • Identifyopportunities for content optimization, messaging refinement, personalization, and A/B testing to continually improve campaign performance.

Collaborate Across the Digital Experience

Support Content Operations & Governance

  • Author, publish, andmaintaindigital content within enterprise content management systems and content authoring platforms, ensuring content accuracy and consistency.

  • Executetimelycopy revisions, production updates, and quick-turn content changes across web, email, SMS, mobile applications, and other digital channels.

Vous contribuerez à la création de solutions technologiques performantes et fiables tout en collaborant avec des équipes multidisciplinaires situées au Canada et à l’international.

  • Concevoir, développer et faire évoluer des applications Web modernes et évolutives à l’aide de React et des technologies JavaScript modernes.

Ce que nous recherchons

  • Baccalauréat en informatique, en génie logiciel, en génie ou dans une discipline connexe.

Nous plaçons nos employés au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons et nous nous engageons à leur offrir, ainsi qu’à leur famille, des avantages sociaux adaptés à leurs besoins diversifiés et évolutifs. What We Are Looking For

jobs.description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Website Experience Sr. Director in our Marketing Operations area in Brazil or the US (Remote accepted)!

Reporting to the VP of Marketing Operations, this role owns the evolution of Wellhub's website — from a traditionally-managed site to an Agentic Website Experience and Operations model, where AI agents increasingly handle content assembly, personalization, identity resolution, and optimization, freeing the team to focus on strategy, judgment calls, and the exceptions that matter. This is a hands-on strategic role: owning the roadmap, design, testing, data, and execution, and leading product managers, UX designers, web analytics, and developers to deliver on that vision. You're expected to have a real point of view on where agentic AI creates leverage on a website versus where it introduces risk, and to be able to defend that point of view to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Lead the vision, roadmap, and strategy for Wellhub's website experience, driving its evolution toward an Agentic Website Experience and Operations model — where AI agents increasingly handle content assembly, personalization, and optimization.
  • Own conversion rate optimization end-to-end: define experimentation strategy, size and prioritize A/B tests, lead qualitative research and behavioral surveys, and translate results into optimization decisions.
  • Own website performance measurement and automated reporting (traffic, MQLs, sign-ups, conversions), analyzing visitor behavior through data synthesis, heat mapping, and tools like Amplitude + Looker.
  • Partner with stakeholders across the organization to shape the website experience for product launches, content, campaigns, and the broader roadmap.
  • Lead the website design and UX function, including the Mantra design system and the end-to-end design-to-code operating model (Figma to Mantra to Strapi), owning the quality bar for both human- and agent-generated work.
  • Evaluate, pilot, and scale agentic AI and AI orchestration tools for the website — defining human-in-the-loop boundaries, guardrails, and escalation paths — and identify, procure, and roll out best-in-class website technology and platforms.
  • Own the site's readiness for AI-driven discovery and personalization: architect content and information architecture for SEO, GEO/AEO, and Web MCP, lead the rollout of AI-powered personalization and predictive experimentation, and ensure conversational/AI-assisted website interactions align with the broader company AI architecture.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A seasoned digital/website leader with proven experience and ownership of a website and hands-on experience running experimentation programs.
  • Deep expertise across web tech stacks — analytics platforms, headless CMS, and web design systems — with a track record of managing them end-to-end.
  • Concrete, hands-on experience applying AI/agentic technology to marketing or web workflows (agent frameworks, AI personalization/CRO, conversational content tooling, or GEO/AEO strategy), including AI-assisted design-to-code workflows in production.
  • A clear, defensible point of view on where agentic AI creates leverage versus risk in B2B contexts, with the ability to bridge marketing, martech/engineering, and data teams on AI implementation.
  • Experience leading design and/or research functions, or credibly managing senior design ICs and design system owners, including owning a design system as shared infrastructure rather than a component library.
  • A strong cross-functional leader who thrives in matrixed, fast-paced, hyper-growth environments, balancing internal business needs with a customer-centric mindset.
  • Analytically rigorous, with strong critical thinking to translate complex AI topics into actionable insights and a sharp focus on KPIs and conversion metrics.
  • Quick to adapt to new domain contexts, AI trends, and vendor tools, with experience working across global companies and website localization.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in B2B website management and hands-on application of agentic AI/experimentation are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Paid Media & Tracking Assistant to support our digital advertising, analytics, and tracking efforts across multiple paid media platforms. The ideal candidate has practical experience setting up, maintaining, and troubleshooting advertising pixels, events, conversion tracking, and analytics systems, with a strong understanding of how paid traffic is measured and optimized.

You will work closely with the marketing team to ensure that campaigns are properly tracked, conversions are accurately recorded, and our tracking infrastructure provides reliable data for reporting and optimization. This role is particularly suited to someone who enjoys working directly with ad platforms, analytics tools, event tracking, and campaign data rather than focusing solely on strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set up, manage, and troubleshoot Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

  • Support paid advertising campaigns across platforms such as Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

  • Define and maintain a clear event tracking structure, including event names, parameters, properties, and conversion definitions.

  • Implement and validate pixels, events, conversion tracking, UTM parameters, and other tracking solutions across websites and campaigns.

  • Work with the tracking stack, including PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Meta Events Manager, Brevo, and Microsoft Clarity.

  • Monitor tracking performance and investigate discrepancies between advertising platforms, analytics tools, and website data.

  • Debug tracking issues and identify why an event or conversion is not firing correctly, rather than only setting up campaigns.

  • Test and validate events across different platforms to ensure that data is being captured accurately and consistently.

  • Ensure that key events and conversions are properly defined, recorded, and attributed across the relevant platforms.

  • Assist with campaign setup, audience tracking, retargeting, and conversion measurement.

  • Analyze campaign and tracking data to identify potential issues and opportunities for improvement.

  • Work with websites, landing pages, and analytics tools to ensure proper data collection and attribution.

  • Help maintain organized tracking documentation and ensure that event naming and tracking structures remain consistent.

  • Stay up to date with changes to advertising platforms, tracking technologies, attribution, and privacy requirements.

  • Support testing and troubleshooting of new tracking setups before campaigns go live.

Preferred Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, Meta Pixel, Meta Events Manager, and custom events/conversions.

  • Experience with TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.

  • Practical experience with PostHog, GA4, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Microsoft Clarity, and Brevo.

  • Strong understanding of event tracking concepts, including event names, parameters, properties, conversion definitions, and attribution.

  • Experience troubleshooting tracking issues and identifying why events or conversions may not be firing, recording, or attributing correctly.

  • Familiarity with server-side tracking / Conversions API is a strong plus.

  • Experience with newer or emerging advertising platforms, including ChatGPT Ads, would be a significant advantage.

  • Comfortable working with data, spreadsheets, dashboards, and campaign performance reports.

  • Strong attention to detail and a hands-on, problem-solving mindset.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who is practical, detail-oriented, and technically curious. You should be comfortable getting into the actual ad platforms and tracking tools, testing events yourself, investigating discrepancies, and figuring out why something is not working as expected.

The ideal candidate should be able to go beyond simply setting up campaigns or implementing pixels. They should understand how the entire tracking flow works, from defining an event and its parameters to ensuring that it fires correctly, is captured by the relevant analytics tools, and is ultimately reflected as a meaningful conversion.

You do not need to be an advanced developer, but you should be confident working with tracking tools, advertising platforms, basic website elements, and analytics systems. Experience working across multiple paid media channels and the ability to quickly learn and troubleshoot new platforms are highly valued.

jobs.excerpt: About the CompanyArmada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty.
jobs.description:
About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

About the Role

Armada is hiring a Senior Data Center BIM Designer to support the Galleon, Leviathan, and Orion product lines — a brand-new capability for the company. As we scale Modular Data Center (MDC) deployments across a growing number of sites and geographies, we need someone who can own the BIM thread that ties every discipline together — civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, piping, controls, and ICT — into a single coordinated model and build the BIM and drawing standards infrastructure.

You will build and own Armada's fully integrated BIM model spanning CSA, MEP, controls, ICT, produce and govern drawing packages for containerized and modular form factors (ISO shipping containers, e-houses, and skid-mounted equipment with PEMB buildings), and set the drawing libraries, standard details, templates, title blocks, and naming conventions the rest of the design team will build on. This is a facility-level BIM role — you'll build and coordinate the full data center model and drawings rather than modeling individual equipment from scratch, incorporating 3D models supplied by equipment manufacturers and vendors into the facility model. You'll also be the senior technical authority and cross-discipline escalation point, working directly with product and engineering leadership to embed repeatable, scalable BIM practices into new product development (Galleon/Leviathan/Orion) from day one.

Location. This role is remote-based on the continental US (approximately 10–20% travel to project sites, fabrication facilities, and vendor/GC locations).

What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)

  • Integrated, all-discipline BIM ownership — Build and maintain one coordinated Revit/BIM model covering civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, piping, controls, and ICT for both the existing Modular Data Center (MDC) product line and new product development (Galleon/Leviathan/Orion), so the whole data center lives in one model instead of different disciplines working in isolation.
  • BIM/drawing standards from the ground up — Build and own the drawing libraries, standard details, templates, Revit families, title blocks, and naming/layer conventions for CSA and MEP alike — the framework the rest of the design team will work within going forward.
  • Senior technical authority on containerized and prefab drawing packages — Own how new form factors — ISO shipping containers, e-houses, skid-mounted equipment with PEMB buildings — get modeled and documented end to end across all MDC disciplines, setting the pattern the rest of the team follows.
  • Cross-discipline coordination — Run clash detection/coordination across all MDC disciplines, review design output against standards and the master model, and act as the single escalation point when disciplines conflict.
  • Repeatable, scalable design for new product development — Work directly with product/engineering leadership to define modular BIM templates and campus-level design patterns across the full discipline set as new products are developed — shaping how Galleon/Leviathan scales, not just documenting decisions made elsewhere.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on BIM/CAD design and drafting experience in commercial, industrial, or modular/offshore projects — with deep, hands-on experience in either CSA (civil, structural, architectural) or MEP (mechanical, electrical, piping) and strong working knowledge of the other, plus demonstrated ability to coordinate across both.
  • Strong proficiency in Revit and AutoCAD, with demonstrated ability to build and manage multi-discipline models and run clash detection/coordination (Navisworks or equivalent).
  • Ability to build BIM/drawing standards, libraries, templates, title blocks, and naming/layer conventions.
  • Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy — you'll be defining the playbook, not inheriting one.
  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 10–20% to project sites, fabrication facilities, and vendor/GC locations worldwide.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience with containerized, modular/prefabricated, or skid-mounted data center drawing packages — ISO shipping containers, e-houses, or skid-mounted equipment with PEMB or existing/new buildings.

jobs.excerpt: Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.
jobs.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


We're looking for a finance-minded leader to run our Americas Order Management and billing operation — someone who understands revenue recognition (ASC 606) deeply enough to make judgment calls on complex, non-standard contracts, and who can lead a team through the operational execution that follows.

This is not a traditional billing, AR, or collections role. We need someone who can look at a contract, understand how its terms affect revenue recognition timing, and confidently explain — and when necessary, challenge — how that translates into billing and financial reporting. Order Management process can be learned on the job. What we can't teach quickly is strong accounting judgment.

If your background is revenue accounting, technical accounting, or FP&A, and you're curious about moving into an operational leadership seat — this role was built with you in mind.

What You'll Do

Revenue & Accounting Judgment

  • Serve as the go-to resource for how contract terms, order changes, and billing decisions affect revenue recognition under ASC 606
  • Evaluate complex or non-standard customer contracts — performance obligations, variable consideration, contract modifications — and determine appropriate revenue treatment
  • Partner with Revenue Accounting, Deal Desk, Sales, and Legal to resolve ambiguous or high-risk revenue scenarios before they become downstream problems
  • Own and strengthen SOX/internal controls across the order-to-billing process; partner with Order Management Assurance on risk and controls
  • Be comfortable pushing back on Sales or Deal Desk when a deal structure creates revenue recognition risk

Team & Operational Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team responsible for Americas order management and billing execution
  • Own SLAs, KPIs, and workload planning across the team
  • Resolve complex order and billing escalations that require financial judgment, not just process knowledge
  • Drive accurate, timely, SOX-compliant execution through month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close
  • Conduct transaction-level completeness and accuracy reviews

Process, Systems & Transformation

  • Identify and lead process improvement, automation, and AI-enabled efficiency initiatives
  • Standardize SOPs and decision frameworks to reduce manual validation, rework, and inconsistent execution
  • Partner on systems enhancements, UAT, and broader transformation initiatives (Salesforce, Workday, Zuora, or comparable platforms)
  • Build stronger integrity and reconciliation discipline across contracts, orders, billing systems, and the GL

What You Bring

Required

  • 8+ years of progressive experience spanning finance, revenue accounting, and/or order-to-cash operations
  • Genuine, hands-on knowledge of ASC 606 / revenue recognition — able to speak to specific contracts or scenarios where you personally determined or influenced revenue treatment
  • Experience navigating SOX / internal controls, including audit support (internal or external)
  • People management experience — leading, coaching, and developing a team
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and making judgment calls without a clean playbook
  • Strong reconciliation and data-integrity mindset across contracts, billing, and financial systems

Strongly Preferred

  • SaaS or technology industry experience
  • Experience at a large, recognizable company with mature finance/controls infrastructure
  • Exposure to Deal Desk, Sales, or Legal in a contract-review or revenue-advisory capacity
  • Systems experience with Salesforce, Workday, Zuora, or comparable Quote-to-Cash platforms
  • Experience leading or contributing to systems/process transformation initiatives

This role is not a fit if your experience is primarily:

  • AR, collections, cash application, or DSO-focused billing operations
  • GTM Revenue Operations (Salesforce administration, lead routing, pipeline/territory management)
  • Audit-only, without commercial or revenue recognition exposure
  • Transformation/PMO work without an accounting foundation

Why This Role

This team is being intentionally rebuilt with more structure, stronger financial judgment, and less manual, reactive work. You'll have real influence over how the Americas order-to-revenue process works — not just executing an existing playbook, but building the frameworks, controls, and standards that the function runs on going forward. It's a rare seat that lets you use deep accounting judgment in an operational leadership capacity, with a clear growth path as the organization scales.

This role has a market-competitive salary with an anticipated base compensation range listed below. Actual salaries will vary depending on a candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and location. This role might also be eligible for a commission or performance-based bonus opportunities.

$85,000.00 - $149,400.00

Benefits:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance.

  • Telehealth coverage

  • Flexible work schedules and work from home opportunities

  • Development and career growth opportunities

  • Open Time Off in addition to 10 paid holidays

  • 401(k) matching program

  • Adoption Assistance

  • Fertility treatments

Working at Genesys

  • AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year.
  • A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work.
  • Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support.
  • Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families.
  • Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work®certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys.

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.

  • Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team.

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.

This includes the number and opportunity size of active partner opportunities in the pipeline, number of signed partners, and revenue generated from newly signed partners.

What You’ll Bring to Engine

Join us on our mission to transform how work travel works—for businesses, for travelers, and for the industry. Apply now and let’s make travel simpler, smarter, and more enjoyable—together.

🤙🏼 About gaiia

At gaiia, we're building the leading platform for Communications Service Providers (CSPs) that truly care about their customers. Our core product is an operating system (OS) for telcos that manages billing, operations, automation and everything in between.

🎭 Role & Team

We're looking to hire a Full-Stack Software Developer with excellent technical skills and communication abilities to join our Platform squad.

You will join a team of 5 Full-Stack Developers (including a Team Lead), one Product Manager, one Quality Assurance Specialist and one Product Designer, developing and refining the technical frameworks and tools that empower all our development teams.

📽 What is your team working on?

Technically speaking, you will work in a serverless ecosystem of microservices deployed on AWS. gaiia is all-in on Typescript, with frontend, backend and infrastructure-as-code all leveraging Typescript.

More pragmatically, as part of the Platform squad, you will have the chance to:

  • Optimize the availability, performance and security of our cloud infrastructure.
  • Build internal libraries and DevOps guidelines to help Engineering squads own and maintain their infrastructure.
  • Craft and optimize our public APIs to provide a stellar developer experience to our technical customers.
  • Design and maintain robust data pipelines and platforms used by both internal teams and external customers.

You will also:

  • Work on a product that is heavily used every day by loyal customers.
  • Collaborate with all development squads.
  • Join a team involved in, surprisingly, all aspects of the gaiia product.

Here are some actual projects you would have worked on recently:

Serverless → CDK migration proof of concept: You'd have paved the way for your organization's move off the Serverless Framework — taking on an end-to-end production service migration to AWS CDK with Docker container Lambdas, then distilling it into a shareable, step-by-step guide any squad could follow with no prior context. You'd have designed the whole approach around safety: running the new setup in parallel with the old one so nothing went live until you were ready, with a clean rollback path if anything went wrong. The real impact wasn't just one migrated service — it was leaving behind a proven playbook that turned a daunting migration into a repeatable, low-risk process for every team after you.

Public API tooling: build internal tools to streamline the development and maintenance of our public API for all our development squads. This project involved automatic API doc generation, designing GraphQL rate-limiting and idempotency algorithms, building internal libraries for authentication and authorization, and adding in-app capabilities for API-key management.

Canary deployments proof of concept: You'd have researched and rolled out canary deployments for production services using AWS CDK and CodeDeploy. Instead of pushing a new version to everyone at once, the setup releases it to a small portion of traffic first, watches key health metrics, and automatically rolls back if something looks off. You'd have documented the setup so other squads could apply the same pattern to their own services, making releases safer and easier to reverse across the board.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud infrastructure
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and production observability

  • Familiarity with semantic layer technologies
  • Experience supporting both analytics and ML/AI workloads
  • Understanding of privacy regulations and data residency requirements

  • Clear architectural decisions have been made and documented.
  • Events entering the data platform have enforceable contracts.
  • Core canonical entities exist and are tested.
  • Data quality and lineage are observable.
  • Other engineers can contribute without needing to understand every implementation detail.

As part of Sigma Software, you will collaborate with experienced engineering teams and contribute to a platform designed around immutable event-driven architecture, governed data contracts, and modern lakehouse principles. Join us as a Senior Software Engineer

  • This is an opportunity for a technically minded individual to join us as a Senior Software Engineer
  • You'll be building and maintaining the services we provide to engineering squads
  • With no product owner or tech lead aligned to this squad, you'll have increased responsibility and autonomy.

What you'll do

You'll engage directly with stakeholders, prioritise based on impact, and deal with ambiguity. We use kanban so we can flexibly adapt. If a product squad is blocked, we want to be able to drop what we're doing and help them immediately.

You’ll also be:

  • You'll be working on things like CI/CD pipelines, Golden Paths and AI productivity tooling. Right now, our biggest focus is enabling and supporting AI adoption across the business.
  • Collaborating with other squads to help them with their problems
  • On a rota for in-hours support, ensuring that we're there for engineers across the business when they're stuck. Whether that's a broken pipeline, a deployment issue, or something they've never seen before. It's varied, often urgent, and requires strong debugging skills and patience

The skills you'll need

We’re looking for someone who can make sound technical decisions and know when to push for quality and when to be pragmatic. You don't wait to be told what to work on - you actively look for ways to improve how squads deliver software, take ownership from problem through to outcome, and can mentor and challenge other engineers through collaboration rather than hierarchy.

  • A focus on the customer - You take pride in helping other engineers. Supporting squads through in-hours support is a core part of the role, and you see it as valuable work, not a chore

The Position:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Clinical Reimbursement Specialist to serve as a clinical subject matter expert on our Clinical Reimbursement Operations team. In this role, you will independently manage complex pre- and post-service appeals, mentor junior team members, and drive process improvements that measurably improve overturn rates and revenue capture across the revenue cycle.

You will apply advanced clinical judgment and deep payer policy expertise to handle the team's most complex, high-dollar, and precedent-setting cases - including Level 2 appeals, external reviews, and payer escalations. Beyond individual casework, you will contribute to workflow design, SOP development, and cross-functional initiatives that strengthen the team's overall performance.

Success in this role requires advanced knowledge of reimbursement systems (including payer utilization management and claims adjudication), fluency in payer medical policies, sound and independent clinical judgment on complex cases, and the ability to influence outcomes through both direct case ownership and informal leadership.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Independently manage complex pre- and post-service appeals across Level 1, Level 2, and external review pathways, including the review, development, and submission of clinically robust appeal documentation.
  • Serve as a clinical subject matter expert on payer medical policies, translating complex policy criteria into patient-specific clinical justification and guiding appeal strategy for high-dollar, ambiguous, or precedent-setting cases.
  • Own end-to-end resolution of assigned cases, including follow-up, coordination with ordering providers, and appropriate escalation to leadership when warranted.
  • Partner with ordering physicians and practice staff to coordinate peer-to-peer reviews, gather supplemental clinical documentation, secure Authorized Representative forms and signatures, and support collaborative initiatives that strengthen appeal outcomes.
  • Mentor and provide informal guidance to Clinical Reimbursement Specialists, including case review, appeal letter quality feedback, and coaching on payer policy interpretation.
  • Lead analysis of denial patterns and appeal outcomes to identify root causes, and drive upstream feedback to reduce future denials.
  • Contribute directly to the development and refinement of appeal letter templates, clinical evidence packets, payer reference guides, and other scalable operational tools.
  • Monitor payer behavior and policy changes across all lines of business; flag material changes and partner with leadership on remediations, coverage reviews, and payer escalations.
  • Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of SOPs, ensuring workflows remain consistent, compliant, and scalable as the team grows.
  • Serve as point of contact for complex patient- or provider-facing inquiries, ensuring accurate, empathetic, and compliant communication.
  • Support digital transformation initiatives, including automation and AI/agentic workflow pilots that improve appeal readiness scoring and clinical documentation review.
  • Represent the Clinical Reimbursement team in cross-functional initiatives and special projects that support evolving reimbursement and operational priorities.

Who You Are:

Qualifications

Required

  • Active clinical licensure (e.g., RN, NP).
  • Associate or Bachelor's degree in nursing.
  • 3–5 years of experience in healthcare reimbursement, revenue cycle operations, or payer-facing roles.
  • 2+ years of experience in prior authorization, denial management, or appeals -including pre-service and post-service workflows.
  • Advanced understanding of payer medical policies, prior authorization, claims adjudication, denials, and appeals - including Level 1, Level 2, and external review processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex, ambiguous, or high-dollar cases without routine escalation.
  • Proven ability to translate complex payer medical policy criteria into patient-specific clinical justification.
  • Strong critical thinking and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret incomplete denial information and drive appropriate next steps without direction.
  • Experience contributing to the development of SOPs, appeal letter templates, workflow tools, or other operational assets within a reimbursement environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor or provide informal leadership to peers, including case review, coaching, or SME support.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional discussions and convey clinical/reimbursement concepts to both clinical and non-clinical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrates ownership of cases through resolution, including follow-up, coordination, and appropriate escalation.
  • Comfortable working in an evolving environment with shifting priorities, ambiguity, and the need to build systems where none exist.

Preferred

  • Prior experience in oncology diagnostics, laboratory services, or complex/specialty reimbursement environments.
  • Experience leading or contributing to process improvement, workflow redesign, or operational scaling initiatives within the revenue cycle.
  • Familiarity with digital transformation initiatives in healthcare operations (automation, AI/agentic workflows, workflow tools, system integration).
  • Relevant certification (CPC, CRCR, CHFP, Lean/Six Sigma) or Master's degree (MSN, MHA, MBA).

What You’ll Be Doing:

Sr. Director, AI Platform Engineering

Job Summary

The Sr. Director of AI Platform Engineering leads the engineering teams supporting Evolent's enterprise AI platform initiatives, with a focus on three capability areas: the document pipeline, event-driven architecture, and agentic user interfaces. The role is accountable for engineering execution in these areas — staffing the teams, delivering the software, and operating it in production — working within the platform direction set with Enterprise Architecture and Product.


This is a build-the-team-while-you-build-the-platform role. The leader will stand up and grow multiple engineering teams from an early-stage footprint and deliver capability on a roadmap where later work depends on the foundations landing first. Success requires equal strength in enterprise-scale delivery judgment and in hiring, organizing and developing engineering talent under delivery pressure.


Architectural direction and platform design standards are set in partnership with Enterprise Architecture. This role is a primary contributor to and implementer of them rather than their sole owner. The Sr. Director partners closely with Architecture, Product, Data Engineering, Security and the core system engineering teams, and represents the platform engineering organization in executive forums. As a leader in the engineering organization, the Sr. Director fosters a culture of quality, customer obsession, product mindset, and technical excellence.


What You Will Be Doing


Support New Enterprise-Scale Platform Initiatives

  • Lead the engineering teams delivering the document pipeline, event-driven architecture and agentic user interface capabilities, from build through production support.
  • Support roadmap sequencing with architecture and product partners, so foundational capabilities land ahead of the work that depend on them and hold that sequence when delivery pressure argues for shortcuts.
  • Implement the platform contracts and standards agreed with Enterprise Architecture and contribute to the engineering perspective that shapes them before dependent teams build against them.
  • Drive capabilities from first production consumer to broader enterprise adoption, proving each one at production volume rather than declaring it complete at first release.
  • Partner with the infrastructure and security organizations on the underlying cloud, messaging and hosting foundations the platform depends on.

Build and Grow the Teams

  • Stand up and scale the engineering teams behind each capability area, including the team topology, role mix and skill profile each one requires as it moves from early build into production operations.

  • Build and maintain a strong engineering culture focused on innovation, collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement, with domain expertise and quality treated as first-class outcomes.

Contribute to Technical Direction and Standards

  • Work with executive leadership, enterprise architecture, product management, and other stakeholders to shape the platform's roadmap and long-term strategy and translate it into executable engineering plans.
  • Apply and reinforce enterprise standards for software development, architecture, and quality assurance.
  • Oversee development and delivery of scalable, high-quality software consistent with the approved architecture, with observability, cost telemetry and operational readiness built in from the start.
  • Support the core system engineering teams in defining integration seams, migration paths and fallback handling so existing systems adopt platform capabilities incrementally.
  • Act as a trusted partner to the business by understanding its needs deeply, influencing through technical expertise, and representing the engineering organization in discussions on progress, risks and opportunities.

AI-Enabled Delivery

  • Utilize approved AI-assisted engineering tools, and lead teams that use them, to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting and analysis activities.
  • Ensure AI-generated outputs are evaluated and validated for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness before they reach production.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and solution quality through AI-enabled workflows and automation.
  • Contribute reusable prompts, workflow templates, engineering playbooks and AI-assisted development patterns that benefit the broader engineering organization.
  • Deliver systems that leverage AI services, APIs, agents and automation capabilities where appropriate, partnering with architecture, security and platform teams on how those capabilities are integrated into enterprise applications.

Governance and Compliance

  • Follow and enforce enterprise policies governing AI usage, intellectual property protection, security, privacy, PHI handling and Responsible AI practices across the teams.
  • Ensure no confidential, regulated or protected information is used with unapproved AI services or tooling.
  • Establish peer review and validation processes for AI-assisted solutions and ensure audit visibility and traceability are built into the capabilities the teams deliver.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 7+ years in leadership roles managing large, distributed teams.
  • Proven track record of delivering complex, enterprise-scale software projects on time and within budget, including at least one initiative launched from inception rather than inherited in flight.
  • Demonstrated experience building engineering teams as part of a new initiative: defining the organization, hiring at pace, and delivering while the team is still forming.
  • High technical acumen, with the ability to influence technical strategy beyond immediate team scope.
  • Strong technical expertise in software architecture, API development and system integration, and deep understanding of cloud services and DevOps practices.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development platforms such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar tools, and familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted testing and AI-enabled software delivery practices.
  • Experience establishing effective engineering operating models and implementing agile methodologies across teams to drive predictable delivery.
  • Exceptional leadership and team-building skills, with the ability to lead through change, build a product mindset, and foster a culture of innovation and accountability.
  • Strong business acumen, with the ability to align technical strategies with organizational goals and priorities.
  • Outstanding communication, collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization and articulate complex technical concepts clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Healthcare domain knowledge, particularly medical claims, prior authorization and clinical documentation workflows.
  • FHIR experience — especially prior-authorization workflows (PAS implementation guide, X12 278 crosswalk) or other healthcare interoperability (HL7v2, CDA).

jobs.excerpt: At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen.
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Director, Data Center Services Center of Excellence

__

We are looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead the start-up and commissioning of power delivery equipment for large-scale data centers. In this role, you will own the planning and execution of commissioning activities for MV/LV switchgear (AIS and GIS), busway, and related critical power systems, ensuring that hyperscale, colocation, and enterprise data centers go live safely, on time, and exactly as designed.
This is a high-visibility, high-impact role at the intersection of engineering, construction, and operations, ideal for someone who thrives in complex technical environments and enjoys being on the critical path of data center delivery.

The work model for the role is: Remote



This role is contributing to the Electrification Service Data Center Services COE in the United States.

Key Responsibilities:

Project Leadership & Ownership

  • Lead end-to-end start-up and commissioning projects for electrical power systems within data centers—from pre-functional checks through Integrated Systems Testing (IST) and handover.
  • Develop and own the commissioning project plan, including scope, schedule, budget, risk register, and resource plan.
  • Serve as the single point of contact for all commissioning-related activities with internal teams, customers, and contractors.

Technical & Commissioning Execution

  • Coordinate and oversee commissioning activities for:
  • Medium and low voltage switchgear / switchboards
  • Transformers, Busway / bus duct and protection relays and metering
  • Ensure commissioning is executed in accordance with owner’s project requirements, design basis, specifications, and industry standards (e.g., NFPA, IEEE, IEC, ASHRAE, Uptime).
  • Review and approve commissioning scripts, test procedures, and method statements, and ensure that deficiencies are documented, tracked, and closed out.
  • Drive root cause analysis and corrective actions for issues uncovered during L2-L4 commissioning and IST.

Stakeholder & Customer Management

  • Act as the key liaison between clients (including hyperscale cloud, enterprise, and colo customers), EPCs, OEMs, Cx agents, and internal engineering/service teams.
  • Run regular progress meetings and technical reviews, clearly communicating status, risks, and recovery plans.
  • Build strong working relationships on-site and represent the company with professionalism and confidence.

Safety, Quality & Compliance

  • Champion a “zero harm” safety culture on all commissioning sites, ensuring compliance with company and customer safety policies and procedures.
  • Enforce quality standards and ensure all work is executed to the highest levels of craftsmanship and reliability.
  • Ensure all required documentation, test reports, as-builts, redlines, and turnover packages are complete, accurate, and delivered on time.

Planning, Controls & Reporting

  • Develop and maintain detailed commissioning schedules aligned with construction milestones and data center go-live dates.
  • Track costs, change orders, and earned value for commissioning scope; proactively manage variances and opportunities.
  • Provide regular project reporting to leadership and customers, including KPIs, risk/issue logs, punch lists, and lessons learned.

Team Collaboration & Leadership

  • Coordinate and direct multidisciplinary site teams (field engineers, technicians, subcontractors, and third-party Cx agents).
  • Mentor less-experienced engineers and support staff on commissioning best practices, documentation, and customer communication.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of standard commissioning procedures, templates, and tools.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field; or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

  • 7+ years managing complex technical projects, with at least 3+ years focused on start-up and commissioning of power or MEP systems.
  • Direct experience in data centers, critical facilities, or heavy industrial power distribution environments.
  • Strong understanding of electrical power systems (MV/LV), short circuit/coordination concepts, protective relays, and critical power architecture (N, N+1, 2N).
  • Demonstrated experience with commissioning processes (levels 1–5), electrical acceptance testing, and integrated systems testing.
  • Familiarity with EPMS/BMS, SCADA, and controls integration is a plus.:
  • Proven track record managing scope, schedule, cost, risk, and stakeholders on multi-million-dollar projects.
  • Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera, or equivalent) and the MS Office suite.
  • Willingness and ability to travel to project sites (10-20% travel).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable presenting to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Authorized to work in the United States

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading commissioning for hyperscale or large colocation data centers.
  • Hands-on background as an electrical field engineer, commissioning engineer, or Cx agent before moving into project management.
  • Professional certifications such as PMP, PE, CxA, CPQ, or equivalent.
  • Experience with major OEM low and medium voltage equipment and protective relay platforms.
  • Familiarity with NFPA 70/70E, IEEE, IEC, and data center-specific standards/owner specifications.
  • Demonstrated experience building and scaling processes for repeatable commissioning across multiple sites or regions.

What's in it for you

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a Bilingual high energy sales representative who knows how to create opportunities.

Position Purpose:

The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) is responsible for driving sales activity within an assigned territory or customer segment through proactive outbound engagement, lead qualification, pipeline development, and closing assigned sales opportunities. The ISR is measured on revenue/ARR, pipeline generation, sales activity, and achievement of assigned targets. The role has two primary orientations: New Business (identifying and converting new customer opportunities) and Expansion Business (growing commercial value within existing installed accounts). The ISR owns assigned opportunities through qualification, product demonstration, proposal, and close, and partners with the Account Executive, Customer Success Manager, and other teams when opportunities require broader commercial or technical support.

Key Responsibilities: (what you will do)

  • Grow annual revenue in the assigned territory or customer segment in line with individual annual and quarterly targets, contributing to the company's five-year growth plan.
  • Deliver effective product demonstrations, prospect and develop new customers through high volume outbound calling, email and other targeted outreach.
  • Identify and qualify new customers and expansion opportunities into the sales pipeline.
  • Manage inbound and outbound leads and assigned sales opportunities using LinkedIn, marketing campaigns, customer data, and other approved resources.
  • Qualify leads from the Customer Success Manager (CSM), marketing, Account Executives, and other sources. The ISR is responsible for timely follow-up, qualification, progression, and closing of opportunities within the defined inside sales scope.
  • Provide regular updates on performance, pipeline, conversion, and business development activity.
  • Manage all assigned sales opportunities using the agreed sales process and sales methodology.
  • Log and progress all qualified opportunities in Salesforce through all stages of the sales cycle.
  • Work together with other teams, including Account Executives, Implementation, Training, Customer Success, and Marketing, and provide all information needed for an effective customer handoff.
  • Plan and conduct high-quality proactive outbound contact with prospects, leads, and existing customers by phone, email, and other approved channels.
  • Plan and execute sales activity with the broader team in the region, ensuring alignment on priorities, campaigns, and customer opportunities.
  • Maintain a qualified pipeline at the required coverage ratio and provide accurate weekly forecasts for assigned opportunities.
  • Manage and update Salesforce records, ensuring lead data, activity, opportunity stages, and customer information are accurate and up to date at all times.
  • Partner with the Account Executive and Solution Engineer (SE) when an opportunity requires complex pricing, technical demonstration, proof of concept, RFP response, or broader commercial support. The ISR remains accountable for a clear and timely handoff.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with prospects and customers at the appropriate level for the assigned account segment.
  • Support broader sales and marketing initiatives to increase brand awareness, customer engagement, pipeline, and client base.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including Account Executives, Implementation Consultants (IC), SEs, Product Management, Customer Success, and Marketing, to ensure customer needs are understood and supported.
  • Be a positive representative of Infomedia and its brand within every customer and market interaction.
  • Conduct all sales activities with the highest level of professionalism and integrity.
  • Collaborate with the Technology Team and sales leadership to ensure sales activity aligns with Infomedia's cybersecurity capabilities and clients' security requirements.
  • Manage all customer and prospect information in compliance with relevant data protection laws and internal Infomedia policies.

Position Requirements: (what we are looking for)

Qualifications, Skills & Experience:

  • Sales experience in a B2B SaaS, technology, inside sales, or customer-facing commercial environment, with demonstrated success against activity, pipeline, or revenue targets.
  • High volume outbound call center experience.
  • Experience managing leads, pipeline, and sales activity using a CRM system, preferably Salesforce.
  • Training or experience in SaaS sales processes and methodologies is preferred.
  • Ability to qualify opportunities rigorously and progress them through a structured sales process.
  • Confidence engaging with customers and prospects by phone, email, video, and other digital channels.
  • Strong commercial instinct: ability to understand customer needs, position value, handle objections, and close assigned opportunities without unnecessary discounting.
  • Ability to recognize when an opportunity requires Account Executive, Solution Engineer, or leadership support and to coordinate an effective handoff.
  • Excellent organisational skills and ability to manage a high volume of leads, activities, and opportunities simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal English language skills, plus local market language skills.
  • Automotive or adjacent industry experience is advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Confidence in proactive prospecting and customer interaction via email, phone calls, and virtual meetings.
  • High degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Excellent organisational, follow-up, and recordkeeping skills.
  • Confident in the use of online tools for research, prospecting, and customer engagement.
  • Ability to work under pressure, to clear targets, and to deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong administration skills, personal discipline, and consistent follow-through.
  • Ability to articulate the importance of security and privacy in a sales context and to address or appropriately escalate related customer queries.
  • High attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining the confidentiality and integrity of customer and prospect data.

Behaviours:

  • High sales drive and motivation to achieve and exceed targets.
  • Collaborative by nature: works effectively with Account Executives, CSMs, SEs, Marketing, and internal teams rather than operating independently.
  • Commercially curious: understands the customer's business problem and positions solutions against business outcomes, not product features.
  • Proactive and persistent: comfortable initiating contact, following up consistently, and creating momentum with prospects and customers.
  • Able to represent Infomedia professionally and positively.
  • Polite, clear, and articulate communicator with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Respectful to others. Acts with integrity.
  • You will thrive here if you enjoy picking up the phone, are energized by business that did not exist yesterday and know how to stay motivated.

Other:

  • Ability to occasionally work outside of office hours, primarily to communicate with colleagues or customers in regions other than that which you are locally based.
  • Ability to travel within your sales region periodically, as required.

jobs.excerpt: Chooose builds software to enable the lower carbon fuel value chain.
jobs.description:
Chooose builds software to enable the lower carbon fuel value chain.

Companies like Delta Air Lines, Cathay Pacific, British Airways, and Microsoft use the Chooose platform to build, operate, and scale their lower carbon fuel programs (typically referred to as Sustainable Aviation Fuel, or SAF), and to advance voluntary and compliance carbon management initiatives.

With offices in Miami and Oslo, and remote employees across the US and Europe, Chooose is relentlessly focused on delivering enterprise software products to enable our customers to drive lower carbon fuel adoption. The company has raised $50M from leading venture capital and strategic investors.

This opportunity is exclusively available as a B2B arrangement

As a Product Owner at Chooose, you will own the end-to-end product vision, roadmap, and execution for your domain. You’ll work with a core team of engineers and designers to build products that enable the largest aviation fuel suppliers and fuel buyers to accelerate their lower carbon fuel business processes.

We’re looking for someone who is energized by ambiguity, deeply curious about the frontier of AI in enterprise products, and passionate about building products that balance technical depth with intuitive user experiences. You’ll need to be hands-on with prototyping and comfortable translating complex systems into clear, user-centered solutions.

This role reports to the CTO.

What you'll do

  • Own the vision, roadmap and execution for a Chooose domain, balancing intuition with data

  • Deeply understand the aviation fuel market and our customers’ needs by spending time with customers

  • Drive high-velocity execution with a distributed team of engineers and designers

  • Prototype rapidly using tools like Cursor to accelerate the product development lifecycle and fast-forward to production-ready products

  • Stay deeply plugged into AI tooling, industry trends, and emergent applications, filtering signal from noise and applying it accelerate execution for the Product team

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization such as Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Account Management, and Operations

What you bring to the table

  • BA/BS in a technical or analytical field (e.g. Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Applied Sciences, or related)

  • Minimum 4 years of product management or adjacent product-building experience in an enterprise context

  • Strong customer empathy and design thinking

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects, and staying current on tools

  • Fluency with core LLM concepts and systems, such as prompting, fine-tuning, embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation, and the judgment to translate these into reliable, user-facing products

  • Fluency with modern prototyping tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code) and comfort with design/collaboration environments (Figma)

  • Fluency in data and experimentation, and understanding when the answer cannot be found in the data

  • Proven ability to lead small, technical teams toward ambitious product goals with urgency

  • Ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences, synthesizing complex systems into compelling narratives

  • Native-level English writing and speaking skills

Nice to have

  • Experience building in financial, enterprise, or other compliance-heavy domains requiring precision and complex systems thinking

  • Experience in high growth startups

  • Experience getting results on a distributed team

  • Polish language skills

Not for you if

  • You prefer product strategy briefings over hands-on delivery

  • You’re not building with AI

The interview process

At Chooose, we prioritize transparency throughout our interview process. If your qualifications look like a fit, we’ll begin with a few introductory conversations where you'll have the chance to discuss your experience and learn more about our company. The second phase varies depending on the role and will most likely involve a practical exercise to show your work. The third and final phase consists of a few one-on-one conversation members of the executive team. The process should take approx. 4-6 weeks. While we strive to keep to this timeline, the occasional adjustment may occur; we’re focused on ensuring for enough time to get to know one another.

We value diversity and believe forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds and different industries to apply.

Compensation will be based on experience and skill, commensurate with market rates, and will include both a monthly fee and equity in Chooose.

Chooose is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion (creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin (ancestry), disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment to our employees and welcome input from candidates and employees on how we can enhance our inclusiveness.

Prerequisite for Employment: Chooose may request to conduct background checks on prospective applicants to verify the information provided in the CV, transcripts, and other documentation. This background check may be carried out by our partner and will not be conducted without the applicant's prior consent. Prospective applicants will receive more information about this.
